auto_merge.commit_title: fix(managed-agent-server): keep journal blob reclamation moving past sealed heads (#17907)
auto_merge.commit_message:
The eviction recheck required the session head to be ACTIVE, and its
failure path returned without state change or cursor. SEALED is the
normal resting state between writer leases, so with the default 72h
grace almost every pack reaching the cutoff belongs to a sealed head;
once 32 such packs fill the global oldest-first LIMIT 32 window, every
30s sweep re-selects the same rows and SQL blob reclamation stalls
fleet-wide. Drop the state conjunct: the packed-through-revision
comparison already proves coverage for any head state, and pack-aware
readers resolve evicted bytes for sealed and waking heads alike.

Add a regression test reproducing the stall (32 sealed-head packs aged
ahead of one active pack): red on the unfixed code (every pass returns
0), green with the fix (32 evicted, then the active pack behind the
window, then an empty pass; bytes resolvable for sealed and active
sessions).

Also lower the three class-size ratchet ceilings to the post-#17856
extraction sizes (760/831/796) and correct the AutomationLedgerRows
javadoc, which described the write-side fence proof as read-only.

prs.title: feat(i18n): add Arabic support for CLI and Web Shell with RTL layout
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This pull request adds complete Arabic language support across both the command-line interface and the Web Shell, including right-to-left layout support in the Web Shell and exported HTML transcripts.

In core and the CLI, Arabic is registered as a shipped language option in the shared output language table and settings schema so it appears alongside existing locales in interactive language selection, slash-command completions, daemon feature advertisement, ACP integrations, and automated locale checks. A full Arabic locale catalog is included for CLI prompts, commands, tool display names, and subscription quota notices with all six Arabic cardinal plural forms.

In the Web Shell, Arabic is supported across transcript views, standalone gates, Managed agent views, slash-command subcommand completion, local command hints, toast notices, settings dialogs, and the service-worker offline fallback. Right-to-left rendering is driven automatically from the resolved UI language via document and portal direction attributes, Radix direction context propagation, conversion of layout-directional CSS and Tailwind utilities to logical properties, mirrored pointer-drag resize deltas and horizontal arrow-key navigation, flipped directional chevrons and back arrows, RTL-aware sticky DataTable pinning and Switch thumb travel, and explicit left-to-right preservation for code blocks, diffs, terminals, structured spreadsheets, charts, left-to-right plan dependency topology graphs, and interactive waiting games. Interactive-only Arabic translations are stubbed out of the read-only transcript export bundle while keeping transcript-reachable Arabic strings available in exported HTML documents, and the document export bundle budget has been updated to match the measured size.

## Why it's needed

Arabic-speaking users previously had to fall back to English in both the terminal CLI and the browser Web Shell, and Arabic text inside the Web Shell rendered inside an English left-to-right shell chrome with unmirrored spacing, borders, popovers, drawers, and directional controls. Adding full Arabic catalogs, CLDR six-form pluralization, and full RTL layout mirroring makes both interfaces natural and usable for Arabic users without inflating read-only exported HTML transcripts with interactive-only UI strings.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Switch the CLI UI language to Arabic via settings or `/language ui ar`, and verify locale normalization for regional and POSIX variants such as `ar-SA` and `ar_EG.UTF-8` while confirming unrelated prefix neighbors like `armenian` do not map to Arabic. Confirm CLI menus, `/language` choices, tool display badges, and multi-form quota messages render in Arabic, and model output language settings recognize `Arabic` alongside existing options.
2. Open the Web Shell in standalone or embedded mode with Arabic selected via `?language=ar`, `/language ui ar`, `/settings`, or browser locale, and verify both the root container and the portal root carry `lang="ar"` and `dir="rtl"`.
3. Inspect key RTL surfaces in Web Shell: the sidebar docks on the start side and widens when dragging its resize handle leftward, popovers and tooltips open on the mirrored side, the floating artifact drawer slides from the left edge, the docked right panel widens when dragging its divider rightward, horizontal tab and timeline arrow navigation follows RTL order, directional back arrows and collapsed chevrons mirror visually, switches slide leftward when toggled on, and DataTable sticky leading/trailing columns pin to the right and left edges respectively.
4. Confirm code blocks, diffs, terminals, spreadsheets, ECharts, and left-to-right DAG plan dependency graphs remain legible with intentional left-to-right structural geometry while user messages isolate mixed-direction text cleanly.
5. Export a conversation to HTML while using Arabic and verify exported transcripts render localized status labels and RTL direction without pulling interactive-only Arabic dictionaries into the read-only transcript bundle.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Automated verification after the final edits confirmed green workspace builds, TypeScript typechecks across all packages and integration tests, zero-warning strict linting, CLI i18n checks showing 1976/2005 Arabic keys translated with zero missing keys, clean read-only transcript bundle builds within the updated byte ceiling, and passing unit/DOM tests covering core output-language consumers, CLI language/quota behavior, Web Shell Arabic pluralization, non-collision locale normalization, build-boundary separation, and RTL layout/resize/drawer/table behavior. Live browser screenshots were not captured locally in this turn.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 22 macOS verification covering workspace builds, strict ESLint, TypeScript typechecks, Prettier formatting, CLI locale validation, and Vitest unit/DOM suites. Playwright browser E2E, integration suites, and Windows/Linux hosts remain to be validated in CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Adding Arabic to the shared core output-language table affects downstream consumers across core goal verification, session title generation, the settings JSON schema, the CLI language registry and `/language` command, serve settings/feature routes, ACP integration, and the i18n check script; all downstream consumers were verified against the build, typecheck, and existing/expanded unit tests. In Web Shell, keeping synchronous translator lookups splits Arabic strings into transcript-reachable and interactive-only modules so read-only HTML exports grow by 47,120 measured bytes (including RTL runtime wiring) rather than carrying all interactive copy. Broad logical CSS/Tailwind refactoring across Web Shell components relies on automated CSS, ref-compat, and DOM suites locally and benefits from Playwright/visual spot-checks in CI.
- Not validated / out of scope: VS Code IDE companion host-chrome strings outside the embedded Web Shell remain English and Simplified Chinese only and were left untouched as requested scope focused on CLI and Web Shell; terminal RTL rendering behavior depends on the host terminal emulator; full Playwright visual tests and non-macOS runners were not executed locally; an unrelated pre-existing timing race observed in the Managed local-files bridge test suite also reproduces identically on the untouched base commit.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. English remains the fallback locale, existing partial-catalog behavior for Russian is unchanged, and existing language configuration values continue to work without migration.

## Linked Issues

None

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 为命令行界面（CLI）与 Web Shell 增加了完整的阿拉伯语语言支持，并在 Web Shell 及导出的 HTML 对话记录中支持从右到左（RTL）的镜像布局。

在 Core 与 CLI 部分，我们将阿拉伯语注册为共享输出语言表及设置 Schema 中的内置语言选项，使其能够同步出现在交互式语言选择器、斜杠命令补全、守护进程特性声明、ACP 集成以及国际化校验脚本中。同时新增了完整的 CLI 阿拉伯语翻译词典，覆盖交互提示、命令说明、工具显示名称以及包含全部六种阿拉伯语基数复数形态的订阅配额提示。

在 Web Shell 部分，阿拉伯语已全面覆盖对话记录视图、独立认证门槛页、托管 Agent 视图、斜杠命令子命令补全、本地命令提示、Toast 通知、设置面板以及 Service Worker 离线回退页。系统会根据解析出的界面语言自动在根容器与 Portal 根节点设置 `lang="ar"` 与 `dir="rtl"`，并通过 Radix 方向上下文向下透传；同时将具备方向语义的 CSS 与 Tailwind 样式统一改造为逻辑属性，在 RTL 模式下镜像处理侧边栏与右侧面板拖拽调整宽度的方向符号、横向键盘方向键导航、返回箭头与折叠尖角图标方向、Switch 开关滑块位移动画以及 DataTable 固定列的吸顶方向；对于代码块、Diff、终端、电子表格、图表、有向无环计划拓扑图和等待小游戏等需要保持物理从左到右结构的内容，则显式保留 LTR 排版，并对混合方向的用户消息采用双向隔离渲染。为避免导出体积膨胀，仅交互界面使用的阿拉伯语词条会在导出 HTML 构建模式中被独立存根剔除，仅保留只读记录所需词条，并依据实测字节数同步更新了导出运行时大小预算。

## 为什么需要这个改动

此前使用阿拉伯语的用户在 CLI 与 Web Shell 中只能回退到英文界面，且 Web Shell 中的阿拉伯语文本会直接嵌入英文 LTR 界面框架里，导致边距、边框、弹出层方向、抽屉滑出方向以及箭头图标方向均与阿拉伯语阅读习惯相反。通过补充完整的阿拉伯语词条、CLDR 六形态复数规则以及全套 RTL 镜像布局，两个端都可以为阿拉伯语用户提供自然完整的使用体验，同时保证只读导出的 HTML 文件不会被仅用于交互界面的翻译文本拖累体积。

## 审阅测试计划

### 验证方式

1. 在 CLI 中通过配置文件或 `/language ui ar` 切换界面语言为阿拉伯语，并验证 `ar-SA`、`ar_EG.UTF-8` 等区域/POSIX 标签的规范化解析，同时确认诸如 `armenian` 等共享前缀但不相干的词不会被误识别为阿拉伯语。检查 CLI 菜单、`/language` 选项、工具名称徽章、订阅配额多复数形式以及模型输出语言 `Arabic` 的显示与设置是否正常。
2. 在独立模式或嵌入模式下通过 `?language=ar`、`/language ui ar`、`/settings` 或浏览器语言切换到阿拉伯语打开 Web Shell，确认主根节点和 Portal 根节点均带有 `lang="ar"` 和 `dir="rtl"` 属性。
3. 验证 Web Shell 中的核心 RTL 交互与布局：侧边栏停靠在起始侧且向左拖拽分隔条时加宽，Tooltip 与 Popover 在镜像侧弹出，窄屏下的浮动右侧抽屉从左侧滑入，宽屏停靠下的右侧面板向右拖拽分隔条时加宽，水平 Tab 与时间轴导航遵循 RTL 方向键顺序，返回箭头和折叠箭头图标完成水平镜像，Switch 在开启时向左滑动，DataTable 固定首列与操作尾列分别吸附在右侧和左侧边缘。
4. 确认代码块、Diff 视图、终端、电子表格、ECharts 图表以及计划 DAG 拓扑图依然保持清晰的从左到右结构方向，同时包含阿英混排的用户消息可正确自动隔离文本方向。
5. 在阿拉伯语环境下导出 HTML 对话记录，确认导出文档可正确呈现本地化状态文案与 RTL 排版，且仅交互场景使用的阿拉伯语词典未被打包进只读导出产物。

### 对比证据

在最终修改完成后，我们已完成全仓工作区构建、全量 TypeScript 类型检查、零警告严格 ESLint 检查、Prettier 格式化校验、CLI 国际化脚本校验（阿拉伯语共翻译 1976/2005 项，缺失关键项为 0）、导出 HTML 运行时体积校验以及核心模块、CLI、Web Shell 与 VS Code Companion 相关单测和 DOM 测试验证。本次在本地未额外截取实时浏览器界面截图。

### 测试环境

|     系统   | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 运行环境说明

基于本地 macOS 与 Node 22 环境完成了工作区构建、严格 ESLint 检查、TypeScript 类型检查、Prettier 格式检查、CLI 语言校验与 Vitest 单元/DOM 测试；Playwright 浏览器 E2E 测试、集成测试及 Windows/Linux 环境需由 CI 进一步验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：在核心公共输出语言表中新增阿拉伯语会影响目标校验、会话标题生成、设置 JSON Schema、CLI 语言注册及 `/language` 命令、daemon 设置与特性路由、ACP 集成以及 i18n 检查脚本等下游消费方；上述全部下游消费方均已通过构建、类型检查以及原有与新增单测的验证。在 Web Shell 中，为保持同步翻译读取契约，我们将阿拉伯语词条拆分为只读记录与交互界面两个模块，使导出 HTML 运行时资产实测净增 47,120 字节（包含 RTL 方向控制逻辑）而不会引入大批量交互文案。组件库及各页面级样式大量改造为 CSS 逻辑属性与 RTL 镜像规则后，本地已通过 CSS 规则、ref 兼容与 DOM 单测验证，建议 CI 中结合视觉回归进一步复核。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：VS Code 扩展宿主侧外部框架文案未在本次范围内，仍维持英文与简体中文（其中嵌入的 Web Shell 本体支持阿拉伯语和 RTL）；终端层面的双向文字排布效果取决于用户所用的终端模拟器本身；全量 Playwright 视觉测试及非 macOS 平台尚未在本地运行；在 Web Shell 全量测试运行中观察到的 Managed 本地文件桥接测试条目存在一处上游基线提交已引入的无关竞态失败（我们的改动未涉及该目录）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。英文继续作为兜底语言，俄语既有的部分词条策略保持不变，现有语言配置无需任何迁移即可继续使用。

prs.title: fix(core): retain oversized transcript indexes in a bounded cache class
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Gives transcript indexes whose byte estimate exceeds the shared 64 MiB index-cache budget their own bounded retention class (256 MiB, LRU eviction within the class) instead of refusing them admission on every request, and makes hook-turn aggregate retention account against the entry's own budget class so a cached large index cannot block hook retention on small sessions. The shared byte budget keeps capping small-session retention exactly as before; the two classes never evict each other by byte budget. Worst-case byte retention is the sum of both budgets (320 MiB), and the constant comment records the remaining residuals explicitly. Capacity contracts in the design docs are updated in both languages.

## Why it's needed

#17889 measured that `GET /session/:id/transcript` costs the same wall-clock time regardless of `limit` and `cursor`: on a 199.9 MB / 84,352-record session every request — including `limit=1`, identical repeats, and cursor continuations — took ~4.2 s and stalled the daemon event loop for unrelated clients. The root cause is the cache admission policy: any index whose estimate exceeds the shared 64 MiB budget was refused outright, so the sessions that most need the cache could never enter it and reparsed the whole JSONL on every page. A 16.5 MiB control session proved the cache mechanism itself works (repeat requests hit in 0.6 ms); the only behavioral difference was the admission decision. This PR fixes that admission cliff for the daemon-local read paths (the workspace-qualified route Web Shell uses, restore projections, turn index, and long-lived ACP children).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Unit suites (from `packages/core`): `npx vitest run src/services/session-transcript-reader.test.ts src/services/session-hook-history.test.ts` → 193 passed, including 8 new regression tests: oversized retention serves repeats/cursor pages without rebuilding; a second oversized index that does not fit the class budget is refused without evicting the first; oversized pruning never touches shared entries; appends still invalidate a retained oversized index; mixed-class admission and hook retention account by class, not total bytes; the restore/offer path caches an oversized index for later pages. Two existing tests were updated to the new contract (zero-retention cases now set both budgets to 1; the non-eviction case now asserts the oversized entry is retained in its own class while the warm shared entry survives and still hits).
2. Mutation witnesses (each mutation applied to the production source, run, and restored): reverting oversized admission, reverting hook class accounting, cross-class prune eviction, total-byte accounting at all three sites, and reverting the offer hunk are each killed by their regression test (executed red/green flips, not read-based reasoning).
3. Issue-scale probe (source-level, the exact function the route delegates to — `SessionTranscriptReader.readPage`, no mocks): a synthetic 84,352-record / 204.6 MiB linear-chain transcript satisfying the reader's validation. Before the fix, ten consecutive requests with a byte-identical cache key each logged `index cache skipped oversized entry byteSize=108984066` and rebuilt the full index (~1.7–1.9 s each, event-loop gaps 378–439 ms). After the fix, the first request builds once and retains the 103.9 MiB index; repeats, cursor pages, and backward pages hit the cache.
4. Merged-tree re-verification: merged `origin/main` (33fdbb37) into the branch in a scratch worktree (clean merge; the only upstream reader delta is the unrelated restore-projection fields), rebuilt core, and ran the 9 reader/consumer suites → 764 passed (including 12 tests main added since the branch base).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change; measured request-level numbers on the 84,352-record / 204.6 MiB fixture (back-to-back, static file, Node v26.12.1):

| request | before | after | full index builds after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit=1` first | 1837.6 ms, cache empty | 1892.2 ms, index retained (108,984,066 bytes) | 1 (one-time) |
| `limit=10` | 1743.2 ms | 10.4 ms | 0 |

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): settle recovery from durable native terminals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a control-plane replica does not hold a Session's Hosted Harness attachment, it now answers the recovery view from durable state instead of reporting a failure. If the latest Turn on a live journal head ended with a terminal event that the Harness itself projected from its journaled settlement, and the Session owes no durable work (no active Turn, no live Runtime execution, no outstanding hosted cleanup debt), every replica answers `ready` with the next Turn allowed. Terminal events that the control plane writes on its own (its SQL failures and cancellations) never count as that proof. The owning replica's live evidence still wins, and sealed heads keep their existing suspension proof. A failed or foreign-prompt status read on the owning replica does not count as absence either: the arm also requires that the replica holds no cached recovery attachment, so unreadable evidence keeps the conservative arms.

Recovery recheck reads the same view, so a durably settled Turn returns `ready` without contacting any Harness. When a cleanup recheck does need a Harness and none can open the Session, the request now fails with `503 recovery_runtime_unavailable` and logs the original failure, instead of an uncoded 500 or a `409 recovery_recheck_unavailable` that never changes. Coded refusals, such as the pool's `503 harness_pool_unavailable`, pass through unchanged. A typed terminal decline (`HostedHarnessRecoveryDeclinedException`) maps to `409 hosted_turn_recovery_declined` with the decline kept as the cause: retrying never changes a decline, so it must not wear the retriable 503.

There is no schema or Harness change. The OpenAPI change is description-only: both recheck descriptions now name `503 recovery_runtime_unavailable` and `409 hosted_turn_recovery_declined` (version 1.123.0), and the Web Shell types are regenerated from it. The new read is one indexed existence check over public events, and 503 is already a documented response of the recheck endpoint.

#17542 (an externally terminated runtime that never settles its Turn) is analysed in the design document but not changed here. The control plane cannot break that loop by writing a failure itself: the journal input would stay unsettled, and the next Harness load would refuse the Session. The fix belongs in how the Runtime Broker reports a lost generation's executions, and it needs a real-stack reproduction first.

## Why it's needed

The Hosted Harness answers status only to the client that loaded the Session. On a multi-replica deployment, every other replica reads no evidence and reports a completed Turn as `operator_required` / `recovery_evidence_unavailable`, so behind round-robin load balancing the send gate flips per request. With four replicas, a completed Turn still locks about nine reads in sixteen, even with the Web Shell's two-miss mitigation (#17557). Recheck could not help: it required a reachable Harness even when durable state already proved the Turn settled.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- On two replicas sharing one MySQL catalog, complete a Turn through replica A, then read the Session's recovery and its summary on replica B. Before: `operator_required` / `recovery_evidence_unavailable` / `nextTurnAllowed: false`. After: `ready` / `nextTurnAllowed: true`, and the summary matches the recovery endpoint on the same replica.
- Make the control plane fail a Turn on its own, for example a submission that fails before it reaches the Harness. Replica B still answers `operator_required`, because a SQL-authored failure is not native settlement.
- While a background Runtime execution or a hosted cleanup debt is still owed, replica B does not answer `ready`.
- With the Harness stopped, recheck a durably settled Turn: the answer is `202` with `state: ready`, and the Harness is never asked to load the Session. Recheck a Turn whose terminal the control plane wrote: the answer is `503 recovery_runtime_unavailable` (or the pool's own coded 503), and the log has a WARN line with the original exception.

16 new H2 unit cases in the recovery service suite cover each of these arms, including the owner's live evidence winning over a native terminal, a sealed head without its wake proof staying not-ready, a non-terminal or foreign-Turn source-keyed row not settling the latest Turn, an unreadable owner status not granting readiness, and a typed decline returning the coded 409.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: server-side state, no UI change.

Local results on macOS with JDK 21 and H2:

- Recovery service suite: 60 tests, 0 failures (55 prior + 5 added in the review round), rerun after rebasing onto the latest main. Four mutation probes each turn the suite red on exactly the new cases: removing the decline catch, removing the cached-attachment guard, removing the `is_terminal = 1` filter, and neutralizing the `turn_id` filter.
- Recovery initial-state suite: 38 tests, 0 failures, run before the rebase. Main has since changed the schema and persistence code this suite uses, so CI's run is the evidence for the rebased revision.
- Checkstyle: 0 violations in all 14 modules.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS covers the focused H2 suites only. Linux runs in CI.

### Environment (optional)

Focused Maven runs from the managed-agent-server directory. The initial-state suite loads locally built core JavaScript.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the durable answer checks only the latest Turn and does not replay the journal. The claim that no earlier input remains pending behind a newer native terminal rests on the Harness running one Turn at a time and refusing to load a Session with an unsettled input; it is not proven over the journal. Separately, some non-ready verdicts are computed only inside the owning Harness (post-Turn file-history work, a pending file-history undo, an unready continuation, extension recovery, stopped writes). While one of them holds, the owner reports it but a non-owner replica answers `ready`. In both cases the view only gates sending: the next submit still goes through the coordinator and the Harness's own admission. Both are listed as residuals in the design document.
- Not validated / out of scope: the two-replica manual run above has not been executed yet. The real-MySQL query plan of the new check and the full `mvn verify`, mysql-integration and Hosted profiles are left to CI. The arm that refuses a bound Session with no managed head is unchanged; that head is created when the Harness first acquires the journal writer, which it needs before it can write a journal event, so a Turn with a native terminal always has one. #17542 has no code change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The recheck endpoint can now return a coded 503 where it previously returned an uncoded 500 or a permanent 409; a typed terminal decline returns `409 hosted_turn_recovery_declined` instead of a retriable 503. A cold recheck of a durably settled Turn returns `ready` without attempting owner-only cleanup — that drive is deliberately given up for the no-load guarantee, and is recorded as an accepted residual in design §9.

Design document: [English](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/fix/managed-recovery-settlement/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-recovery-native-terminal.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/fix/managed-recovery-settlement/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-recovery-native-terminal.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17538
Fixes #17543
Refs #17542 (analysis only; a follow-up is required)

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当控制面副本没有持有某个 Session 的 Hosted Harness attachment 时，它现在会根据持久状态回答恢复视图，而不是报告失败。如果活跃 journal head 上的最新 Turn 以 Harness 根据其 journal 结清记录投影出的终态事件结束，并且 Session 没有未完成的持久工作（没有活跃 Turn、没有运行中的 Runtime execution、没有未清的 hosted cleanup 债务），每个副本都会回答 `ready`，并允许下一个 Turn。控制面自己写入的终态事件（它在 SQL 中写的失败和取消）永远不算作这种证明。owner 副本的 live evidence 仍然优先，已 seal 的 head 保持原有的挂起证明。owner 副本上抛异常或回应别的 prompt 的状态读取也不算"没有证据"：该分支还要求本副本不持有缓存的 recovery attachment，读不到的证据仍走保守分支。

恢复 recheck 读取同一个视图，所以已持久结清的 Turn 不需要联系任何 Harness 就会返回 `ready`。当清理 recheck 确实需要 Harness、而没有任何 Harness 能打开该 Session 时，请求现在以 `503 recovery_runtime_unavailable` 失败并记录原始异常，不再返回无错误码的 500 或永远不变的 `409 recovery_recheck_unavailable`。带错误码的拒绝（例如 pool 的 `503 harness_pool_unavailable`）原样透传。类型化的终止拒绝（`HostedHarnessRecoveryDeclinedException`）映射为 `409 hosted_turn_recovery_declined` 并保留原拒绝作为 cause：重试永远改变不了拒绝，因此它不能披上可重试的 503。

没有 schema 或 Harness 改动。OpenAPI 仅改描述：两处 recheck 描述现在写明 `503 recovery_runtime_unavailable` 与 `409 hosted_turn_recovery_declined`（版本 1.123.0），Web Shell 类型已据此重新生成。新增的读取是一次在 public events 上走索引的存在性检查，503 也已经是 recheck 接口文档中登记的响应。

#17542（被外部终止的 runtime 永远无法结清其 Turn）在设计文档中做了分析，但本 PR 没有改动。控制面不能自己写一个失败来打破这个循环：journal 中的输入仍未结清，下一次 Harness 加载会拒绝该 Session。修复应落在 Runtime Broker 如何报告丢失 generation 的 execution 上，并且需要先在真实环境中复现。

## 为什么需要

Hosted Harness 只对加载该 Session 的客户端回答状态。在多副本部署中，其他副本都读不到证据，会把已完成的 Turn 报告为 `operator_required` / `recovery_evidence_unavailable`，因此在轮询负载均衡后面，发送按钮会随每个请求翻转。在 4 个副本下，即使有 Web Shell 的两次未命中缓解（#17557），一个已完成的 Turn 仍然会在约 16 次读取中锁住 9 次。recheck 也无济于事：即使持久状态已经证明 Turn 已结清，它仍然要求一个可达的 Harness。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 在共享同一个 MySQL catalog 的两个副本上，通过副本 A 完成一个 Turn，然后在副本 B 上读取该 Session 的恢复状态和摘要。修改前：`operator_required` / `recovery_evidence_unavailable` / `nextTurnAllowed: false`。修改后：`ready` / `nextTurnAllowed: true`，并且同一副本上摘要与恢复接口一致。
- 让控制面自己让一个 Turn 失败，例如提交在到达 Harness 之前就失败。副本 B 仍然回答 `operator_required`，因为 SQL 写入的失败不是原生结清。
- 当后台 Runtime execution 或 hosted cleanup 债务仍未完成时，副本 B 不回答 `ready`。
- 停掉 Harness，对一个已持久结清的 Turn 执行 recheck：返回 `202` 且 `state: ready`，Harness 从未被要求加载该 Session。对一个终态由控制面写入的 Turn 执行 recheck：返回 `503 recovery_runtime_unavailable`（或 pool 自己带错误码的 503），并且日志中有一条带原始异常的 WARN。

恢复服务测试套件中新增的 16 条 H2 单元用例覆盖了上述每个分支，包括 owner 的 live evidence 优先于原生终态、缺少 wake 证明的已 seal head 保持非 ready、非终态或属于别的 Turn 的带 source key 行不能结清最新 Turn、读不到的 owner 状态不授予 readiness，以及类型化拒绝返回带错误码的 409。

### 证据（修改前后）

不适用：服务端状态，没有 UI 改动。

在 macOS、JDK 21、H2 上的本地结果：

- 恢复服务测试套件：60 条，0 失败（原有 55 条 + 评审轮新增 5 条），rebase 到最新 main 后重跑。四组变异探针各自恰好让新用例转红：去掉 decline catch、去掉缓存 attachment 闸门、去掉 `is_terminal = 1` 过滤、中和 `turn_id` 过滤。
- 恢复初始状态测试套件：38 条，0 失败，在 rebase 前运行。此后 main 改动了该套件用到的 schema 和 persistence 代码，所以 rebase 后版本的证据以 CI 的运行结果为准。
- Checkstyle：全部 14 个模块 0 违规。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

macOS 只覆盖了聚焦的 H2 测试套件。Linux 由 CI 运行。

### 环境（可选）

在 managed-agent-server 目录下运行聚焦的 Maven 测试。初始状态测试套件会加载本地构建的 core JavaScript。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：持久判断只检查最新 Turn，不重放 journal。"更新的原生终态之后不会残留更早的待结清输入"依赖 Harness 一次只运行一个 Turn、以及加载时遇到未结清输入会拒绝，并没有在 journal 层面证明。另外，有些非 ready 判定只在 owner Harness 内部计算（Turn 结束后的 file-history 工作、待处理的 file-history 撤销、未就绪的 continuation、扩展恢复、已停止的写入）。这些状态成立期间，owner 会报告它们，而非 owner 副本会回答 `ready`。两种情况下，该视图都只控制能否发送：下一次提交仍要经过 coordinator 与 Harness 自身的准入。两者都已作为残余问题列在设计文档中。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：上面的双副本手动验证尚未执行。新检查在真实 MySQL 上的执行计划，以及完整的 `mvn verify`、mysql-integration 和 Hosted profile 留给 CI。对没有 managed head 的已绑定 Session 的拒绝分支保持不变；该 head 在 Harness 首次获取 journal writer 时创建，而 Harness 写任何 journal 事件之前都必须先拿到 writer，所以带原生终态的 Turn 一定有这个 head。#17542 没有代码改动。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。recheck 接口在原来返回无错误码 500 或永久 409 的情况下，现在可能返回带错误码的 503；类型化终止拒绝返回 `409 hosted_turn_recovery_declined` 而不是可重试的 503。冷副本对持久已结清 Turn 的 recheck 直接返回 `ready`，不再尝试 owner-only 清理——为了"不加载 Session"的保证有意放弃该驱动能力，已作为接受的残余记录在设计 §9。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/fix/managed-recovery-settlement/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-recovery-native-terminal.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/fix/managed-recovery-settlement/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-recovery-native-terminal.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整且同步。

auto_merge.commit_message:
* fix(managed-agent): settle recovery from durable native terminals

A replica without the Session's Harness attachment read no live recovery
evidence and reported a completed Turn as operator_required, so the send
gate flipped per request behind a load balancer. When the latest Turn on a
live head carries the Harness's journaled terminal and no durable work is
owed, every replica now answers ready. Recheck returns that answer without
contacting a Harness, and a cleanup recheck that no Harness can serve fails
with a coded 503 instead of an uncoded error.

The externally terminated runtime loop (#17542) is analysed in the design
document and left for a follow-up.

Fixes #17538
Fixes #17543

* fix(managed-agent): guard durable recovery readiness and map terminal declines

Review round on #17886 (chiga0 withdrawal, bot R1-1..R1-6), each finding
verified against the head before fixing:

- R1-2: a typed HostedHarnessRecoveryDeclinedException is terminal, so map
  it to 409 hosted_turn_recovery_declined with the decline as cause instead
  of the retriable 503 that invited clients to retry a permanent refusal.
- R1-1: the durable-native-terminal arm also requires no cached recovery
  attachment, so a failed or foreign-prompt status read on the owning
  replica keeps the conservative arms: unreadable evidence is not no
  evidence.
- R1-4: pin the is_terminal and turn_id filters with two negative cases;
  the two previously surviving mutations now each kill exactly one case.
- R1-5: name recovery_runtime_unavailable and hosted_turn_recovery_declined
  in both recheck descriptions (description-only OpenAPI change, 1.123.0)
  and regenerate the Web Shell types.
- R1-6: accept and document in design section 9 that a cold recheck of a
  durably settled Turn no longer drives owner-only cleanup; the no-load
  guarantee wins, cleanup keeps its owner-side and durable-debt drivers.
- R1-3: record the agreed EXISTS scan-order rewrite as owed to the section
  7 real-MySQL plan check, in both design languages.

Focused SessionRecoveryServiceTest 60/60 (JDK 21, H2); four mutation probes
killed (decline catch, cache guard, both SQL filters); dual Checkstyle and
the four contract gate suites green. Real-MySQL plan and two-replica stack
remain owed to CI.

prs.title: feat(core): copy .worktreeinclude paths into new worktrees
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds support for a repository-level `.worktreeinclude` file: a committed, gitignore-syntax list of ignored paths that are copied from your main checkout into every worktree the CLI creates.

A `git worktree add` checkout contains only tracked files, so gitignored local state — `.env`, `appsettings.Development.json`, local certificates — is absent. This PR reads `.worktreeinclude` at the repository root (one pattern per line, `#` comments, blank lines skipped), matches those patterns against git's own ignored set, and copies the matches into the new checkout while preserving directory structure.

Patterns are only ever matched against `git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard`, never expanded from disk. That keeps tracked files, `.git` internals and paths outside the repository unreachable by construction: the worst a committed pattern can do is select a file git already lists as ignored. The listing is recursive, so a pattern naming a fully-ignored directory selects the files inside it rather than a directory entry that can't be copied.

The copy runs on both creation paths — `createUserWorktree` (the `--worktree` flag, the `enter_worktree` tool, and `agent` worktree isolation) and `setupWorktrees` (Agent Arena) — so one committed file covers every worktree family. It is non-fatal throughout: a missing or unreadable file, an oversized one, or an individual copy failure leaves the worktree usable without those files. The file is capped at 1 MB and 10,000 patterns because it is committed input that anyone with push access can change, and each pattern costs time against every ignored file.

## Why it's needed

Agents working in a worktree routinely need local, never-committed files — an API key in `.env`, a machine-specific dev config — and today every new worktree requires manual setup or a custom provisioning script. Running several isolated agents in parallel multiplies that cost. This is the last unimplemented item from the worktree design's advanced list (the `.worktreeinclude` row in `docs/design/worktree.md`), and it is tracked as #10584.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

In a scratch repository that ignores `.env` and `.local/`:

1. Create `.env`, `.local/top.txt` and `.local/sub/deep.txt` in the main checkout, plus a `.worktreeinclude` containing `.env` and `.local/`.
2. Create a worktree (`qwen --worktree=one`, or `createUserWorktree('one', 'main')` directly).
3. The new checkout contains all three files with the source contents; a gitignored path not named in the file (try `secrets/*.json`) is absent.
4. Delete `.worktreeinclude` and create another worktree: nothing is copied and the worktree still succeeds.

The new integration test file pins those four outcomes plus a negation (`!config/example.json`), a tracked file named by a pattern (not copied twice / not selected at all), the size cap, and a `.worktreeinclude` that is a directory.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `packages/core/src/services/gitWorktreeService.ts` copied only untracked files in `setupWorktrees`; `createUserWorktree` copied nothing. After: both paths copy the resolved `.worktreeinclude` set.

```
$ cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/services/gitWorktreeService.worktreeinclude.integ.test.ts \
    src/services/gitWorktreeService.test.ts src/services/gitWorktreeService.symlinks.integ.test.ts
 ✓ ... (13 tests) / (41 tests) / (15 tests)
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  69 passed (69)
```

`npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json` and `npx eslint` on the touched files pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS only. Windows and Linux not run locally; the copy path is plain `fs` with repository-relative paths from git, and CI covers the rest.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit and integration tests only (real `git` against temp repos).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a committed `.worktreeinclude` lets anyone with push access decide which ignored files a clone copies into its worktrees. The blast radius is bounded to gitignored files that already exist in the source checkout, but a pattern reaching a large ignored tree (a build cache) would copy it per worktree with no size limit. That tradeoff is documented in the user docs' Limitations section.
- Not validated / out of scope: symlinks among the ignored files are copied as whatever `fs.copyFile` does with them (the link target's contents), not recreated as links. Worktrees created before a line is added do not retroactively receive the file.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Without a `.worktreeinclude`, behaviour is unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #10584

prs.title: test(integration): deflake the export document budget on all CI runners (#17884)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the maximum transcript-document browser gate's wall-clock budget actually scale on CI, so the perf assertion stops failing under runner load. The budget now widens on the marker every runner provides instead of one that the lanes running this gate never set. The gate's own assertions, inputs, and measured window are untouched — the test file is byte-identical to its previous state.

## Why it's needed

CI Failure Patrol flagged the maximum-document case as flaky after it rendered in 64.5s against a 60s ceiling and then passed on rerun of the same commit, with unrelated core changes in the PR. An earlier deflake round had already added a 3x multiplier for exactly this contention, but it keyed on the runner-environment marker, and neither lane that runs this gate maps that marker into the step — the PR-gated smoke step sets only a temp directory, and the nightly browser-regression step sets no environment at all. The one lane that does map the marker explicitly excludes this test file. The widened tier was therefore unreachable in CI, which is why the overruns kept recurring after that earlier fix: 73s, 68.4s, 60.9s, and now 64.5s all still landed on the tight ceiling.

Scaling on the CI marker instead matches the interactive harness this budget already cites as its precedent, and it works on both the shared ARM64 pool and hosted runners without depending on any lane's environment mapping. Local runs keep the tight ceiling so a genuine regression still fails fast on a dev machine.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the always-on budget witness, which is the repository's designated fast surrogate for this gate: `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts document-export-budget`. Expect 5 passed. To confirm the witness really pins the fix, set the CI multiplier to 1 in the budget helper and re-run: the widened-ceiling case must fail with `expected 60000 to be 180000`. Restore it to 3 and re-run to green.

To see the defect this PR removes, check out the parent commit and run the same suite with the new witness: the gate lane's real environment shape (CI set, runner-environment marker absent) resolves to only 60s, which is what let a 64.5s render fail.

Confirm the ceiling arithmetic still holds: the widened budget plus its 30s per-case slack is 210s, under the integration suite's 300s test timeout, so a wedged run still reports the budget assertion rather than a bare timeout. Confirm local runs are unaffected — with CI unset the budget stays 60s.

The browser gate itself could not be executed in this sandbox: Chromium installs, but the image ships no GUI libraries and the session is non-root with no apt lists, so every browser case dies at launch on a missing `libglib-2.0.so.0` before any assertion runs. That result is identical before and after this change. The workflow's CI is the final gate for the browser run.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible or TUI change. Budget resolution before → after: CI with the runner marker unmapped went from 60000 ms to 180000 ms; local runs unchanged at 60000 ms.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.2 on Linux x64. Unit-level verification only; the Playwright browser gate is blocked by missing system libraries in this sandbox. Cache and browser paths were redirected to a writable temp directory because the session home is read-only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: hosted CI now shares the widened 180s ceiling that previously only the self-hosted pool was meant to get, so a perf regression between 60s and 180s no longer fails in CI. The tight 60s ceiling is retained for local runs, every other assertion in the gate (content, CSP, network, heap, PDF) is unchanged, and the interactive harness already accepts this same tradeoff for all CI. The alternative — mapping the runner marker into the CI step — would touch CI machinery and would still leave hosted runners on the tight ceiling that may have produced this very flake.
- Not validated / out of scope: the browser gate could not be run end-to-end here (no GUI libraries, no root); no CI workflow, production source, or dependency was modified. Whether the gate should keep a separate tighter tier for hosted runners is a policy question left as-is rather than redesigned.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Two test-side files changed, net +34/−19 lines. Two existing witness case titles were renamed and their tier expectations corrected to the new decision; no assertion was removed, skipped, or loosened, and the assertion count increased by one.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17884

prs.title: docs(managed-agent): design Runtime-owned background observation (Phase 3b)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This adds the separate Phase 3b design that the [Phase 3 control-plane wake design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-control-plane-wake.md) (#17805) calls for: letting a Hosted Session whose only live work is a background Shell or Monitor suspend while its processes keep running. English and Chinese versions are added side by side, and the parent design links to them in both languages.

The design starts from a finding that changes the parent's plan. The background output capture, including the running SHA-256 that every manifest revision carries, lives only in Harness memory, and publishing Session resources needs the live writer. So no later process can continue an open capture, and the parent's idea of re-opening the direct publisher on wake cannot work. The design therefore moves the background capture and the Monitor policy (line splitting, debounce, idle timeout, event quota) into the worker, whose lifetime covers the whole stream and whose replacement already caps the capture under the existing background-work design.

The worker turns everything that must become durable into numbered delivery entries, one ordered stream per background run. While a Harness is resident, the worker pushes the entries to it and the Harness applies them through its writer. While the Session is suspended, the Broker pulls the entries over the existing lease-fenced Runtime transport and stores them in a staging ledger, with the bytes kept as Session resources. A staged Monitor observation or process exit wakes the Session through the existing backstop scan, and a staged exit also settles its execution row, so a quiet exit releases its hold without loading the Session. On load the Harness re-attaches first, learns from the worker how far staging reaches, drains staging up to that point, and then accepts pushes after it.

The suspension seal, extended from the 3a stamp, also certifies that the remaining unsettled work is verified background holds, so the recovery view and the cleanup retry can tell them apart from owed work. Suspension releases only probe the holds and keep the mount instead of draining. Parked-MCP reclamation checks for background work before it disconnects anything, which corrects an ordering that would otherwise disconnect MCP servers for nothing.

Compared with the parent, the design withdraws the durable binding-scoped staging authorization, since the Broker pulls under the lease it already holds, and replaces the three-party freeze and the separate received/durable byte positions with the single delivery sequence. It answers the parent's open questions 4–10 and proposes four implementation slices.

## Why it's needed

Background Shells and Monitors pin a Hosted Session today: suspension refuses them, and every close path stops them. Long-running background work therefore keeps a Harness slot for its whole life, which is the residency Phase 3 sets out to remove. The parent design left 3b as a boundary to be finalized in its own design; this is that design, grounded in the code as it stands so implementation can start from settled decisions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- The design's code claims hold at `main` `e108e089bd`, especially §1.1 (the capture's running digest is in Harness memory and resource publication needs the writer), §1.3 (the suspension terms and both teardown drains), and §1.4 (only the Broker calls the worker, and background settlement is operation-triggered).
- The delivery protocol leaves no gap and delivers nothing twice across a Harness restart, a pull in flight during re-attach, and a crash between commit and staging deletion (§4.3–§4.6).
- The seal certificate is sound by the same argument as 3a: written by the writer that ran the per-run check, at the exact revision, and cleared by any acquisition (§4.8).
- The withdrawals and replacements in §12 match the parent design's §4.4–§4.6 and §10.
- Both language versions are complete and aligned: section structure, decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and open questions.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (design document only).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A. Prettier passes on the four changed files, every relative design link resolves, and the two language versions have matching heading levels, list items, numbered items and table rows.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: moving the background capture into the worker is the largest change and must be byte-for-byte equivalent to today's capture; the design requires characterization tests before the move. While a Session is suspended the Broker pull is the only path for output, so a Broker outage stalls background processes through pipe backpressure rather than losing output.
- Not validated / out of scope: this PR changes no code. The constants (pull wait, staged-bytes watermark, hard cap, outbox budgets, segment size) are left to the §7 measurement. A maintenance writer, a public read path for staged output, external storage and cross-boot attach are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none in this PR. The proposed implementation adds a staging table and a resource owner kind to the V1 baseline in place, under the current schema policy.

## Linked Issues

Follows #17805 (Phase 3 design) and builds on #17869 (seal-time wake stamp addendum) and its implementation #17908.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 新增 [Phase 3 控制面唤醒设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-control-plane-wake.zh-CN.md)（#17805）要求的独立 Phase 3b 设计：让仅剩后台 Shell 或 Monitor 作为活跃工作的 Hosted Session 可以挂起，同时进程继续运行。中英文两个版本一起新增，父设计也在中英文两版里加上了指向它们的链接。

这份设计从一个改变父设计方案的发现出发。后台输出的捕获，包括每个 manifest 修订都要携带的增量 SHA-256，只存在于 Harness 的内存里，而发布 Session 资源需要活着的 writer。所以之后的任何进程都无法续写一个打开的捕获，父设计"唤醒时重新打开直连 publisher"的想法行不通。因此本设计把后台捕获和 Monitor 策略（切分行、防抖、空闲超时、事件配额）搬到 worker 里：worker 的寿命覆盖整条流，而且按现有的后台工作设计，worker 被替换时本来就会把捕获封顶。

worker 把所有需要持久化的内容变成带编号的投递条目，每个后台 run 一条有序的流。Harness 常驻时，worker 把条目推给它，Harness 通过自己的 writer 应用这些条目。Session 挂起时，Broker 通过现有的、受租约隔离的 Runtime 传输通道拉取这些条目，存入暂存账本，字节以 Session 资源的形式保存。暂存的 Monitor 观测或进程退出会通过现有的兜底扫描唤醒 Session；暂存的退出还会结算对应的执行行，所以悄悄退出的进程不用加载 Session 就能释放持有。加载时，Harness 先重新挂接，从 worker 得知暂存覆盖到哪里，把暂存排空到那个位置，然后再接受之后的推送。

从 3a 的戳扩展而来的挂起 seal，还会证明剩下的未结算工作是经核实的后台持有，这样 recovery view 和清理重试就能把它们与欠下的工作区分开。挂起时的释放只探测持有并保留挂载，不再排空。停放 MCP 的回收会在断开任何东西之前先检查后台工作，纠正了一个否则会白白断开 MCP 服务器的顺序问题。

与父设计相比，本设计撤销了持久的绑定级暂存授权，因为 Broker 是在它已持有的租约下拉取；并用单一的投递序号取代了三方冻结和单独的已接收/已持久化字节位置。它回答了父设计的开放问题第 4–10 项，并提出四个实现切片。

## 为什么需要

今天后台 Shell 和 Monitor 会把 Hosted Session 钉住：挂起会拒绝它们，所有关闭路径都会停止它们。因此长时间运行的后台工作会在整个生命周期里占用一个 Harness 槽位，而这正是 Phase 3 要消除的常驻。父设计把 3b 留作一个需要在独立设计中定案的边界；本文就是那份设计，它以当前代码为依据，好让实现从已经定下的决定出发。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 设计中关于代码的论断在 `main` 的 `e108e089bd` 上成立，尤其是 §1.1（捕获的增量摘要在 Harness 内存里，资源发布需要 writer）、§1.3（挂起条件和两条拆除排空路径）以及 §1.4（只有 Broker 调用 worker，后台结算由操作触发）。
- 在 Harness 重启、重新挂接时有拉取正在进行、以及提交与删除暂存之间崩溃这几种情况下，投递协议都不留缺口，也不重复投递（§4.3–§4.6）。
- seal 证明的可靠性与 3a 的论证相同：由执行过逐 run 检查的 writer 在精确的 revision 上写入，任何一次获取都会清除它（§4.8）。
- §12 中的撤销和取代与父设计的 §4.4–§4.6 和 §10 一一对应。
- 两个语言版本完整且一致：章节结构、决定、约束、验收标准和开放问题都对得上。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用（仅设计文档）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  | 不适用 |
| 🪟 Windows | 不适用 |
|  🐧 Linux  | 不适用 |

### 环境（可选）

不适用。四个改动文件都通过 Prettier 检查，所有相对设计链接都能解析，两个语言版本的标题层级、列表项、编号项和表格行数一致。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：把后台捕获搬进 worker 是最大的改动，必须与今天的捕获逐字节等价；设计要求在迁移前先写特征测试。Session 挂起期间，Broker 拉取是输出的唯一路径，所以 Broker 宕机会通过管道背压让后台进程停顿，而不会丢失输出。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：本 PR 不改代码。各项常量（拉取等待时间、暂存字节水位、硬上限、outbox 预算、分段大小）留给 §7 的测量决定。维护 writer、暂存输出的公开读取路径、外部存储和跨启动挂接不在范围内。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：本 PR 没有。拟议的实现会按现行 schema 策略，在 V1 基线上原地新增一张暂存表和一种资源 owner 类型。

## 关联 Issue

承接 #17805（Phase 3 设计），建立在 #17869（seal 时唤醒戳补充设计）及其实现 #17908 之上。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): wire external foreground Shell into Broker and Control Plane [17357 B/2]
prs.body:
Split from #17357 at source commit `510dc8a1d994331868f71ebb175bf4ebcb8e7219`; candidate B: `5f746c523b309`. This is **[17357 B/2]** — the Runtime Broker dispatch/cancel/reconcile/close fences and Control Plane profile negotiation for the external foreground-Shell lane, stacked on #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**) (`split/16023-resident-workspace`) and #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) (`split/17357-worker-and-producer`).

## What this PR does

Wires the external foreground-Shell profile (`hosted-workspace-external-shell/1`) through the Control Plane, External Workspace Provisioner, and Runtime Broker:
- **Broker move-before-settle fences**: extracts `RuntimeExecutionExternalShell`, `RuntimeDispatchPayloadAdmission`, and `RuntimeToolAcknowledgements` from `RuntimeBrokerService` and `RuntimeExecutionDispatcher` (lowering `RuntimeBrokerService` from 2028 to 2006). Before dispatching a foreground Shell on an external worker, the Broker opens the worker's capture channel; after the worker finishes, the Broker moves the captured bytes into the control plane's publication via `ExternalShellPublication` and rebuilds the result envelope before settling the execution row.
- **Cancel, reconcile, and close drain proofs**: prevents a worker's raw settled status from settling an un-moved external Shell record on the cancel or reconcile paths, while allowing a proven `not_started` receipt or an already-finished publication to settle cleanly. Session close and Workspace drain require the worker's drained-stop proof and refuse to release storage while an external Shell execution is unsettled.
- **Control Plane & Provisioner negotiation**: gates `hosted-workspace-external-shell/1` behind `qwen.managed-agent.harness.external-workspace-shell-enabled` (default `false`), requires durable tool publication and `default` or `auto-edit` approval mode, pins handle version 2 on `ExternalWorkspaceProvisioner`, and verifies worker publication readiness during placement establishment/reconcile without adding an extra HTTP exchange to every live dispatch confirm.

## Why it's needed

Even with the worker capture routes and producer store from #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**), the Broker and Control Plane must guarantee that a worker's local completion never settles the execution record or releases storage before the captured bytes have been durably published in the control plane. Splitting these 53 Broker/Control-Plane files (+2,782/−468) from the 31 worker/producer files in A/2 isolates the state-machine and lifecycle fences for focused review.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the Broker dispatch lane, drain proof, close recovery, and profile unit tests from `packages/managed-agent-server` on JDK 21:

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest,ExternalShellDrainProofTest,ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest,WorkspaceToolProfilesTest,ClassSizeRatchetTest
```

And against disposable MySQL 8.4:

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -Pmysql-integration -pl verification -am verify \
  -Dit.test=ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT \
  -Dmysql.url="jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false" \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=<password>
```

Expected:
- `ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest` (9 tests), `ExternalShellDrainProofTest` (6 tests), `ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest` (6 tests on H2), and `ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT` (6 tests on MySQL 8.4) all pass.
- Requesting `toolProfile` without a bound Workspace returns `400 invalid_tool_profile`, and replaying a recorded Session creation succeeds before the live 409 capability check.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI — backend Broker and Control Plane wiring with generated OpenAPI client types.

```text
ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest        Tests run: 9, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellDrainProofTest          Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest       Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0   (H2)
ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT    Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0   (MySQL 8.4.11)
WorkspaceToolProfilesTest            Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
mvn -o test-compile                  BUILD SUCCESS (all 15 reactor modules)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local JDK 21 (`openjdk@21`) and disposable MySQL 8.4.11 on macOS.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the Broker sits on the byte-moving critical path before settling any external foreground Shell execution, so an unreachable or unacknowledged worker capture keeps the execution recoverable (`UNKNOWN`) and blocks Session close rather than losing output.
- Not validated / out of scope: worker capture routes and `ExternalShellPublicationProducer` implementation details are covered in #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**). Background Shell and `monitor` remain out of scope for external workers.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for existing placements. `qwen.managed-agent.harness.external-workspace-shell-enabled` defaults to `false`.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-broker-and-control-plane/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-broker-and-control-plane/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #15512 (phase 2, slice C). Split from #17357 (`[17357 B/2]`).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

自 #17357 的源码提交 `510dc8a1d994331868f71ebb175bf4ebcb8e7219` 拆分而来；候选提交 B 为 `5f746c523b309`。本 PR 是 **[17357 B/2]** —— 包含外部前台 Shell 通道在 Runtime Broker 的派发/取消/对账/关闭围栏以及控制面 profile 协商，堆叠在 #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**)（`split/16023-resident-workspace`）与 #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**)（`split/17357-worker-and-producer`）之上。

## 这个 PR 做了什么

将外部前台 Shell profile（`hosted-workspace-external-shell/1`）贯通至控制面、External Workspace Provisioner 与 Runtime Broker：
- **Broker「先搬运后结算」围栏**：从 `RuntimeBrokerService` 与 `RuntimeExecutionDispatcher` 中抽离 `RuntimeExecutionExternalShell`、`RuntimeDispatchPayloadAdmission` 和 `RuntimeToolAcknowledgements`（将 `RuntimeBrokerService` 从 2028 行降至 2006 行）。在向外部 worker 派发前台 Shell 前，Broker 先打开 worker 的 capture 通道；待 worker 执行结束后，Broker 通过 `ExternalShellPublication` 将捕获字节搬入控制面 publication 并重建结果信封，随后才结算执行记录。
- **取消、对账与关闭排空证明**：防止取消或对账路径仅凭 worker 返回的 settled 状态直接结算尚未完成搬运的外部 Shell 记录，同时允许已证实的 `not_started` 回执或已完成搬运的 publication 正常结算。Session 关闭与 Workspace 排空要求校验 worker 的 drained-stop 证明，在外部 Shell 执行未结算前拒绝释放存储。
- **控制面与 Provisioner 协商**：将 `hosted-workspace-external-shell/1` 置于独立开关 `qwen.managed-agent.harness.external-workspace-shell-enabled`（默认 `false`）之后，强制要求启用持久化 tool publication 以及 `default` 或 `auto-edit` 审批模式；在 `ExternalWorkspaceProvisioner` 上使用独立的 handle 版本 2，并在建立或对账 placement 时校验 worker 的 publication 就绪状态（日常存活确认不增加额外 HTTP 往返）。

## 为什么需要它

在 #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) 提供了 worker 捕获路由与 producer 存储的基础上，Broker 与控制面还必须确保：绝不能在捕获字节持久化到控制面之前仅凭 worker 的本地完成状态就结算记录或释放存储。将这 53 个 Broker/控制面文件（+2,782/−468）从 A/2 的 31 个 worker/producer 文件中拆出，便于集中评审状态机与生命周期围栏。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 JDK 21 下从 `packages/managed-agent-server` 运行 Broker 派发通道、排空证明、关闭恢复与 profile 单元测试：

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest,ExternalShellDrainProofTest,ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest,WorkspaceToolProfilesTest,ClassSizeRatchetTest
```

以及基于 MySQL 8.4 的集成验证：

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -Pmysql-integration -pl verification -am verify \
  -Dit.test=ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT \
  -Dmysql.url="jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false" \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=<password>
```

预期行为：
- `ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest`（9 个用例）、`ExternalShellDrainProofTest`（6 个用例）、`ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest`（H2 6 个用例）与 `ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT`（MySQL 8.4 6 个用例）全部通过。
- 未绑定 Workspace 时请求 `toolProfile` 返回 `400 invalid_tool_profile`，且已记录的 Session 创建幂等重放在实时 409 能力检查前直接返回。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

N/A（无 UI 变更 —— 纯后端 Broker 与控制面编排及自动生成的 OpenAPI 类型）。

```text
ExternalShellDispatchLaneTest        Tests run: 9, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellDrainProofTest          Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellCloseRecoveryTest       Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0   (H2)
ExternalShellCloseRecoveryMySqlIT    Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0   (MySQL 8.4.11)
WorkspaceToolProfilesTest            Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
mvn -o test-compile                  BUILD SUCCESS (全部 15 个模块通过)
```

### 测试平台

|   操作系统   | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--: |
|   🍏 macOS   |  ✅  |
|  🪟 Windows  |  ⚠️  |
|   🐧 Linux   |  ⚠️  |

### 环境说明（可选）

macOS 本地 JDK 21（`openjdk@21`）与临时 MySQL 8.4.11。

## 风险与影响范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Broker 位于每次外部前台 Shell 结算前的字节搬运关键路径上；若 worker 捕获通道不可达或未完成确认，记录将保持可恢复的 `UNKNOWN` 状态并阻止关闭 Session，而不会丢失输出。
- 未验证 / 范围外：worker 捕获路由与 `ExternalShellPublicationProducer` 的实现细节由 #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) 覆盖；后台 Shell 与 `monitor` 仍不在外部 worker 支持范围内。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对存量 placement 无影响。`qwen.managed-agent.harness.external-workspace-shell-enabled` 默认为 `false`。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-broker-and-control-plane/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-broker-and-control-plane/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

属于 #15512（phase 2, slice C）。拆自 #17357（`[17357 B/2]`）。

prs.title: fix(core): bound JSONL tail diagnostic recovery and cache churn
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Resolves items 1–3 of the follow-up tracker for the merged JSONL append-integrity fix, and leaves item 4 (native Windows and current-head macOS validation) explicitly open.

Three behaviors change, all confined to the diagnostic path that reports an uninspectable file tail. A debug sink that failed three consecutive warning deliveries for one file no longer stays silent forever after it is repaired: the spent budget now admits exactly one probe per sixty-second cooldown window, and the attempt counter is never reset, so a permanently broken sink cannot turn into a retry loop. The bounded diagnostic cache no longer discards a suppression in order to admit a new path: only a slot whose delivery already failed is reclaimable, and when no such slot exists the new path is simply not diagnosed while its append proceeds unchanged. And a fatal tail-inspection failure now names the file it failed on, including the recovery path that runs after a missing-file stat, without changing the error's identity, code, stack, or append outcome.

The change also adds focused witnesses for the explicit writer lifecycle, the FIFO writer-handle target, a replaced in-flight delivery, and a failed debug append combined with a throwing delivery observer.

## Why it's needed

Both behavioral gaps were independently reproduced against unmodified main before any code was written, rather than taken from the tracker's framing. The tracker quoted a cache-churn example of 140 paths and 280 appends producing 280 warnings and explicitly flagged it as an unconfirmed lead; a source-level probe confirmed exactly that count. The same probe confirmed that repairing a blocked debug sink, and proving it healthy with a marker write, still produced zero warnings for a key whose three-attempt budget was spent.

The churn matters because the eviction rule was discarding the very state that suppresses duplicate warnings, so a long sequence of distinct paths re-warned on every pass. The silence matters because an operator who fixes the underlying sink loses the diagnostic precisely when it would start working again. Neither is a regression in the append correctness fix — existing bytes were preserved in every scenario — but both make the diagnostic unreliable in exactly the situations it exists for.

The file-context gap is narrower but real: descriptor-based syscalls do not carry the pathname that Node attaches to path-based errors, so a fatal failure reached callers without saying which file failed, and the recovery branch inside the catch escaped annotation entirely.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the two focused suites from the core package and confirm 171 passing tests, including the cooldown, eviction-policy, writer-lifecycle, FIFO-target, and error-context cases for both the async and sync appenders. Then confirm the two policy claims behaviorally rather than by reading the code: drive a long sequence of distinct uninspectable paths and check that the warning count stops at the cache bound instead of growing with every pass, and drive a blocked-then-repaired debug sink and check that a previously exhausted key delivers exactly one warning after the cooldown window and not before it.

For the error-context claim, force a descriptor-based stat failure on a missing path and confirm the propagated error names the file while keeping its original code and object identity, and that the writer descriptor is still closed.

Each guard is paired with a mutation that was actually executed and restored: removing the cooldown gate, restoring unconditional oldest-key eviction, never evicting, resetting the attempt counter after the cap, dropping the error annotation, annotating unconditionally, removing the recovery-branch annotation in either appender, and reordering the degraded flag after the delivery observer. Every one of those reddens a named case. One mutation deliberately survives and is documented: deleting the stale-completion guard line alone changes nothing observable, because the delivery callback closes over its own entry object; the witness instead pins the isolation property, and the mutation that writes to whatever the cache holds now does redden it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible or TUI surface changes. The observable outputs are debug-log warning counts, propagated error text, and file bytes, all reported below.

Measured on Linux x86-64, Node v26.12.1, at main `1176e39bbc` before the change and at this branch after it:

| Scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 140 distinct torn paths, 280 appends, healthy sink | 280 warnings | 128 warnings |
| Blocked sink, 6 appends, sink repaired and proven healthy, 4 more appends | 0 warnings | 0 warnings inside the cooldown window |
| Same, after a real 61-second wait and 2 more appends | 0 warnings | 1 warning |
| Bundled CLI, write-only torn usage file, 3 API rounds | — | 3 records appended, exactly 1 tail warning, torn bytes preserved |
| Bundled CLI, same file, debug file logging disabled | — | no debug file created, identical byte shape |
| Bundled CLI, readable newline-terminated file | — | no warning, no extra separator |

All twelve records in the outage scenario kept their conservative separators; no scenario lost or rewrote existing bytes. Native FIFO evidence at the final head: both appenders match the same platform's native append outcome (`fsync` → `EINVAL` on Linux) and preserve the 14-byte payload exactly. This is Linux-only evidence and is not generalized to other platforms.

Focused suites: 150 passing before, 171 after. Root build, typecheck and bundle each exited 0; Prettier and ESLint are clean on every changed file. A ten-dimension code review returned two valid Suggestions, both fixed and both given a mutation witness that reddens without the fix.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment

Linux x86-64, Node v26.12.1, non-root. Focused suites and source-level probes ran against TypeScript source; the CLI group ran against the bundled artifact with an isolated home and runtime directory and a local mock OpenAI server as the only network peer. No real model access occurred.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: once the cache holds 128 suppressions, a genuinely new uninspectable path is not diagnosed until some slot's delivery fails. This is only reachable when at least 128 distinct files have unreadable tails, which is already pathological, and the append itself is unaffected. The alternative — evicting a delivered or in-flight suppression — is what produced the confirmed 280-warning churn. A first attempt that protected only delivered suppressions was measured to be insufficient: a synchronous burst evicted in-flight entries and still produced 129 warnings for 129 paths, so the rule protects both.
- Not validated / out of scope: native Windows sharing violations and current-head macOS behavior (item 4 of the tracker) — no such host was used, and the earlier macOS evidence predates the writer-handle lifecycle, so it is not reused. The earlier platform evidence is not presented as certification. In the review's build-and-test lane, two unrelated suites were red and attributed rather than hidden: a machine-dependent memory recall latency case in a file this change does not touch, and web-shell's localStorage failures caused by Node 26's native placeholder shadowing jsdom. The CLI package's related-test lane timed out at its full allowance and has no conclusion. The expanded repository-wide suite was not run.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No public API, config key, CLI flag, or on-disk record format changes. One previously asserted behavior is intentionally replaced: a path evicted from a full diagnostic cache used to warn again, and now does not. The case encoding the old expectation was replaced with exact counts under the new policy, not weakened, and a separate case keeps eviction of failed-delivery slots observable. Fatal tail-inspection error messages gain a ` (file: …)` suffix; the original message stays a verbatim prefix and the error object, code and stack are unchanged.

Design document: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/17852-jsonl-tail-diagnostics/docs/design/jsonl-tail-diagnostics-17852.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/17852-jsonl-tail-diagnostics/docs/design/jsonl-tail-diagnostics-17852.zh-CN.md) — both complete and synchronized, including the measured caveat about the redundant guard and the deferred native-platform scope.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17852 — resolves items 1, 2 and 3; item 4 (native Windows and current-head macOS validation) remains open and is not claimed here.
Refs #17771 — the merged parent whose deferred work this is.
Refs #17853 — the post-merge verification ledger that recorded these deferrals.

Reader-side salvage of already-damaged history stays independent work in #17756.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

解决已合入的 JSONL 追加完整性修复的跟踪 issue 中的事项 1–3，并明确保留事项 4（Windows 原生与当前 head 的 macOS 验证）为未解决。

三处行为变化，全部限于报告「文件尾部无法检查」的诊断路径。某个文件的 debug sink 连续三次告警投递失败后，不再在修好之后永久沉默：用尽的预算现在每六十秒冷却窗口只放行一次探测，且尝试计数器永不清零，因此永久损坏的 sink 不会变成重试循环。有界诊断缓存不再为了接纳新路径而丢弃抑制状态：只有投递已失败的槽位可被回收，不存在这样的槽位时，新路径只是不被诊断，其追加照常进行。致命的尾部检查失败现在会指出它失败于哪个文件，包括缺失文件 stat 之后运行的恢复路径，同时不改变错误的身份、code、stack 与追加结果。

改动还为显式 writer 生命周期、FIFO writer 句柄目标、被替换的在飞投递，以及真实 debug append 失败叠加 delivery observer 抛错补充了聚焦见证。

## 为什么需要

两个行为缺口都在写任何代码之前，针对未修改的 main 独立复现，而不是照搬跟踪 issue 的说法。issue 引用了「140 个路径、280 次追加产生 280 条告警」的缓存更替例子，并明确标注为未确认线索；源码级探针确认了恰好这个计数。同一探针也确认了：修复被阻塞的 debug sink、并用一次 marker 写入证明它健康之后，三次预算已用尽的键仍然产生零条告警。

更替之所以重要，是因为驱逐规则丢弃的正是抑制重复告警的状态，于是一长串不同路径每轮都重新告警。沉默之所以重要，是因为修好底层 sink 的操作者，恰好在诊断本该重新可用时失去了它。两者都不是追加正确性修复的回归——每个场景都保留了既有字节——但两者都让诊断恰好在它存在的意义所在的场景里不可靠。

文件上下文缺口更窄但真实：基于描述符的系统调用不带 Node 附加给路径名错误的 pathname，因此致命失败到达调用方时不说是哪个文件失败了，而 catch 内部的恢复分支更是完全绕过了标注。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在 core 包下跑两个聚焦套件，确认 171 个用例通过，包含异步与同步两个 appender 的冷却、驱逐策略、writer 生命周期、FIFO 目标与错误上下文用例。然后用行为而非读代码来确认两条策略声明：驱动一长串不同的无法检查路径，确认告警数停在缓存上限而不是随每轮增长；驱动一个先阻塞后修复的 debug sink，确认此前耗尽的键在冷却窗口之后恰好投递一条告警、窗口之前不投递。

对错误上下文声明，在缺失路径上强制一次基于描述符的 stat 失败，确认传播的错误指出文件名、同时保留原始 code 与对象身份，且 writer 描述符仍被关闭。

每个守卫都配了一次真实执行并还原的变异：移除冷却门、恢复无条件最旧键驱逐、完全不驱逐、达到上限后重置计数器、去掉错误标注、无条件标注、去掉任一 appender 恢复分支的标注、把 degraded 标志排到 delivery observer 之后。每一条都会让一个具名用例转红。有一条变异有意存活并已记录：单独删除过期完成守卫那行不改变任何可观察行为，因为投递回调闭包捕获的是它自己的 entry 对象；见证钉住的是隔离性质，而「写缓存当前持有的对象」那个变异确实会让它转红。

### 证据（前后对照）

N/A —— 无用户可见或 TUI 面变化。可观察输出是 debug 日志告警数、传播的错误文本与文件字节，均在下表报告。

测量环境为 Linux x86-64、Node v26.12.1，改动前在 main `1176e39bbc`、改动后在本分支：

| 场景 | 改动前 | 改动后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 140 个不同残缺路径、280 次追加、健康 sink | 280 条告警 | 128 条告警 |
| 阻塞 sink、6 次追加、修复并证明健康、再 4 次追加 | 0 条告警 | 冷却窗口内 0 条告警 |
| 同上，真实等待 61 秒后再 2 次追加 | 0 条告警 | 1 条告警 |
| 打包 CLI、只写残缺 usage 文件、3 轮 API | — | 追加 3 条记录、恰好 1 条尾部告警、残缺字节保留 |
| 打包 CLI、同一文件、关闭 debug 文件日志 | — | 不创建 debug 文件、字节形状一致 |
| 打包 CLI、可读且换行结尾的文件 | — | 无告警、无多余分隔符 |

故障场景的全部 12 条记录都保留了保守分隔符；没有任何场景丢失或改写既有字节。最终 head 的原生 FIFO 证据：两个 appender 都与同平台原生追加结果一致（Linux 上 `fsync` → `EINVAL`），并精确保留 14 字节 payload。这是仅 Linux 的证据，不推广到其他平台。

聚焦套件：改动前 150 通过，改动后 171 通过。根 build、typecheck、bundle 均 exit 0；Prettier 与 ESLint 在每个改动文件上干净。十维度代码评审返回两条有效 Suggestion，均已修复，且各配了一个去掉修复就转红的变异见证。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境

Linux x86-64、Node v26.12.1、非 root。聚焦套件与源码级探针针对 TypeScript 源码运行；CLI 组针对打包产物运行，使用隔离的 home 与 runtime 目录，唯一网络对端是本地 mock OpenAI 服务。未发生真实模型访问。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：一旦缓存持有 128 条抑制，真正新出现的无法检查路径在某个槽位投递失败之前不会被诊断。只有至少 128 个不同文件尾部不可读时才可能到达，这本身已是病态场景，且追加本身不受影响。替代方案——驱逐已投递或在飞的抑制——正是产生已确认的 280 条告警更替的原因。只保护已投递抑制的第一版经实测不够：同步突发会驱逐在飞条目，129 个路径仍产生 129 条告警，因此规则同时保护两者。
- 未验证/范围外：Windows 原生共享冲突与当前 head 的 macOS 行为（跟踪 issue 事项 4）——未使用此类宿主，且更早的 macOS 证据早于 writer-handle 生命周期，不被复用。更早的平台证据不被当作认证。在评审的构建与测试车道中，两个无关套件为红并已归因而非隐藏：一个本改动未触碰文件中的机器相关内存召回延迟用例，以及 Node 26 原生占位遮蔽 jsdom 导致的 web-shell localStorage 失败。CLI 包的 related-test 车道在完整期限下超时，无结论。未跑扩展的全仓库套件。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。不改动公开 API、配置键、CLI flag 或磁盘记录格式。一处此前被断言的行为被有意替换：从已满诊断缓存中被驱逐的路径过去会再次告警，现在不会。编码旧期望的用例被替换为新策略下的精确计数，而非削弱，另有一条用例保持失败投递槽位的驱逐可观察。致命尾部检查错误的 message 增加 ` (file: …)` 后缀；原始 message 仍是逐字前缀，错误对象、code 与 stack 不变。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/17852-jsonl-tail-diagnostics/docs/design/jsonl-tail-diagnostics-17852.md) 与 [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/17852-jsonl-tail-diagnostics/docs/design/jsonl-tail-diagnostics-17852.zh-CN.md) —— 两份完整同步，包含关于冗余守卫的实测注记与延后的原生平台范围。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #17852 —— 解决事项 1、2、3；事项 4（Windows 原生与当前 head 的 macOS 验证）仍未解决，此处不声称完成。
Refs #17771 —— 本工作承接的已合入父 PR。
Refs #17853 —— 记录这些延后项的合入后验证账本。

已损坏历史的读取侧抢救仍是 #17756 的独立工作。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): stamp clean suspensions for wake dispatch
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This implements slice (1) of the [seal-time wake stamp addendum](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-control-plane-wake-seal-stamp.md) ([中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-control-plane-wake-seal-stamp.zh-CN.md)). When the control plane turns on wake dispatch (`qwen.managed-agent.wake-dispatch.enabled`, off by default), an idle Hosted Session whose only pending inputs are deferred, unattempted wake inputs — for example a loop wakeup due in an hour — now suspends instead of staying resident. At the seal, the Harness records what its wake pump would pick from the committed prefix: whether a deliverable wake input remains and when the earliest one is due. The Store writes that stamp on the journal head together with the journal revision it certifies, and refuses a stamp for any other revision.

On the control plane, the existing wake recovery scan becomes the due-time dispatcher. A stamped head leaves the scan until its earliest input is due, and is then loaded without replaying its journal. Every writer acquisition clears the stamp and pulls a stamped future due time back to the scan's claim delay, so a crashed writer or a refused load falls back to today's replay proof. The recovery view reports a stamped clean suspension as ready right after its seal, and the event transport drops a delayed wake notice for a stamped head that has nothing deliverable or is not yet due.

The capability is advertised in the writer grant, so the Store that issues it is the one that consumes the stamp, and an older Harness ignores it. The suspension gate stays strict for everything the control plane cannot own: a non-wake input, an input a transcript attempt already touched, an input that is already due, and a stopped run's message input all keep the Session resident as today.

Both language versions of the addendum are updated with the two post-merge review items from #17869 (the transport drop condition now also covers a stamped head with nothing pending, and the widening of `ready` to stamped child Sessions is stated) and with the implementation decisions: the capability rides the writer grant, the stamp arm is added beside the existing scan-proven arm of the recovery view rather than replacing it, and the transport keeps its current load verb in this slice.

## Why it's needed

Today any pending input keeps a Hosted Session resident, so a Session waiting on a far-future wakeup pins a Harness slot until it fires. The scan-based scheduling in the parent design would have re-proved every such head on each claim cycle and could starve a due Session behind long far-future journals (both reproduced on H2; addendum §1). The suspending writer already holds the exact answer, and nothing can commit until the next writer acquisition, so recording it at the seal lets the existing backstop deliver the input at its due time with no journal replay.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- With wake dispatch off, nothing changes: an idle Session with a pending deferred wakeup stays resident, writer grants carry no capability, and seals carry no stamp.
- With it on, an idle Session whose only pending input is a future loop wakeup suspends; its head records the stamped revision, the pending flag and the due time. The scan does not select the head before that time, and selects it as stamped once it is due, with zero journal reads.
- With it on, a Session holding a due wake input, a stopped run's message, a non-wake input or an attempted wake input stays resident.
- A later writer acquisition clears the stamp and caps a future due time at the claim delay without lowering a delay a claim already set; a refused load's seal and a bare seal leave no stamp; a stamp naming another revision is refused with `409 managed_session_wake_stamp_stale` and the head stays unsealed.
- A stamped clean suspension is `ready` right after its seal, including one with an unattempted deferred input; once an acquisition clears the stamp, it is not.
- A delayed wake notice for a stamped head that is not yet due, or has nothing pending, causes no load; one for a due head, or for a stamp at an older revision, loads as today.
- The scan selects a stamped child Session, and a stamped child of a stopped or terminal parent run is cleared without a load.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no UI change). Local verification output is posted as a separate comment.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux arm64, JDK 21, Maven 3.9.9, Node 24. Java checks are focused unit and H2 tests; TypeScript checks are build, typecheck, lint and focused unit tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: for a stamped head the control plane trusts the writer's own seal-time projection instead of an independent journal replay. The stamp reuses the wake pump's pick, is fenced to the exact committed revision, and is cleared by any later writer acquisition, so unstamped heads keep the replay proof. The stamp also makes stamped child Sessions eligible for `ready`, which the scan-based proof did not cover; this is intended (addendum §3.3).
- Not validated / out of scope: the MySQL 8.4 `mysql-integration` cases, SpotBugs and the full `mvn verify` are pending CI. There is no end-to-end run, which would need a control plane, a Harness and MySQL together. The Harness tests do not cover the due-input, stopped-message and attempted-input arms of the suspension gate, or the grant refresh on writer renewal. The addendum's §6 measurement and moving the transport to the passive load verb are follow-ups.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the V1 baseline gains one nullable head column in place, so development catalogs must be recreated per the schema policy. The seal request gains an optional field and the writer grant a new flag; both are ignored by older peers.

## Linked Issues

Implements the design in #17869 (addendum to #17805).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 实现 [seal 时 wake 戳补充设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-control-plane-wake-seal-stamp.zh-CN.md)（[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-control-plane-wake-seal-stamp.md)）的第 (1) 批改动。控制面打开 wake 分发（`qwen.managed-agent.wake-dispatch.enabled`，默认关闭）后，如果一个空闲的 Hosted Session 的待处理输入全部是延后到期、且未被尝试过的 wake 输入（例如一小时后到期的 loop wakeup），它现在可以挂起，而不必一直驻留。在 seal 时，Harness 记录它的唤醒泵会从已提交前缀中挑出什么：是否还有可投递的 wake 输入，以及最早的那个何时到期。Store 把这个戳连同它所认证的 journal revision 一起写到 journal head 上，revision 不一致的戳会被拒绝。

在控制面上，现有的 wake 恢复扫描成为按到期时间分发的机制。带戳的 head 在其最早输入到期前不会进入扫描，到期后被加载时不需要重放 journal。每次获取 writer 都会清掉戳，并把戳里的未来到期时间压回扫描的认领延迟，因此 writer 崩溃或加载被拒绝时，会回到现有的重放证明路径。恢复视图在带戳的正常挂起 seal 之后立即报告 ready；对于没有可投递输入或尚未到期的带戳 head，事件 transport 会丢弃迟到的 wake 通知。

该能力通过 writer grant 公告，因此签发它的 Store 就是消费戳的 Store，旧版 Harness 会忽略它。对控制面无法接管的情况，挂起门仍保持严格：非 wake 输入、已被 transcript 尝试过的输入、已经到期的输入，以及已停止 run 的消息输入，都会像现在一样让 Session 保持驻留。

补充设计的中英文版本都已更新，包括 #17869 合并后的两条评审意见（transport 丢弃条件现在也覆盖没有 pending 的带戳 head；明确写出 `ready` 扩展到带戳的子 Session），以及实现中的决定：能力随 writer grant 下发；恢复视图的戳分支是在现有扫描证明分支之外新增的，而不是替换它；这一批改动中 transport 仍沿用现有的加载动词。

## 为什么需要

目前任何待处理输入都会让 Hosted Session 保持驻留，所以一个等待远期 wakeup 的 Session 会一直占用 Harness 槽位，直到它触发。父设计中基于扫描的调度会在每个认领周期重新证明每个这样的 head，还可能让一个已到期的 Session 被长 journal 的远期 head 饿死（两者都已在 H2 上复现，见补充设计 §1）。挂起中的 writer 本来就掌握精确的答案，而在下一次获取 writer 之前不会有任何提交，因此在 seal 时把它记录下来，现有的兜底扫描就能在到期时投递输入，而无需重放 journal。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- wake 分发关闭时行为不变：带待处理延后 wakeup 的空闲 Session 保持驻留，writer grant 不带该能力，seal 不带戳。
- 打开后，唯一待处理输入是未来 loop wakeup 的空闲 Session 会挂起；它的 head 记录戳的 revision、pending 标记和到期时间。扫描在到期前不会选中该 head，到期后以带戳的方式选中它，journal 读取为零。
- 打开后，持有已到期 wake 输入、已停止 run 的消息、非 wake 输入或已尝试过的 wake 输入的 Session 保持驻留。
- 之后的一次 writer 获取会清掉戳，并把未来到期时间压到认领延迟，但不会降低认领已设置的延迟；拒载的 seal 和裸 seal 不留下戳；revision 不一致的戳以 `409 managed_session_wake_stamp_stale` 被拒绝，head 保持未 seal。
- 带戳的正常挂起在 seal 之后立即为 `ready`，包括带一个未尝试 deferred 输入的情况；一旦某次获取清掉了戳，就不再是 `ready`。
- 对尚未到期或没有 pending 的带戳 head，迟到的 wake 通知不会引起加载；对已到期的 head，或戳的 revision 较旧的 head，照现有方式加载。
- 扫描会选中带戳的子 Session；父 run 已停止或已终止的带戳子 Session 会被清除且不加载。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用（没有 UI 变化）。本地验证输出单独以评论形式发布。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux arm64、JDK 21、Maven 3.9.9、Node 24。Java 检查为选定的单元测试和 H2 测试；TypeScript 检查为构建、类型检查、lint 和选定的单元测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：对于带戳的 head，控制面信任 writer 自己在 seal 时的投影，而不是独立的 journal 重放。戳复用唤醒泵的挑选逻辑，被围栏限定在确切的已提交 revision 上，并在之后任何一次 writer 获取时被清除，因此无戳的 head 仍走重放证明。戳还让带戳的子 Session 可以成为 `ready`，这是基于扫描的证明所不覆盖的；这是有意的（补充设计 §3.3）。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：MySQL 8.4 的 `mysql-integration` 用例、SpotBugs 和完整的 `mvn verify` 等待 CI。没有端到端运行，那需要控制面、Harness 和 MySQL 同时就位。Harness 测试没有覆盖挂起门中已到期输入、已停止消息和已尝试输入这几种情况，也没有覆盖续租时对 grant 的刷新。补充设计 §6 的测量以及把 transport 改为被动加载动词是后续工作。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：V1 基线原地新增一个可为空的 head 列，因此开发用的 catalog 需要按 schema 策略重建。seal 请求新增一个可选字段，writer grant 新增一个标记；旧版对端都会忽略它们。

## 关联 Issue

实现 #17869 中的设计（#17805 的补充设计）。

</details>
