auto_merge.commit_title: feat(managed-agent): stamp clean suspensions for wake dispatch (#17908)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* feat(managed-agent): stamp clean suspensions for wake dispatch

Implement slice (1) of the seal-time wake stamp addendum. When the
control plane enables wake dispatch, an idle Hosted Session whose only
pending inputs are deferred, unattempted wake inputs suspends instead
of staying resident. Its seal records what the wake pump would pick
from the committed prefix, and the Store writes that stamp on the
journal head with the revision it certifies.

The wake backstop becomes the due-time dispatcher: a stamped head
leaves the scan until its earliest input is due and is then loaded
without replaying its journal. Every writer acquisition clears the
stamp and caps a stamped future due time at the claim delay, so
crashes and refused loads keep the existing proof path. The recovery
view reports a stamped clean suspension ready right after its seal,
and the transport drops a delayed wake notice for a stamped head with
nothing due.

The capability is off by default and rides the writer grant. The
addendum records the two post-merge review items from #17869 and the
implementation decisions in both languages.

* test(managed-agent): drop storage_version from the stamped-heads fixture

The version convergence in #17864 removed the column from the session head.

* docs(managed-agent): describe the wake-dispatch setting in the configuration reference

prs.title: fix(agents): reject incompatible Host replacements
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Refuses an Agent Host replacement when its resulting set of bound Hosts cannot offer an affected agent's explicitly pinned program. It reports affected agent IDs before changing persistent state, preserves pins, and permits replacement when a compatible surviving Host still satisfies the pin. Interrupted replacements are checked again even after bindings have moved to the staged identity.

Enrollment errors distinguish a known unregistered secret from an already enrolled staged secret. Known refusals retain the existing status/error contract for older clients and add actionable detail for current clients; staged conflicts preserve the enrolled secret. Current clients display the detail while retaining secret cleanup and earlier-identity restoration semantics.

## Why it's needed

Host replacement previously preserved a program pin while moving the agent onto Hosts that might not offer it. The inspected pickup path skips an unavailable pinned program, so this configuration can strand queued work without notifying the owner. Direct binding updates already reject an unsupported pin; replacement needs equivalent compatibility admission without silently selecting another program or breaking enrollment recovery.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Pin an agent to Claude on its only Host, then attempt replacement with a Qwen-only Host. Expect refusal, affected IDs and corrective advice, with both registry and roster unchanged and the pin preserved. An invalid token must receive a generic refusal without agent details.
- Correct the replacement's program declarations and retry the same unexpired enrollment token. Expect successful replacement and an unchanged pin. Also verify that a Qwen-only replacement succeeds when a surviving bound Host offers Claude, while a surviving v2 unavailable probe does not count as support.
- Exercise interrupted enrollment and secret rotation. A known unregistered refusal must clean up the candidate secret or restore the earlier enrolled secret; an enrolled staged-secret conflict must preserve that secret. Retrying after the roster committed must still check program compatibility and reuse the staged Host ID.

Completed local validation: `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run bundle`, targeted ESLint and Prettier all passed. From `packages/core`, `npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/store.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` passed 46 tests. From `packages/cli`, `npx vitest run src/serve/routes/agent-hosts.test.ts src/serve/agent-host-client.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` passed 123 tests. An independent test-engineer verified the local bundle through real daemon HTTP routes. Two independent design audit rounds were incorporated, and the subsequent implementation review reported “No findings.”

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the global `qwen 0.27.3` HTTP reproduction returned `replacementStatus: 201` for a Qwen-only replacement of a Claude-pinned agent, preserving the pin on the incompatible new binding. A current-source script reproduced the same invalid admission.

After: the local bundle daemon recorded `conflictStatus: 401` with affected IDs and corrective detail, `registryAndRosterBytesUnchanged: true`, and `sameTokenAndSecretRetryStatus: 201` after compatible declarations. The compatible-surviving-Host case recorded `replacementStatus: 201` with the pin and surviving binding preserved. No screenshots or recordings were captured; HTTP observations are the before/after evidence. Actual indefinitely queued work and remote program execution were not exercised.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested — build, typecheck, bundle, 169 focused tests and local daemon HTTP verification |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS; Node.js `v22.18.0`; pnpm `11.24.0`; isolated local daemon using `node dist/cli.js`. The global reproduction used `qwen 0.27.3`. Initial build failure from installed `diff 7.0.0` versus required `^8.0.3` was repaired with a frozen-lockfile dependency synchronization and postinstall; manifests and lockfile were unchanged. An early missing-dist test guard stopped one attempt during rebuilding; final tests ran with completed prerequisites and settled dependencies. Unrelated build warnings remain.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: incompatible replacements now require operator correction. Admission checks available declarations/probes, so it does not guarantee a Host is online or that a later heartbeat still reports the program available. Existing explicit pins are never dropped automatically.
- Not validated / out of scope: Linux/Windows, CI, actual queued-run liveness, remote Claude/Codex execution, full mixed-version processes and real daemon crashes between file commits. Staged conflicts, client recovery and file failures are covered by focused fault-injection tests. Scheduler redesign, automatic repair of existing incompatible bindings and Java/control-plane changes are excluded.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: intentional tightening of incompatible replacement admission; no schema or data migration. Existing fixed refusal responses remain recognizable to older clients; current clients additionally display actionable detail. Changing bindings may require cancelling queued/live work under the existing guard.

## Linked Issues

Closes [#13644](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13644).

---


<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

当替换后的绑定 Host 集合无法提供受影响 Agent 显式固定的程序时，拒绝 Agent Host 替换。在修改持久化状态前报告受影响 Agent ID，保留固定程序；如果兼容的存续 Host 仍满足固定要求，则允许替换。中断的替换即使已经把绑定移到暂存身份，也会重新检查。

注册错误区分确定未注册的密钥与已注册的暂存密钥。确定拒绝时保留旧客户端识别的状态/错误契约，并为当前客户端增加可操作 detail；暂存冲突保留已注册密钥。当前客户端显示 detail，同时保留密钥清理和原身份恢复语义。

## Why it's needed

此前 Host 替换保留程序固定配置，却可能把 Agent 移到不提供该程序的 Host 上。已检查的 pickup 路径会跳过不可用的固定程序，因此这种配置可能让任务停留在队列中而不通知所有者。直接更新绑定已经拒绝不受支持的固定程序；替换需要同等兼容性准入，同时避免静默选择其他程序或破坏注册恢复。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- 将 Agent 固定为 Claude 且仅绑定一个 Host，再尝试替换为只提供 Qwen 的 Host。预期拒绝，显示受影响 ID 和修正建议，注册表、列表均不变且保留固定程序。无效令牌应收到通用拒绝，不含 Agent 详情。
- 修正替换 Host 的程序声明，使用相同且未过期的注册令牌重试。预期替换成功且固定程序不变。另验证存续绑定 Host 提供 Claude 时允许 Qwen-only 替换，而存续 Host 的 v2 不可用探测不能计为支持。
- 验证中断注册和密钥轮换。确定未注册的拒绝必须清理候选密钥或恢复此前已注册密钥；已注册暂存密钥的冲突必须保留该密钥。列表已提交后的重试仍需检查程序兼容性，并复用暂存 Host ID。

已完成的本地验证：`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run bundle`、定向 ESLint 和 Prettier 均通过。在 `packages/core` 执行 `npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/store.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false`，46 项通过。在 `packages/cli` 执行 `npx vitest run src/serve/routes/agent-hosts.test.ts src/serve/agent-host-client.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false`，123 项通过。独立 test-engineer 通过真实 daemon HTTP 路由验证了本地 bundle。已采纳两轮独立设计审计结果，后续实施审查结论为“No findings.”。

### Evidence (Before & After)

修改前：全局 `qwen 0.27.3` HTTP 复现中，将固定 Claude 的 Agent 替换到 Qwen-only Host 返回 `replacementStatus: 201`，在不兼容的新绑定上保留固定程序。当前源码脚本复现了相同的错误准入。

修改后：本地 bundle daemon 记录 `conflictStatus: 401`，附带受影响 ID 和修正 detail，`registryAndRosterBytesUnchanged: true`；声明兼容后记录 `sameTokenAndSecretRetryStatus: 201`。兼容存续 Host 场景记录 `replacementStatus: 201`，保留固定程序和存续绑定。未采集截图或录像；HTTP 观察结果构成前后对比证据。未执行实际无限排队任务或远程程序。

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested — 构建、类型检查、bundle、169 项定向测试和本地 daemon HTTP 验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS；Node.js `v22.18.0`；pnpm `11.24.0`；使用 `node dist/cli.js` 的隔离本地 daemon。全局复现使用 `qwen 0.27.3`。首次构建因已安装 `diff 7.0.0` 不满足所需 `^8.0.3` 而失败，通过 frozen-lockfile 依赖同步及 postinstall 修复；manifest 和 lockfile 未变。一次过早测试在重建期间被 missing-dist 检查拦下；最终测试在前置条件完成、依赖稳定后运行。仍存在无关的构建警告。

## Risk & Scope

- 主要风险或取舍：不兼容替换现在需要操作者修正。准入检查可用声明/探测，不保证 Host 在线，也不保证后续心跳仍报告程序可用。绝不自动解除现有显式固定程序。
- 未验证 / 范围外：Linux/Windows、CI、实际排队任务活性、远程 Claude/Codex 执行、完整混合版本进程及文件提交间隙的真实 daemon 崩溃。暂存冲突、客户端恢复和文件故障由定向故障注入测试覆盖。不包含调度重构、已有不兼容绑定的自动修复和 Java/控制平面变更。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：有意收紧不兼容替换的准入；无需 schema 或数据迁移。旧客户端仍可识别既有固定拒绝响应；当前客户端额外显示可操作 detail。现有保护可能要求先取消排队/运行任务才能修改绑定。

## Linked Issues

关闭 [#13644](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13644)。

---


</details>

prs.title: fix(daemon): include memory metrics in detailed status JSON
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Preserves three existing fields in each daemon's `detail` object from `qwen daemon status --detail --json`: `runtime.process`, `runtime.memory`, and `limits.memory`. It reuses the existing summary request, keeps the endpoint's units and nulls, and does not include other runtime or limits fields. Adds operator documentation about process RSS and the coverage of sampled ACP child RSS.

## Why it's needed

Operators could already get memory diagnostics from the HTTP `/daemon/status` endpoint, but the CLI dropped them from detailed JSON. Keeping these fields gives operators a way to track RSS, heap usage, pressure and the resolved budget before an OOM incident, without manually querying the daemon HTTP endpoint.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- From `packages/cli`, run `npx vitest run src/commands/daemon.test.ts`.
- With a local daemon running, run `qwen daemon status --detail --json` and compare these three fields under `detail` with the raw summary response. Check that `qwen daemon status --json` still does not query details, and that `qwen daemon status --detail` keeps its text output unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The new regression reproduced the missing fields with the original code. After the change, the focused daemon command suite passed all 74 tests on Linux, including omission on legacy responses and preservation of zero and null.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | ⚠️ Not run |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not run |
| Linux | ✅ Daemon command unit suite |

### Environment (optional)

Linux; Vitest with mocked status responses. No live daemon deployment was required for the unit suite.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: additive JSON fields that reflect the daemon's existing schema; older daemons may omit them. Child RSS is a sample, not total process-tree memory.
- Not validated / out of scope: live-daemon deployment, `/health`, workspace idle reclamation, and memory admission policy.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none expected. Text output, JSON without `--detail`, and authentication behavior are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Related to #17888 (CLI observability only; workspace runtime reclamation remains tracked separately in #8051).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动内容

`qwen daemon status --detail --json` 在每个 daemon 的 `detail` 下保留已有的三个字段：`runtime.process`、`runtime.memory` 和 `limits.memory`。复用原有摘要请求，保留原始单位和空值，不透传其他 runtime 或 limits 字段。文档说明进程 RSS 与 ACP 子进程 RSS 的采样覆盖范围。

## 改动原因

HTTP `/daemon/status` 已有内存指标，但 CLI 详细 JSON 原先会过滤掉这些数据。透传后，运维可以在 OOM 发生前跟踪 RSS、堆内存、压力和有效预算，不必手动请求 daemon HTTP 接口。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证步骤

- 在 `packages/cli` 下运行 `npx vitest run src/commands/daemon.test.ts`。
- 本地 daemon 启动后运行 `qwen daemon status --detail --json`，将 `detail` 下的三个字段与原始摘要响应对照。确认仅用 `--json` 时不查询详细信息，而 `--detail` 的文本输出保持不变。

### 前后对照

新增回归用例可在原代码中复现字段缺失。修改后 Linux 上 daemon 命令专项套件 74 项测试全部通过，覆盖旧响应缺字段以及零值和空值保留。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | ⚠️ 未运行 |
| Windows | ⚠️ 未运行 |
| Linux | ✅ daemon 命令单测 |

### 测试环境（可选）

Linux；Vitest 使用模拟的状态响应。此次单测未部署真实 daemon。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：新增 JSON 字段沿用 daemon 已有结构，旧 daemon 可能没有相关字段。子进程 RSS 是采样值，并非整个进程树的内存总量。
- 未验证或不在范围内：真实 daemon 部署、`/health`、空闲工作区回收、内存准入策略。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：没有预期的破坏性变更。文本输出、没有 `--detail` 的 JSON 和鉴权行为均不变。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #17888，仅处理 CLI 可观测性；工作区 runtime 回收仍在 #8051 单独跟踪。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): decouple first prompt from automatic title writes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Web Shell submits the first prompt as soon as its session is ready. It saves the automatic title in the background using the newly allocated session ID. The daemon applies that title only when there is no existing title or title write in progress, and suppresses a late title event once a manual rename has taken effect.

## Why it's needed

The first prompt previously waited for the title metadata request. A slow title endpoint delayed prompt submission even though the session was ready. Moving the write into the background also requires the daemon to protect a manual rename from a late automatic title.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Hold the automatic title PATCH and submit the first prompt in a new session. Confirm the prompt receives HTTP 202 before releasing the PATCH.
2. Hold session creation, submit the first prompt, and switch to an existing session. Release creation while the title PATCH is still held. Confirm exactly one prompt reaches the newly allocated session and the selected session stays visible.
3. Hold the automatic title PATCH before it reaches storage. Rename the session in the sidebar, then release the PATCH. Confirm both the saved title and the sidebar retain the manual name.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Playwright Chromium on macOS ran against both builds from the same `main` commit, `ac4ae44cbaca92938d1f655b40d0e4581d702656`, using a mock daemon over REST/SSE. Each condition ran five times per build. Times are medians in milliseconds, measured from clicking Send.

| Title PATCH delay | To prompt POST, before → after | To HTTP 202, before → after | Accepted before title response, before → after |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 0 ms | 96 → 95 | 119 → 110 | 0/5 → 0/5 |
| 600 ms | 717 → 107 | 751 → 124 | 0/5 → 5/5 |

| Regression scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Title endpoint held | No prompt acknowledgment while the PATCH was held | First prompt received HTTP 202 before the PATCH was released |
| Switch sessions during creation | Prompt count stayed at zero while the title PATCH was held | Exactly one prompt reached the newly allocated session and the selected session stayed visible |
| Manual rename before the delayed title write | The delayed write replaced the saved manual title | Both the saved title and the sidebar retained the manual name |

Chromium results were 1/4 passing on the baseline and 4/4 with the fix. The repository build, typecheck, and 931 focused unit tests passed with the fix. The bridge and recorder tests also cover a late write reply and the order of persisted title writes.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | ✅ Chromium and local checks |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment

Local production Web Shell builds with Playwright Chromium and the mock daemon. The timing covers prompt admission via HTTP 202.

## Risk & Scope

- The initial title is best effort. The session catalog can show a provisional title and then reconcile with the daemon.
- The Chromium tests exercise REST/SSE request order, session routing, and rename behavior. Model response latency is outside this measurement.
- The automatic write uses a distinct field so older daemons cannot interpret it as a manual rename. No migration is required.
- Design documents [English](https://github.com/callmeYe/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-async-session-title/docs/design/web-shell-first-prompt-title.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/callmeYe/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-async-session-title/docs/design/web-shell-first-prompt-title.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 改动

Web Shell 在会话就绪后立即提交首条消息，并使用新分配的会话 ID 在后台保存自动标题。daemon 只在没有现有标题或正在进行的标题写入时应用自动标题。手动改名生效后，daemon 会抑制迟到的自动标题事件。

### 原因

此前首条消息要等待标题元数据请求。即使会话已经就绪，标题接口慢也会推迟消息提交。标题移到后台后，daemon 也需要保护手动改名，避免迟到的自动标题覆盖它。

### 审阅验证计划

1. 挂起自动标题 PATCH，在新会话提交首条消息。确认消息先收到 HTTP 202，再放行 PATCH。
2. 挂起会话创建，提交首条消息后切到已有会话。放行创建，继续挂起标题 PATCH。确认首条消息仅发一次，发往新分配的会话，界面保持在选中的会话。
3. 在自动标题 PATCH 到达存储前挂起它。在侧栏手动改名后放行 PATCH，确认存储中的标题和侧栏都保留手动名称。

#### 修复前后证据

在 macOS 上用 Playwright Chromium 验证了同一个 `main` 提交 `ac4ae44cbaca92938d1f655b40d0e4581d702656` 的前后两份构建，后端为模拟 REST/SSE daemon。每种条件在每份构建上运行 5 次。耗时从点击发送开始，取中位数，单位为毫秒。

| 标题 PATCH 延迟 | 发出 prompt POST，修复前 → 修复后 | 收到 HTTP 202，修复前 → 修复后 | 标题返回前收到 202，修复前 → 修复后 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 0 ms | 96 → 95 | 119 → 110 | 0/5 → 0/5 |
| 600 ms | 717 → 107 | 751 → 124 | 0/5 → 5/5 |

| 回归场景 | 修复前 | 修复后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 标题接口挂起 | PATCH 挂起时收不到首条消息的确认 | 放行 PATCH 前首条消息已收到 HTTP 202 |
| 创建期间切换会话 | 标题 PATCH 挂起时，已提交的消息数为 0 | 只向新分配的会话提交一次，界面保持在选中的会话 |
| 延迟写入前手动改名 | 迟到的写入覆盖了存储中的手动名称 | 存储与侧栏都保留手动名称 |

Chromium 用例从修复前的 1/4 通过变为修复后的 4/4 通过。整仓构建、类型检查和 931 项相关单测均已通过。桥接层与记录服务的测试还覆盖了迟到的写入响应和标题持久化顺序。

#### 验证平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | ✅ Chromium 和本地检查已通过 |
| Windows | ⚠️ 本地未验证 |

prs.title: test(integration): give the editor-parity waits the shared-pool stall tier (#17544)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Raises the polling ceiling used by the interactive editor-parity acceptance suite so that a mid-turn repaint on the shared runner pool gets the same stall allowance the harness already grants the CLI at startup. The suite's local wait budget goes from 12s to 30s, and the shared wait helper triples that in CI, which lands the CI ceiling exactly on the 90s self-hosted boot tier. Both waits named in the flake report go through that one helper, so a single ceiling change covers both signatures. Every assertion, every input and every probe condition is untouched — nothing is skipped, retried, wrapped or loosened — and a small pin ships alongside so the ceiling cannot silently drift back below the boot tier.

## Why it's needed

CI Failure Patrol saw two waits in this suite expire on one commit and pass on a rerun of the same commit: the search/Tab/Escape case waiting for the model reply to become visible, and the streaming-cancel case waiting for the cancelled prompt to return to the composer. Both are waits for a repaint after a key press, and the suite is fully mocked against a local fake provider, so no real model latency is involved.

The harness already records that this shared pool stalls the very same CLI for much longer than the mid-turn ceiling allowed: the ready-prompt budget documentation describes a boot exhausting 30s on all three retries and another exhausting 90s, and grants 90s on self-hosted runners and 180s on self-hosted docker as a result. The mid-turn ceiling was 36s in CI — below the boot tier for the same host — so a stall the harness already tolerates at startup expired a wait in the middle of a test. An earlier change raised this whole family's wait ceilings for exactly this signature class; this file kept the second-lowest budget in the family while containing its longest and most interaction-dense cases.

One detail matters when reading the report: the polling helper throws only its label, never the screen it last saw, so "no content mismatch" describes the error text rather than a screen verified healthy. The investigation therefore checked the alternatives against code and captured frame evidence instead of trusting the signature. CPU contention was ruled out by pinning the whole test tree to a single core shared with three busy loops — the cases still passed, because the suite is dominated by its own fixed settles. Reply-label desynchronisation was ruled out by confirming one request per submit with matching labels and every background model caller disabled. Viewport scroll-off was ruled out by measuring the waited-for reply's row in every captured frame: it is always the newest transcript line, directly above a fixed six-row footer. The product's cancel/restore branch was traced and takes the restore path for a held stream that has already rendered content.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the suite the way the parity leg does, from `integration-tests`, with the sandbox off and retries disabled: `CI=true QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run interactive/tui-editor-parity.test.ts interactive/tui-editor-parity-wait-budget.test.ts --retry=0 --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1`. Expect all 30 cases green (29 acceptance cases plus the new pin), with the search/Tab/Escape case around 33s.

Confirm the pin actually witnesses the ceiling by reverting the budget literal to `12_000` and re-running just the pin: it must fail with `expected 36000 to be greater than or equal to 90000`. Restore the literal and it passes. This probe was run before committing, in that order.

Confirm the change is ceiling-only: the acceptance diff is one numeric literal plus an explanatory comment, with no assertion, input, key sequence or probe condition altered.

Two limits are worth knowing before reviewing. The flake did not reproduce locally — 18 pre-fix executions of the named case were green, including the harshest contention surrogate — so the ceiling is calibrated against the pool's recorded stall incidents and the existing boot policy, not against a local reproduction. And `bun` is not installed on this runner, so the bun+ink and bun+opentui legs were not exercised; if the stall is specific to the native renderer, CI remains the authority.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change with no user-visible behavior. For the record: the CI wait ceiling moves from 36s to 90s and the local ceiling from 12s to 30s; post-fix the whole suite plus the pin passed 30/30 on two consecutive runs, and the pin failed against the pre-fix ceiling with the assertion quoted above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node v22.23.2 on Linux, driving the prebuilt bundle with `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` on the node+ink renderer leg, `CI=true` for the scaled budgets. `bun` is not installed, so the other two renderer legs were unavailable.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a genuinely stuck UI now takes up to 90s in CI and 30s locally to fail a wait, instead of 36s and 12s. The two reported cases inherit the suite's 300s per-test ceiling, so they still fail on the wait's own label. The three permissions cases pin a 90s per-test ceiling of their own; under a stall they would now report the suite timeout rather than the wait label, and they still fail either way. Local failure diagnosis for this file is correspondingly slower, which is the unavoidable consequence of the helper coupling its local and CI budgets by a factor of three.
- Not validated / out of scope: no local reproduction of the flake; the bun+ink and bun+opentui legs; and `npm run build`, which this sandbox cannot run because corepack is denied write access to its cache outside the project (`EACCES: permission denied, mkdir '/home/github-runner/.cache/node/corepack/v1'`). The diff touches no workspace package — the integration tree has no manifest and is not a workspace member — so the per-package build never compiles it. `npm run typecheck` (all workspaces plus the integration program), `npm run lint` and Prettier all passed. No product code, CI machinery, shared wait policy or configuration was changed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17544

阅读报告时有一个细节很重要：轮询助手抛出的只有标签，从不附带它最后看到的屏幕，因此“没有内容不符”描述的是错误文本，而不是一块被验证为健康的屏幕。所以本次排查是对照代码与采集到的帧证据去核实各种可能，而不是相信签名本身。CPU 争用已被排除：把整棵测试进程树绑到与三个忙循环共享的单个核上，用例依然通过，因为该套件的时间主要花在自身的固定 settle 上。回复标签错位已被排除：确认每次提交对应一个请求且标签一致，并且所有后台模型调用方都已关闭。可视区滚出已被排除：逐帧测量被等待回复所在的行，它始终是最新的一条 transcript 行，紧邻固定的六行页脚之上。产品侧的取消/恢复分支也已追踪，对于已经渲染出内容的 held 流，它走的是恢复路径。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

按 parity leg 的方式运行该套件：在 `integration-tests` 目录下，关闭 sandbox 并禁用重试：`CI=true QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run interactive/tui-editor-parity.test.ts interactive/tui-editor-parity-wait-budget.test.ts --retry=0 --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1`。预期 30 个用例全绿（29 个验收用例加新增 pin），其中 search/Tab/Escape 用例约 33s。

确认本改动只涉及上限：验收文件的 diff 是一个数字字面量加一段解释性注释，没有任何断言、输入、按键序列或探针条件被改动。

评审前值得知道两个边界。抖动在本地没有复现——修复前命名用例的 18 次执行全部通过，其中包括最严苛的争用 surrogate——因此上限是按该池已记录的卡顿事故与既有启动策略定标的，而不是按本地复现定标的。另外本 runner 未安装 `bun`，所以 bun+ink 与 bun+opentui 两条 leg 未被执行；如果卡顿特定于原生渲染器，CI 仍是最终权威。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 仅测试改动，没有用户可见行为变化。备查：CI 等待上限从 36s 提高到 90s，本地上限从 12s 提高到 30s；修复后整个套件加 pin 连续两轮均 30/30 通过，而该 pin 面对修复前的上限失败，报上文引用的断言。

### 测试平台

| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |

prs.title: fix(memory): rebuild extraction indexes in the runtime
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The automatic memory extractor checks for duplicates and writes topic documents. The runtime rebuilds the matching user and project indexes using successful write receipts. The extractor can read the root indexes for deduplication. Its file tools reject writes to those indexes.

If a partially completed extraction has already saved a document, that document is included in the rebuilt index. When a project index repair fails, the next extraction retries it before inspecting new input. The history cursor stays at the last confirmed position until extraction completes.

## Why it's needed

The extractor currently asks the model to edit the indexes that the runtime already regenerates. That creates redundant tool calls and often requires additional model requests after the useful write has finished. A failed batch can also leave an already saved topic absent from the index.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Add a durable user preference and update an existing project memory. Check that the extractor only writes topic documents, that both runtime-generated root indexes point to those documents, and that a new session can recall them.
- Cancel a batch after a successful topic write or exhaust its turn budget. Check that the document is indexed and the history cursor still allows retry.
- Fail the project index rebuild once. On the next run, check that the runtime repairs the index even if the model detects an identical pre-existing topic and performs no new write.
- Try writing either root index directly or through a symlink from the extractor. Check that writes are denied and ordinary topic writes still succeed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The targeted core suite passed all 179 tests on macOS. In a controlled replay at base commit `477dc9d214`, updating a topic took five model requests and included a failed index edit. Paired model measurements are tracked in the E2E evidence.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Targeted core tests passed |
| Windows | Pending CI |
| Linux | Pending CI |

## Risk & Scope

The runtime now records a pending project index repair in the existing extraction cursor. Older cursor files work without migration. The change uses the extractor's existing permission boundary and keeps the model route, history input, and scheduling cadence.

[English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2bdd1490f908f5f7671744f4ee8664ac1feb08fa/docs/design/auto-memory/runtime-owned-extraction-index.md) · [简体中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2bdd1490f908f5f7671744f4ee8664ac1feb08fa/docs/design/auto-memory/runtime-owned-extraction-index.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related to #13004.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动

自动提取器负责查重和写入主题正文。运行时根据成功写入的工具回执重建对应的用户和项目索引。提取器可以按需读取根索引查重，其文件工具会拒绝写入根索引。

如果一次未完成的提取已经保存正文，重建索引时会包含该正文。项目索引修复失败后，下次提取会先重试修复，再检查新输入。游标在提取完成前停留在上次确认的位置。

## 背景

提取器当前要求模型编辑运行时已经会重新生成的索引。这会增加工具调用，有时正文写成后还要再发起模型请求。一次失败的提取也可能让已保存的正文暂时无法从索引查到。

## 审阅测试计划

### 验证步骤

- 新增一条长期用户偏好，再更新一条已有项目记忆。确认提取器只写正文，由运行时生成的两个根索引都包含对应条目，新会话能够召回。
- 正文成功落盘后取消提取，或耗尽轮次上限。确认正文已进入索引，游标允许下次重新处理。
- 让项目索引重建失败一次。再次提取时，即使模型发现正文已经存在并且没有再写，也应先修复索引。
- 尝试由提取器直接或通过符号链接写根索引。确认索引写入被拒绝，普通正文仍能保存。

| Windows | 等待 CI |
| Linux | 等待 CI |

运行时在现有游标文件上记录待修复的项目索引。旧游标无需迁移。改动使用提取器现有的权限边界，沿用模型路由、历史输入和调度节奏。

prs.title: fix(acp-bridge): merge background-turn live text chunks
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Coalesce compatible `agent_message_chunk` and `agent_thought_chunk` events in an in-flight background turn by including the validated background-turn ID in live-journal segment identity. Invalid or unmodeled background-turn metadata remains discrete so replay cannot silently discard extension fields when events merge.

Regression coverage exercises full and summary replay, turn completion, different background-turn boundaries, malformed metadata, and an extension field present only in an earlier chunk.

## Why it's needed

Live replay deliberately coalesces bounded groups of text updates, but every update carrying `backgroundTurn` metadata bypassed that path as unmodeled. A long background turn could therefore accumulate hundreds of thousands of small events. In the motivating session, `/load` returned HTTP 200 in about 2.5 seconds, yet its response was about 146 MiB and contained more than 200,000 live events, leaving Web Shell busy parsing and replaying them.

Most of that payload was repeated envelope metadata rather than response text. Merging compatible events removes the redundant event overhead without changing streamed text. The strict own-key check also prevents a different problem: the existing background-turn parser recognizes normalized fields but ignores extensions, while merged replay keeps the latest metadata, so extension-bearing chunks must not be merged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Send several consecutive message and thought chunks with the same valid `backgroundTurn` during an admitted background turn. Both full and summary loads should return one merged event of each type rather than every input chunk, preserving concatenated text, final event identity, and background-turn metadata. Change `turnId`, make the metadata invalid, or add an unmodeled extension only to the first chunk; the original events must remain separate so content and metadata are preserved.

End the turn and confirm compacted replay still contains each text sequence exactly once with no residual text duplicates in the live journal.

Focused automated verification completed locally:

```text
cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/compactionEngine.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       145 passed (145)
```

The final change was also rebuilt with `npm run build && npm run bundle` (exit 0), checked with root `npm run typecheck` (exit 0), and passed targeted ESLint and Prettier checks. A controlled ACP end-to-end replay against the bundled CLI exited 0: full and summary live journals each contained 3 events (one start marker and the two merged text events) instead of 13, text and background metadata were preserved, and terminal replay contained no duplicates. No real model calls were used.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — replay and daemon behavior only; no user-interface or screenshot changes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js v26.12.1 and npm 11.20.0 in the Linux worktree. End-to-end verification used the bundled CLI with a controlled ACP mock rather than a live model.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: chunks with unknown background-turn extension fields now deliberately stay discrete to preserve metadata. If a future producer adds extensions, those events keep their larger representation until compaction explicitly models them, rather than losing information through merging.
- Not validated / out of scope: no 200,000-event browser rendering benchmark was run; adaptive journal growth and response-size budgets are unchanged (P1). Cross-turn behavior in the older compacted-slot path and a derive-once parsing/allocation refactor are intentionally untouched. macOS and Windows were not run locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none intended. There is no protocol, persisted-schema, or migration change.

## Linked Issues

N/A — this PR came from a local replay incident investigation and does not close a GitHub issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

将同一后台轮次中兼容的 `agent_message_chunk` 和 `agent_thought_chunk` 事件合并到 live journal，并把校验后的后台轮次 ID 纳入分段身份。非法或未建模的后台轮次 metadata 继续保持离散，避免事件合并时静默丢失扩展字段。

回归测试覆盖 full 和 summary replay、轮次结束、不同后台轮次边界、非法 metadata，以及只出现在较早 chunk 中的扩展字段。

## Why it's needed

Live replay 本来会将连续文本更新分组为有界事件，但带有 `backgroundTurn` metadata 的更新全部被视为未建模，绕过了该合并路径。长时间后台轮次因此可能累积数十万个小事件。本次事故中的 `/load` 虽在约 2.5 秒内返回 HTTP 200，但响应约 146 MiB，包含超过 20 万个 live 事件，导致 Web Shell 长时间解析和回放。

这些数据大多是重复的 envelope metadata，而不是正文。合并兼容事件可以在不改变流式文本的前提下删除重复事件开销。严格的 own-key 检查还防止另一个问题：现有后台轮次解析器识别规范化字段但忽略扩展字段，而合并后的 replay 保留最新 metadata，因此不能合并带未建模扩展字段的 chunk。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

在一个已准入的后台轮次中连续发送多个具有相同合法 `backgroundTurn` 的 message 和 thought chunk。full 和 summary 加载都应分别返回一个合并事件，而不是每个输入 chunk 各一个事件，同时保留串联文本、最终事件身份和后台轮次 metadata。修改 `turnId`、让 metadata 非法，或只在第一个 chunk 中加入未建模扩展字段时，原事件必须保持分离，以保留文本和 metadata。

结束轮次后，确认 compacted replay 中的每段文本仍恰好出现一次，live journal 中没有残留的重复文本。

本地完成的聚焦自动验证：

```text
cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/compactionEngine.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       145 passed (145)
```

最终改动还执行了 `npm run build && npm run bundle`（exit 0）和根目录 `npm run typecheck`（exit 0），并通过目标文件的 ESLint 与 Prettier 检查。针对打包 CLI 的可控 ACP 端到端回放以 exit 0 完成：full 和 summary live journal 均包含 3 个事件（1 个开始标记和 2 个合并文本事件），而不是 13 个；文本与后台 metadata 均保留，终态回放没有重复内容。验证未调用真实模型。

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — 仅修改 replay 和 daemon 行为，没有用户界面或截图变化。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### Environment (optional)

Linux worktree 中的 Node.js v26.12.1 和 npm 11.20.0。端到端验证使用打包 CLI 和可控 ACP mock，不调用真实模型。

## Risk & Scope

- 主要风险或取舍：含未知后台轮次扩展字段的 chunk 会有意保持离散，以保留 metadata。如果未来生产者增加扩展字段，在 compaction 显式支持这些字段之前，相关事件会保留较大的表示形式，而不是因合并丢失信息。
- 未验证或不在范围内：未运行 20 万事件的浏览器渲染基准；自适应 journal 增长和响应大小预算保持不变（P1）。旧 compacted-slot 路径中的跨轮次行为以及 derive-once 解析和分配重构都有意保持不变。未在本机运行 macOS 和 Windows。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无预期的破坏性变更，不涉及协议、持久化 schema 或迁移变化。

## Linked Issues

N/A — 本 PR 来自本地 replay 事故调查，不关闭任何 GitHub issue。

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Switches the manual `review_requested` lane in `qwen-code-pr-review.yml` from the deleted `qwen-code-ci-bot` account to the live `qwen-code-review-bot` account, with `vars.REVIEW_BOT_LOGIN` available as the repository-level override, and updates the workflow meta-test fixtures to the same configurable identity. The three job gates and the `review-config` `bot_login` output now agree on the account that actually receives review requests and posts PR reviews.

This is intentionally scoped to the manual re-review channel. Other workflows still reference `qwen-code-ci-bot` and are deliberately left alone here: `qwen-autofix.yml` (`REVIEW_BOT` and review-event routing), `qwen-autofix-fork-bridge.yml`, `qwen-autofix-fork-signal.yml`, `qwen-pr-safety-precheck.yml` (manual-precheck comment ownership), and `pr-force-push-reminder.yml` (automation exclusion). Those are separate consumers or are masked by the collaborator association branches, so changing them would broaden this PR beyond #16832. The `RELEASE_SYNC_ACTOR` fallbacks in `ci.yml` and `sdk-python.yml` are also unchanged because release sync likely uses a different actor identity and I found no evidence that `qwen-code-review-bot` is its replacement.

## Why it's needed

Requesting `qwen-code-ci-bot` as a reviewer is not usable: `GET /users/qwen-code-ci-bot` returns 404, and requesting it on an owned PR returned HTTP 422 (`Reviews may only be requested from collaborators`). Requesting `qwen-code-review-bot` on the same owned PR was accepted, and the account is a live collaborator (`GET /users/qwen-code-review-bot` resolves as a `User`; the collaborator check returns 204). Recent PR reviews in this repository are authored by `qwen-code-review-bot`; there is no GitHub App identity involved in the observed review author.

The old gate still produced an event run but made every job skip. On PR #17841, requesting `qwen-code-review-bot` generated `pull_request_target` run [44522592919](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44522592919), and all review jobs reported `skipped` because the workflow compared the live request with the dead login.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Confirm the identity evidence above: old account 404 / reviewer request 422; new account resolves, is a collaborator, is requestable as a reviewer, and is the observed PR review author.
2. Confirm `.github/workflows/qwen-code-pr-review.yml` has no `qwen-code-ci-bot` references and that `precheck-pr`, `review-config`, `authorize`, and the `bot_login` output all resolve `(vars.REVIEW_BOT_LOGIN || 'qwen-code-review-bot')`.
3. Run `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/qwen-pr-review-workflow.test.js`.
4. Run `grep -R ".github/workflows/qwen-code-pr-review.yml" scripts/tests/` and check the dependent suites listed below.
5. After merge, on an owned open PR only, request `qwen-code-review-bot` as a reviewer and confirm the `🧐 Qwen Pull Request Review` run's jobs start instead of all reporting `skipped`. This live path cannot be proven before merge because `pull_request_target` reads the workflow from the base branch.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this is a CI/workflow change with no CLI, TUI, Web UI, or Web Shell surface. The discriminating evidence is the GitHub API/workflow behavior above plus the workflow meta-tests.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

<!-- ✅ tested · ⚠️ not tested · N/A -->

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node 22.23.4, Vitest 3.2.7. The workflow behavior was reproduced through the GitHub REST API on owned PR #17841 only; the successfully added reviewer was removed afterward.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the actual fixed live trigger can only be observed after this base-branch workflow merges; pre-merge verification is necessarily static and meta-test based.
- Not validated / out of scope: no full local workflow execution, and the Windows/Linux suites were not run locally. `actionlint` is available at 1.7.7 but is unusable as a signal on this existing workflow: the full invocation exceeded 120 seconds while invoking ShellCheck, and `-shellcheck=` then rejected the pre-existing `deployment: false` environment key as a schema error. The changed workflow is parsed and exercised by the meta-tests.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the stale `qwen-code-ci-bot` repository collaborator entry still needs admin cleanup outside this PR. This PR does not touch the auxiliary consumers listed above or the release-sync actor fallback.

Verification run on commit `b39b893d51bd437fc9076603bd1b9cb1933a4676` (after merging `origin/main` `33fdbb37387a`; lint-gate freshness against `7f496cec38b0` is fresh):

- `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/qwen-pr-review-workflow.test.js` — passed: 282 tests, 3 skipped.
- `qwen-resolve-workflow.test.js` — passed: 55 tests.
- `qwen-triage-workflow.test.js` — passed: 216 tests, 11 skipped.
- `review-artifact-upload.test.js` — passed: 19 tests.
- `review-worktree-cleanup-workflow.test.js` — passed: 24 tests.
- `qwen-autofix-workflow.test.js` — 356 passed, 1 pre-existing local-host timeout in `attributes deletions, empty files, renames and octopus merges correctly` at its explicit 120-second limit; this unrelated test was previously reproduced on the clean baseline.
- `npx prettier --check .github/workflows/qwen-code-pr-review.yml scripts/tests/qwen-pr-review-workflow.test.js` and `git diff --check` — passed.
- Independent read-only review of the final diff — no findings.
- `qwen review run --effort low --json --timeout-minutes 20` — review-gate UNVERIFIED: the wrapper returned no machine verdict (`completed=false`, `verdictLine=null`); its stderr contained a light review with no P0/P1 findings, and the single bounded attempt was not retried.

prs.title: test(managed-agent): re-home publication lifecycle IT v1 witness to external-files
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Re-homes the lifecycle witness in the tool-publication MySQL integration test from a files-on-v2 session (lifecycle protocol 2) back to a v1 profile: it flips the session's tool profile to external-files and keeps the close at protocol 1, instead of bumping the protocol to 2. Test-only, one file.

## Why it's needed

Follow-up to #17871. The D3 files-on-v2 change moved the files profile to lifecycle protocol 2, and #17871 migrated this test's CLOSE arm from protocol 1 to 2 so the lifecycle admission gate would accept it. That migration is incomplete for this particular test: it hand-builds its own lifecycle store outside the persistence package, so it cannot inject the profile lifecycle verifier (the setter is package-private and its only caller lives in the persistence package). At protocol 2 the effects-recovery path requires that verifier and throws `workspace_lifecycle_protocol_unavailable` when it is absent — before the never-initialized branch the assertion targets — so the case can never pass. The lane that runs this file is the MySQL integration job, which triggers on schedule/dispatch only, so the first red would surface in the nightly run rather than on the PR page. The #17871 review bot raised this as R5-1; the guard path, the package-private setter, and its single call site were each verified against the merged tree. Keeping the witness on external-files (which stays at protocol 1) restores the pre-D3 protocol-1 behavior the test relied on, matching how the rest of the D3 migration re-homed v1 witnesses, and avoids a package move just to wire the verifier.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the MySQL integration lane (it needs JDK 21, Maven and a MySQL container) and confirm `receiptAndReplayDoNotDeadlockWithSameTenantLifecycleCompletion` passes; or trace the guard: with the session on external-files the close runs at protocol 1, the effects verifier's protocol-2 branch (which demands the profile verifier) is skipped, and recovery returns the never-initialized receipt the test asserts. Removing the fix (back to protocol 2 on the hand-built store) makes the first effects recovery throw.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅ compile + Checkstyle (dual execution, 0 violations); MySQL IT not run locally (no container)   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ not tested   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️ not tested (CI MySQL integration lane will witness)   |

### Environment (optional)

Isolated Maven repository, JDK 21, `mvn -pl verification -am test-compile checkstyle:check checkstyle:check@runtime-broker-checkstyle` → BUILD SUCCESS, 0 violations.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none beyond the test itself — it restores the protocol-1 path the test used before D3, on a profile that remains v1.
- Not validated / out of scope: the MySQL integration test was not executed locally (no MySQL container); the CI MySQL integration lane is the witness. The other two MySQL fixtures migrated in #17871 are unaffected (one uses the persistence-package fixture that wires the verifier; the other fails at admission before effects recovery).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

References #17871 (review bot R5-1).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

把 tool-publication MySQL 集成测试里的生命周期见证从 files-on-v2 会话（生命周期协议 2）改挂回 v1 profile：将会话的 tool profile 翻成 external-files、关闭保持协议 1，而不是把协议升到 2。仅测试，单文件。

## 为什么需要

#17871 的后续。D3 的 files-on-v2 把 files profile 移到生命周期协议 2，#17871 把该测试 CLOSE 臂从协议 1 迁到 2 以通过生命周期准入守卫。但对这个特定测试迁移不完整：它在 persistence 包之外自建生命周期 store，无法注入 profile 生命周期 verifier（setter 是包级私有，唯一调用点在 persistence 包）。协议 2 下 effects 恢复路径要求该 verifier，缺失时抛 `workspace_lifecycle_protocol_unavailable`——先于断言所依赖的 never-initialized 分支——用例不可能通过。跑该文件的通道是 MySQL 集成 job，仅 schedule/dispatch 触发，故第一次变红出现在 nightly 而非 PR 页。#17871 评审 bot 以 R5-1 提出；守卫路径、包级私有 setter 及其唯一调用点均已对合并树逐一核实。把见证保留在 external-files（仍为协议 1）恢复了测试在 D3 之前依赖的协议 1 行为，与 D3 其余迁移改挂 v1 见证的做法一致，也避免仅为注入 verifier 而移包。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

跑 MySQL 集成通道（需 JDK 21、Maven 与 MySQL 容器），确认 `receiptAndReplayDoNotDeadlockWithSameTenantLifecycleCompletion` 通过；或追迹守卫：会话在 external-files 上关闭走协议 1，effects verifier 的协议 2 分支（要求 profile verifier）被跳过，恢复返回测试断言的 never-initialized receipt。去掉修复（回到自建 store 上的协议 2）会使首次 effects 恢复抛错。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——仅测试改动。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅ 编译 + Checkstyle（双 execution，0 违规）；MySQL IT 本机未跑（无容器）   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ 未测   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️ 未测（CI MySQL 集成通道将见证）   |

### 环境（可选）

隔离 Maven 仓库，JDK 21，`mvn -pl verification -am test-compile checkstyle:check checkstyle:check@runtime-broker-checkstyle` → BUILD SUCCESS，0 违规。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：除测试本身外无——它恢复 D3 之前测试用的协议 1 路径，挂在一个仍为 v1 的 profile 上。
- 未验证/范围外：MySQL 集成测试本机未执行（无 MySQL 容器）；CI MySQL 集成通道是见证。#17871 迁移的另两处 MySQL 夹具不受影响（一处用注入了 verifier 的 persistence 包 fixture；另一处在准入即失败、不到 effects 恢复）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

引用 #17871（评审 bot R5-1）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): keep what the person typed in a reduced compaction request (#9455)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a compaction request does not fit its window, #15936 reduces it by cutting every text part to 4,000 characters, the user's own messages included. This PR keeps the text the person typed in that reduced request.

- **The person's prompt is marked where it is sent.** The CLI's interactive and OpenTUI modes mark the part that holds a prompt a person submitted, and headless mode does for a person's message sent as stream-json input. ACP marks a prompt a person wrote, and hosted serve marks a prompt that reaches the model as written. A plain `-p` prompt, slash-command expansions, a Mod's or a scheduled prompt, mid-turn messages and hosted input queued during a turn are not marked. Core marks the first text part of a person's prompt unless the front end marked the prompt itself, as ACP does, since it puts the instruction last. The mark is never sent to a provider. The CLI stores it in the session file; ACP and hosted serve record the turn without it, so after a resume their earlier turns are cut as before.
- **A reduced request keeps the marked text.** It is kept whole, up to a cap of 32,000 characters. The blocks the CLI puts in front of the prompt, such as the IDE context, are cut like other text and closed again. Unmarked text, including attached files, tool output and every turn of a session recorded before this change, is cut exactly as before.
- **It never asks for more than the plain cut.** Each character kept beyond the plain cut is charged as a whole token against the summary's output budget, so a request the server accepts in its plain form is also accepted with the text kept, at any density up to a token a character. The kept request is used only on the first send, and only while the summary keeps at least half of its budget and its minimum: at the 20,000-token budget cap, that is one message of up to about 14,000 characters. Past that the request is the plain cut, as today. A rejected kept request is retried with the plain cut, even when the two differ by only a few characters. If a kept reply has no output count and no closed `<state_snapshot>`, the truncation check would drop it for the smaller budget, so the plain cut is sent once instead.
- It also corrects a code comment that came with #15936. Not every writer escapes tags inside a block's body: the reminder that ends a todo-list result holds the list as JSON. #15936's design doc already says so.

## Why it's needed

The summary prompt asks for the user's exact phrasing and for every user message, but a reduced request held only the first 4,000 characters of each, so a long request, often a pasted spec or log followed by the actual ask, reached the summarizer without its end. On a mock backend that enforces the window, with 5 requirement sentences spread through each long request, the sentences that reached the summary request rose from 15, 10 and 10 of 25 to 23, 19 and 16 of 25 for requests of 6,000, 9,000 and 12,000 characters, in English and in Chinese alike.

This is the second half of the work split out of #14953. It differs from the plan I posted there on 11-02 in three ways:

- Parts 1 and 2 of that plan are one PR. Telling typed text apart by its position in the turn failed in several layouts: ACP puts the prompt last, and memory recall, the IDE context, task notifications, an earlier summary and restored files all sit beside it. So the text is now marked where it is sent, and only marked text is kept.
- The kept text keeps its start only, not its start and its end. Eliding the middle would create cut shapes that the closing rule for cut text was never measured on.
- Condensing older turns to the user's messages, part 3 of that plan, is not in this PR.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use an OpenAI-compatible provider, or a local mock, that rejects any request whose prompt plus `max_tokens` exceeds its window, and log the requests it receives. Build a session with a few large file reads and one typed message of about 10,000 characters whose last sentence is distinctive. Then set the window low enough that the compaction request no longer fits, and run `/compress`.

- Before: the message reaches the compaction request cut to its first 4,000 characters, followed by the truncation marker.
- After: it reaches the request whole, and the summary can name its last sentence. Compaction succeeds as before.
- A message of 4,000 characters or less is the same before and after. A message over about 14,000 characters, or several long messages that together pass that budget, are cut as before.
- A slash command's expansion, and a session recorded before this change, are cut as before.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real provider: OpenRouter `qwen/qwen3.8-27b`. Before is `main` at this branch's base and After is this branch. Each session was built once with After through stream-json input, which marks the person's message, and restored for both sides, so both compress identical histories. `/compress` ran with the window set to 32,768, so every compaction request took the reduced path; a recall question ("list every requirement I gave you") then ran with the window at 262,144. Each long message carried 5 requirement codes spread through it.

| Scenario | Before: typed text in the compaction request | Before: codes recalled | After: typed text in the request | After: codes recalled | After `max_tokens` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3,000 characters (control) | whole | 5 of 5 | identical request | 5 of 5 | 20,000 |
| 6,000 | first 4,000 | 3, 3 | whole | 5, 5 | 18,030 |
| 9,000 | first 4,000 | 2, 0¹ | whole | 5, 5 | 15,030 |
| 12,000 | first 4,000 | 2, 2 | whole | 5, 5 | 12,030 |
| 9,000 Chinese characters | first 4,000 | 2, 2 | whole | 5, 5 | 15,030 |
| 18,000 (past the budget) | first 4,000 | 1¹ | identical request | 1 | 20,000 |
| 6,000, sent with plain `-p` (unmarked) | first 4,000 | 3 | identical request | 3 | 20,000 |

Two numbers are two runs; a request and its repeat were byte-identical. Every compaction was a single request answered 200 with finish `stop`, with no rejection and no retry. `max_tokens` fell by exactly the characters kept, and the kept text actually cost about 0.2 prompt tokens per character in English and 0.58 in Chinese. No request carried the mark, and no recall named a code that had not reached its compaction request. Total cost about $0.30.

¹ The stored summary was cut short by the existing step that strips the summary's analysis block: the model quoted the compaction directive in its summary, and the quote was read as an unclosed block. Both sides run that code.

The recall question ran at 262,144 because, under the 32,768 window, both sides sent it with `max_tokens: 1`. That looks like the post-compaction estimate issue (#15486); it was not traced here.

Unit tests cover:

- the mark: its shape, its absence from requests on the native, OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic and Responses routes, its survival through the session file, and the resume checks that drop a completed local command's input;
- each place it is set and each exclusion: no human input, internal sends, a Mod's prompt and side queries; ACP's model-only prompts, runtime Goal continuations and attachment-only prompts; hosted prompts that are not new input, were rewritten or extended, or had memory joined; and a request its front end already marked, as ACP sends one on the shared agent loop;
- keeping: leading blocks cut and closed, a lone opening tag the person typed, and the cap with a block it cuts inside;
- the budget: smaller by exactly the characters kept; used at exactly half of the plain budget and not one character past it; the plain cut when the summary would fall under its minimum, on the retry and on the payload-overflow path; a retry only a few characters shorter than the kept request; a kept reply with no usage and no snapshot, followed by one plain send; and a sweep over session shapes, lengths and scripts in which the kept request is accepted wherever the plain one is.

At `fff3048c30`: the core suites under services, core and utils ran 16,928 tests, of which 16,895 passed and 33 were skipped; none failed. The ACP integration, hosted harness and prompt ledger suites pass, 3,683 of 3,683. Core and CLI type-check clean. Before the rebase, each of 20 guards was reverted on its own and turned its tests red, and so does each check added in review: the skip for an already-marked request, the character comparison on the retry, and the plain resend.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests; a local mock provider for the request-level comparison; OpenRouter `qwen/qwen3.8-27b` for the end-to-end run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the kept text comes out of the summary's output budget, by at most half, so a summary longer than that budget, which the plain request would have fit, is dropped as truncated. Keeping is all or nothing per request: past about 14,000 characters of typed text (less in a tight window, and counted over all messages), the request is the plain cut. Text denser than a token a character, such as rare CJK characters or emoji, can make the server reject the kept request; the retry then sends the plain cut. The text after a marked part's leading blocks is kept as typed, which in the CLI includes the framing around a paste and a prompt that a `UserPromptSubmit` hook rewrote. Core marks the first text part, so a caller that sends the human-input flag with another part first and marks nothing gets that part marked: headless mode does this on a first turn that carries a startup-worktree or recovered-agents notice, where the notice is marked and the text is cut as before.
- Not validated / out of scope: whether keeping the text improves task outcomes; marking a plain `-p` prompt, slash-command expansions, mid-turn messages and hosted input queued during a turn; keeping as much of a long message as the budget allows, and keeping its end; condensing older turns (part 3 of the #14953 plan); recording the mark in ACP's and hosted serve's turn records; tests for ACP's sandbox/SSH marking branch and for the minimum-output floor. The end-to-end run used stream-json input; the interactive, OpenTUI and ACP front ends are covered by unit tests only. Windows and Linux are covered by CI only.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Sessions recorded before this change have no marks and are cut as before, and the mark is not sent to providers.

Design doc: [English](https://github.com/yanyukang2003-ux/qwen-code/blob/fix/9455-keep-typed-text/docs/design/2026-11-17-keep-typed-text-in-reduced-compaction.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/yanyukang2003-ux/qwen-code/blob/fix/9455-keep-typed-text/docs/design/2026-11-17-keep-typed-text-in-reduced-compaction.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #9455. Follows #15936. The round-4 findings from #14953 are answered in a comment below.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

压缩请求放不进窗口时，#15936 会把每个文本片段截到 4,000 字来缩减它，用户自己的消息也一样被截。这个 PR 让缩减后的请求保留用户亲手输入的文字。

- **在发送的地方给用户的提示打标记。** CLI 的交互界面和 OpenTUI 会给装着用户所提交提示的那个片段打标记，无界面模式对以 stream-json 输入发送的用户消息也会打标记。ACP 给用户写的提示打标记，托管模式给原样发给模型的提示打标记。普通的 `-p` 提示、斜杠命令的展开内容、Mod 或定时任务的提示、对话进行中插入的消息，以及托管模式在一轮进行中排队的输入，都不打标记。core 给用户提示的第一个文字片段打标记，除非前端已经自己打过标记，比如 ACP，因为它把指令放在最后。标记从不发给模型服务商。CLI 会把它存进会话文件；ACP 和托管模式记录这一轮时不带标记，所以恢复会话之后，它们较早的轮次照旧截断。
- **缩减后的请求保留有标记的文字。** 整条保留，上限 32,000 字。CLI 放在提示前面的标签块（比如 IDE 上下文）和其他文字一样截断，并重新补上结束标签。没有标记的文字，包括附带的文件、工具输出，以及这次改动之前录制的会话里的每一轮，都和以前完全一样地截断。
- **请求的总量从不超过普通截法。** 比普通截法多保留的每个字，都按一个完整的 token 从摘要的输出额度里扣除，所以服务器能接受普通版的请求，保留文字后也一定能接受，只要文字密度不超过每字一个 token。保留版只在第一次发送时使用，而且只在摘要还能保有至少一半额度和最低输出空间时使用：额度为 20,000 token 上限时，就是单条最多约 14,000 字的消息。超出时请求就是普通截法，和现在一样。保留版被拒后，重试发送普通截法，即使两者只差几个字也是如此。如果保留版的回复没有输出用量、也没有完整的 `<state_snapshot>`，截断检查会因为额度较小而丢掉它，这时改发一次普通截法。
- 同时更正一条随 #15936 合入的代码注释。并非所有写入方都会转义块正文里的标签：待办列表结果末尾的提醒以 JSON 形式放入列表。#15936 的设计文档已经写明了这一点。

## 为什么需要

摘要提示词要求引用用户的原话、列出每一条用户消息，但缩减后的请求里每条消息只剩前 4,000 字，所以长请求（常常是先贴一段需求或日志、最后才是真正的要求）送到摘要模型时没有了结尾。在一个严格执行窗口限制的模拟后端上，每条长请求里均匀埋 5 句要求：6,000、9,000、12,000 字的请求，送进摘要请求的句数分别从 25 句中的 15、10、10 句提高到 23、19、16 句，英文和中文结果相同。

这是从 #14953 拆出来的后半部分工作。它和我 11-02 在那里发的计划有三点不同：

- 那个计划的第 1、2 部分合成了一个 PR。按片段在一轮中的位置来判断哪些是用户输入的文字，在好几种布局下都会出错：ACP 把提示放在最后，而记忆召回、IDE 上下文、任务通知、上一次的摘要和恢复的文件都和它并列。所以现在改为在发送的地方打标记，只保留有标记的文字。
- 保留的文字只留开头，不再同时保留开头和结尾。从中间省略会产生新的截断形态，而被截断文字的补闭合规则从未在这些形态上验证过。
- 把旧轮次压缩成只剩用户消息（那个计划的第 3 部分）不在这个 PR 里。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

使用一个兼容 OpenAI 的服务商或本地模拟服务，要求它拒绝提示加 `max_tokens` 超过窗口的请求，并记录收到的请求。建立一个会话：读几个大文件，再输入一条约 10,000 字、最后一句很有辨识度的消息。然后把窗口调小，让压缩请求放不下，再运行 `/compress`。

- 改动前：这条消息进入压缩请求时只剩前 4,000 字，后面跟着截断标记。
- 改动后：它完整进入请求，摘要能说出它的最后一句。压缩和以前一样成功。
- 4,000 字以内的消息改动前后相同。超过约 14,000 字的消息，或几条长消息加起来超过这个额度时，照旧截断。
- 斜杠命令的展开内容，以及这次改动之前录制的会话，照旧截断。

### 证据（改动前后对比）

真实服务：OpenRouter `qwen/qwen3.8-27b`。改动前是这个分支所基于的 `main`，改动后是这个分支。每个会话都用改动后的版本通过 stream-json 输入（它会给人的消息打标记）建立一次，再分别在两边恢复，所以两边压缩的是完全相同的历史。`/compress` 在窗口设为 32,768 时运行，因此每个压缩请求都走缩减路径；之后在窗口为 262,144 时提一个回忆问题（"列出我给你的每一条要求"）。每条长消息里均匀埋了 5 个要求编号。

| 场景 | 改动前：压缩请求里的用户文字 | 改动前：复述出的编号 | 改动后：请求里的用户文字 | 改动后：复述出的编号 | 改动后的 `max_tokens` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3,000 字（对照） | 完整 | 5/5 | 请求完全相同 | 5/5 | 20,000 |
| 6,000 字 | 前 4,000 字 | 3、3 | 完整 | 5、5 | 18,030 |
| 9,000 字 | 前 4,000 字 | 2、0¹ | 完整 | 5、5 | 15,030 |
| 12,000 字 | 前 4,000 字 | 2、2 | 完整 | 5、5 | 12,030 |
| 9,000 个汉字 | 前 4,000 字 | 2、2 | 完整 | 5、5 | 15,030 |
| 18,000 字（超出额度） | 前 4,000 字 | 1¹ | 请求完全相同 | 1 | 20,000 |
| 6,000 字，用普通 `-p` 发送（无标记） | 前 4,000 字 | 3 | 请求完全相同 | 3 | 20,000 |

两个数字表示跑了两次；同一请求和它的重复运行逐字节相同。每次压缩都是一个请求、返回 200、结束原因为 `stop`，没有被拒绝，也没有重试。`max_tokens` 正好减少了保留的字数；保留的文字实际每字约耗 0.2 个提示 token（英文）和 0.58 个（中文）。没有任何请求带有标记，回忆中也没有出现未进入压缩请求的编号。总花费约 0.30 美元。

¹ 存下来的摘要被现有的"去掉摘要中分析块"的步骤截短了：模型在摘要里引用了压缩指令，这段引用被当成了未闭合的块。两边运行的是同一段代码。

回忆问题在 262,144 窗口下运行，是因为在 32,768 窗口下两边都以 `max_tokens: 1` 发出了它。这看起来是压缩后估算的问题（#15486），这里没有追查。

单元测试覆盖：

- 标记本身：它的结构；它不会出现在原生、OpenAI 兼容、Anthropic 和 Responses 各条通道的请求里；它在会话文件中保留下来；以及恢复会话时丢弃已完成本地命令输入的那两处检查；
- 每个打标记的地方及每种排除情况：没有用户输入、内部发送、Mod 的提示和旁路查询；ACP 的仅供模型的提示、运行时目标续跑和只有附件的提示；托管模式下不是新输入、被改写或扩展、或拼接了记忆的提示；以及前端已经打过标记的请求，比如 ACP 在共享 agent 循环上发出的请求；
- 保留：开头的标签块被截断并补闭合、用户自己输入的孤立开始标签，以及上限截断落在块内部的情况；
- 额度：正好少掉保留的字数；正好在普通额度的一半时使用保留版，多一个字就不用；摘要会低于最低空间时、重试时、以及请求体过大路径上都用普通截法；只比保留版少几个字的重试；没有用量、也没有 snapshot 的保留版回复之后改发一次普通截法；以及一组覆盖不同会话形态、长度和文字的测试，凡是普通版被接受的地方，保留版也被接受。

在 `fff3048c30` 上：core 的 services、core、utils 三个目录 共运行 16,928 条测试，16,895 条通过、33 条跳过，没有失败。ACP 集成、托管模式和提示账本的测试 全部通过，共 3,683 条。core 和 CLI 类型检查无错误。变基之前，20 个保护条件逐一改回后都让对应测试变红；评审中新增的检查也是如此：已有标记时跳过、重试时比较字符数，以及改发普通截法。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 环境（可选）

单元测试；请求级对比使用本地模拟服务；端到端测试使用 OpenRouter `qwen/qwen3.8-27b`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：保留的文字从摘要的输出额度中扣除，最多扣一半，所以如果摘要比剩下的额度长、而普通请求本可以容纳它，这份摘要会被判为截断而丢弃。保留按请求整体全有或全无：用户输入的文字超过约 14,000 字（窗口紧时更少，并且按所有消息合计）时，请求就是普通截法。密度超过每字一个 token 的文字（比如生僻汉字或表情符号）可能导致服务器拒绝保留版，此时重试发送普通截法。有标记的片段在开头标签块之后的文字都按用户输入保留，在 CLI 中这包括粘贴内容外面的说明文字，以及被 `UserPromptSubmit` 钩子改写过的提示。core 标记的是第一个文字片段，所以如果调用方传了用户输入标志、却把别的片段放在前面且自己不打标记，被标记的就是那个片段：无界面模式在带有"启动于 worktree"或"恢复后台 agent"提醒的第一轮就会这样，被标记的是提醒，用户的文字照旧截断。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：保留文字是否能提升任务完成效果；给普通的 `-p` 提示、斜杠命令展开、对话中插入的消息和托管模式排队输入打标记；在额度内尽量多保留长消息，以及保留它的结尾；压缩旧轮次（#14953 计划的第 3 部分）；在 ACP 和托管模式的轮次记录中保存标记；ACP 沙箱/SSH 打标记分支的测试，以及最低输出空间的测试。端到端测试使用的是 stream-json 输入；交互界面、OpenTUI 和 ACP 前端只由单元测试覆盖。Windows 和 Linux 仅由 CI 覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。这次改动之前录制的会话没有标记，照旧截断；标记不会发给服务商。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/yanyukang2003-ux/qwen-code/blob/fix/9455-keep-typed-text/docs/design/2026-11-17-keep-typed-text-in-reduced-compaction.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/yanyukang2003-ux/qwen-code/blob/fix/9455-keep-typed-text/docs/design/2026-11-17-keep-typed-text-in-reduced-compaction.zh-CN.md)

prs.title: feat: turn dynamic workflows on by default
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Dynamic workflows are now on by default. When `tools.workflowsEnabled` is not set, the Workflow tool, `/workflows`, saved workflows and extension workflows are available in the terminal, headless runs, ACP sessions and every daemon workspace runtime, without any setup.

Users can still turn them off: `tools.workflowsEnabled: false` and `QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1` work as before. `--bare` starts with a minimal toolset that excludes Workflow. `--safe-mode` keeps Workflow off when the setting is unset. An explicit `true` enables it in `--safe-mode`. The setting's description, the Web Shell description, the generated settings schema and the user docs now say workflows are on by default and how to turn them off.

## Why it's needed

The switch is a user- or system-scope setting that most users never find, so the model could not reach for a workflow even when a task would clearly benefit from parallel subagents. The tool is deferred behind tool search, so until the model loads it the session context carries only its name. Runs are bounded by the size guideline (`medium`, under 15 agents, by default), the per-run agent cap and the 30-minute wall-clock cap. These limits already applied to users who opted in.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Use a fresh HOME with no workflow setting and no `QWEN_CODE_*_WORKFLOWS` env, and ask `qwen -p` to load the workflow tool through tool search and run a one-agent script. Expect the run to succeed.
2. Set `tools.workflowsEnabled: false` in user settings, or `QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1`, or pass `--bare`. Expect the workflow tool to be absent.
3. In Web Shell with default settings, expect the Workflows surfaces to be available for a trusted workspace.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Prompt: "If a workflow tool exists, run `phase('Probe'); const r = await agent('Reply with the word PONG only.'); return { r };` and reply `RESULT=<reply>`, else reply `MISSING`." All runs used an isolated HOME and the Token Plan model `deepseek-v4-flash-0731`.

| Run | Output |
| --- | --- |
| Before: global `qwen` 0.27.4, no setting | `MISSING` |
| After: no setting | `RESULT=PONG` |
| After: `tools.workflowsEnabled: false` | `MISSING` |
| After: `QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1` | `MISSING` |
| After: `--bare` | `MISSING` |

Unit tests passed for:
- core config, workflow registration, workflow intent, client, runner and workflow tool;
- CLI config and settings schema;
- the daemon's runtime and capability tests, the built-in command loader and the app container.

The updated cases cover the new default and keep bare and safe mode off. Core and CLI typecheck clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Built bundle (`node dist/cli.js`), isolated HOME, yolo approval, `--output-format text`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: more users can start runs that dispatch many subagents and spend tokens accordingly. A message that contains the word `workflow`, in any sense, now adds the steering reminder for these users too. The reminder tells the model to proceed normally when a workflow does not fit, and `ui.disableWorkflowKeywordTrigger` turns it off.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full unit, integration and TUI parity suites run in CI. Any snapshot that lists slash commands or registered tools for a default session may change, because `/workflows` and the Workflow tool are now present. Not tested on macOS or Windows. No change to the size guideline, caps or keyword trigger.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: users who never set `tools.workflowsEnabled` now get workflows. To keep the old behavior, set `tools.workflowsEnabled: false` in user or system settings, or `QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1`.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-11-19-workflows-on-by-default.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-19-workflows-on-by-default.zh-CN.md). Both versions carry the same decisions, risks, acceptance criteria and follow-up.

## Linked Issues

None. Related: #17809 (headless background workflow runs).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

动态 workflow 现在默认开启。没有设置 `tools.workflowsEnabled` 时，Workflow 工具、`/workflows`、已保存的 workflow 和扩展提供的 workflow 在终端、headless 运行、ACP 会话和每个 daemon 工作区 runtime 里都可用，不需要任何配置。

用户仍然可以关闭它：`tools.workflowsEnabled: false` 和 `QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1` 照常生效。`--bare` 启动时使用精简工具集，其中不包含 Workflow。`--safe-mode` 在未配置时保持 Workflow 关闭，显式设为 `true` 可以开启。设置说明、Web Shell 说明、生成的设置 schema 和用户文档都改为写明 workflow 默认开启，以及如何关闭。

## 为什么需要

这个开关是用户级或系统级设置，大多数用户不会发现它。所以即使任务明显适合用并行 subagent，模型也用不了 workflow。工具延迟加载、藏在工具搜索后面，在模型加载它之前，会话上下文里只有它的名字。运行受规模指引（默认 `medium`，少于 15 个 agent）、单次运行的 agent 数上限和 30 分钟总时长上限约束。这些限制对已经主动开启的用户本来就生效。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 用一个没有任何 workflow 设置、也没有 `QWEN_CODE_*_WORKFLOWS` 环境变量的全新 HOME，让 `qwen -p` 通过工具搜索加载 workflow 工具并运行一个单 agent 脚本。预期运行成功。
2. 在用户设置里设 `tools.workflowsEnabled: false`，或设 `QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1`，或加 `--bare`。预期 workflow 工具不存在。
3. 在默认设置的 Web Shell 里，预期受信任工作区可以使用 Workflows 相关界面。

### 证据（前后对比）

提示词："如果存在 workflow 工具，就运行 `phase('Probe'); const r = await agent('Reply with the word PONG only.'); return { r };` 并回复 `RESULT=<回复>`，否则回复 `MISSING`。"所有运行都使用隔离的 HOME 和 Token Plan 模型 `deepseek-v4-flash-0731`。

| 运行 | 输出 |
| --- | --- |
| 之前：全局 `qwen` 0.27.4，无设置 | `MISSING` |
| 之后：无设置 | `RESULT=PONG` |
| 之后：`tools.workflowsEnabled: false` | `MISSING` |
| 之后：`QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1` | `MISSING` |
| 之后：`--bare` | `MISSING` |

单元测试通过的部分：
- core 的 config、workflow 注册、workflow intent、client、runner 和 workflow 工具；
- CLI 的 config 和设置 schema；
- daemon 的 runtime 和能力测试、内置命令加载器以及 app container。

更新后的用例覆盖了新的默认值，并保证 bare 和 safe 模式保持关闭。core 和 CLI 类型检查通过。

| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |

构建后的打包产物（`node dist/cli.js`），隔离的 HOME，yolo 审批，`--output-format text`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：更多用户可能启动派发大量 subagent、相应消耗 token 的运行。对这些用户来说，消息里含 `workflow` 这个词（不论什么含义）也会加上引导提醒。提醒告诉模型，workflow 不合适时照常处理，`ui.disableWorkflowKeywordTrigger` 可以关掉它。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): bind the daemon chat controller to the session provider
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Lands the daemon adapter's binding hook for the unified chat surface (slice 2d). `useDaemonChatController` constructs the slice-2c `createDaemonChatController` once per session from live `DaemonSessionProvider` state, so the daemon chat column can be driven by the backend-neutral `SessionChatController` contract. It wires the intent transports to the session actions (forwarding the daemon's `onAdmitted` prompt id), bridges prompt settlement from the terminal-event subscription, and derives the two evidence channels the provider does not expose explicitly — approval currency and decision settlement — from the pending-permission set via a pure, unit-tested helper. The storage key reuses the existing daemon composer draft key, and capabilities derive from the daemon feature tags through the exhaustive capability map.

This is a foundation slice: the hook renders nothing on its own. The `ChatSurface` component and the main-column switch (with the visual before/after gate) are the next increment. No existing behavior changes here.

## Why it's needed

The slice-2c controller is dependency-injected and backend-neutral; it needs a binding layer to read the real provider. Two of its evidence channels (approval currency, decision settlement) have no explicit provider subscription, so this slice derives them from the pending-permission lifecycle: a request is live while pending; an answered request that resolves emits an applied decision and stays live so the decision can establish; an unanswered departure is a supersession. Landing this with the derivation unit-tested before the surface switch keeps the risky extraction building on proven wiring.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the daemon chat suites from `packages/web-shell`:

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx vitest run client/daemon/permission-signals.test.ts client/daemon/chat-controller.test.ts client/daemon/chat-intents.test.ts
```

Observed locally: `Test Files 3 passed`, `Tests 95 passed` (6 new permission-signal + 50 controller + 39 engine). The new helper cases pin: a newly pending request becomes live; a still-pending request emits nothing; an answered request that resolves emits an applied decision and stays live (identity released by the engine on establish); an unanswered departure is superseded (not live); a mixed transition separates answered / superseded / new; and a consumed answer is not re-emitted.

Type gates (the stricter CI build gate is `tsconfig.lib.json`):

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit   # exit 0
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit       # exit 0
```

ESLint and Prettier are clean on the touched files. Note: a stale local `@qwen-code/sdk` dist after a baseline change produces unrelated errors in files this PR does not touch; `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (which builds the SDK) resolves them before judging the gate.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — additive hook, helper, and tests; no UI or behavior change. The hook is consumed by the upcoming surface switch.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local unit tests and type checks only (vitest + tsc). The hook is not rendered yet, so no daemon is needed to test the derivation helper.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the hook is a foundation not yet consumed by production code; it is rendered by the upcoming surface switch. It lives under `daemon/` outside `chat-core` and imports the contract, controller, and provider, so it introduces no daemon value-import edge into the kernel.
- Not validated / out of scope: `pendingQuestions`, `statusFacts.queueLength`/`goalActive`, and `settledPhase` are bound conservatively (no direct provider selector/hook yet) and will be wired to their real sources in the ChatSurface increment; the optional capability-gated sub-controllers (model / approval-mode / context-usage / session-ops) and the contract's `acknowledge` exposure also land with the surface. The hook itself is verified by typecheck plus the derivation helper's unit tests; a provider-harness test of the full wiring belongs with the surface switch.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No routes, storage keys (the draft key is reused, not redefined), session namespaces, or UI behavior change.

Design: [daemon chat binding (EN)](../blob/feat/unified-chat-surface-slice2d-daemon-binding/docs/design/2026-11-20-daemon-chat-binding.md) · [简体中文](../blob/feat/unified-chat-surface-slice2d-daemon-binding/docs/design/2026-11-20-daemon-chat-binding.zh-CN.md). Part of the [unified chat surface](../blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-16-unified-chat-surface.md) migration; builds on the merged contract (#17520), status stack (#17684), intent engine (#17709), and controller assembly (#17794).

## Linked Issues

Part of slice 2 of the unified chat surface design (#17460). Follows the merged slice-2c controller assembly #17794.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

为统一聊天界面落地 daemon 适配器的绑定 hook（slice 2d）。`useDaemonChatController` 按会话从活的 `DaemonSessionProvider` 状态构造一次 slice-2c 的 `createDaemonChatController`，使 daemon 聊天列能由后端中立的 `SessionChatController` 契约驱动。它把意图 transport 接到会话动作（转发 daemon 的 `onAdmitted` prompt id）、从终态事件订阅桥接 prompt 结算，并从待处理权限集合派生 provider 未显式暴露的两条证据通道——approval 时效与决策结算——经一个纯的、有单测的助手。存储键复用既有 daemon composer 草稿键，能力经穷举能力映射从 daemon feature tags 派生。

这是基础切片：hook 本身不渲染任何内容。`ChatSurface` 组件与主列切换（带视觉前后对比门）是下一增量。此处不改任何现有行为。

## 为什么需要

slice-2c 控制器是依赖注入、后端中立的；它需要一个绑定层来读真实 provider。它的两条证据通道（approval 时效、决策结算）没有显式的 provider 订阅，故本切片从待处理权限生命周期派生：请求待处理期间存活；已应答的请求解析时发出已应用决策并保持存活使决策能建立；未经应答的离开是被取代。在表面切换前随派生单测落地，让风险更高的抽取建立在已被证明的接线之上。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

从 `packages/web-shell` 运行 daemon chat 套件：

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx vitest run client/daemon/permission-signals.test.ts client/daemon/chat-controller.test.ts client/daemon/chat-intents.test.ts
```

本地实测：`Test Files 3 passed`、`Tests 95 passed`（6 新权限信号 + 50 控制器 + 39 引擎）。新助手用例钉住：新待处理请求变存活；仍待处理请求不发信号；已应答请求解析时发出已应用决策并保持存活（引擎在建立时释放身份）；未经应答的离开是被取代（不存活）；混合转换区分已应答/被取代/新增；已消费的应答不重复发出。

类型门（更严格的 CI 构建门是 `tsconfig.lib.json`）：

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit   # exit 0
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit       # exit 0
```

ESLint 与 Prettier 在改动文件上干净。注意：换基线后本地陈旧的 `@qwen-code/sdk` dist 会在本 PR 未触碰的文件上报无关错误；判定该门前先 `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`（会构建 SDK）。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——新增 hook、助手与测试；无 UI 或行为变更。hook 由接下来的表面切换消费。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ✅（本地）；🪟 Windows ⚠️；🐧 Linux ⚠️（交由 CI）。

### 环境

仅本地单元测试与类型检查（vitest + tsc）。hook 尚未被渲染，测试派生助手无需 daemon。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：hook 是尚未被生产代码消费的基础，将由接下来的表面切换渲染。它位于 `daemon/` 在 `chat-core` 之外，导入契约、控制器与 provider，故不向内核引入 daemon 值导入边。
- 未验证/超出范围：`pendingQuestions`、`statusFacts.queueLength`/`goalActive`、`settledPhase` 保守绑定（尚无直接 provider 选择器/hook），将在 ChatSurface 增量接真实来源；可选能力门控子控制器（模型/审批模式/上下文用量/会话操作）与契约 `acknowledge` 暴露也随表面落地。hook 本身由类型检查 + 派生助手单测验证；完整接线的 provider-harness 测试属表面切换。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。不改路由、存储键（草稿键是复用而非重定义）、会话命名空间或 UI 行为。

设计文档：[daemon chat binding（英文）](../blob/feat/unified-chat-surface-slice2d-daemon-binding/docs/design/2026-11-20-daemon-chat-binding.md) · [简体中文](../blob/feat/unified-chat-surface-slice2d-daemon-binding/docs/design/2026-11-20-daemon-chat-binding.zh-CN.md)。属于[统一聊天界面](../blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-16-unified-chat-surface.md)迁移；建立在已合入的契约（#17520）、状态栈（#17684）、意图引擎（#17709）与控制器组装（#17794）之上。

## 关联 Issue

属于统一聊天界面设计（#17460）slice 2 的一部分。承接已合入的 slice-2c 控制器组装 #17794。

</details>
