prs.title: feat(managed-agent): clarify Web UI parity and wire local terminal
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a central **Managed capabilities** dialog with all 35 audited daemon-only surface groups, English and Simplified Chinese explanations, search, and an explicit tracker for every group. This distinguishes a tracked gap from a permanent product decision instead of leaving users with an unexplained missing control.

Corrects the capability matrix against the routes that actually exist, including side-query/recap support and archived Session export, while preserving the distinctions between durable Session worktrees and the daemon's narrower reset, branch, handoff, and persisted-attestation contracts.

Enables the existing terminal and required tool-measurement support for local Managed deployments. The local front door now relays Managed terminal upgrades through the existing single ACP dispatcher, with strict path matching, primary/loopback and Host/Origin checks, selective handshake forwarding, initial-byte relay, and shutdown cleanup. The standalone gateway reuses the same relay rather than maintaining a divergent implementation.

Design documentation: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/managed-web-ui-17717/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-web-ui-parity.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/managed-web-ui-17717/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-web-ui-parity.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

Managed Web UI hid a large number of daemon-only surfaces without saying which gaps were temporary or intentionally excluded. Several parity rows also contradicted mounted routes, and durable worktree storage obscured important differences in the daemon's operational contracts.

The terminal itself already had the Java admission, ticket, Runtime, and UI code, but local `qwen serve --managed` did not enable or dispatch it. Wiring it through the established local front door makes that existing feature usable without introducing another WebSocket listener or conflating Java's one-time terminal ticket with the daemon bearer token.

The inventory records the choices requested for this implementation, rather than silently making new product exclusions: Memory stays with #13396; Agents, Extensions, Hooks, Channels and Scheduled Tasks stay with #16546; the remaining groups stay with #15084 for separate reviewed decisions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. From both a full-shell new Session and an existing Session (including host-session-only presentation), open **Managed capabilities**. Expect 35 groups in five categories, English/Chinese reasons, and explicit issue ownership. Search locally and confirm that opening or filtering the inventory creates no Session and makes no new backend request.
2. Build and launch a same-revision local Managed runtime. Open a shell-capable Session after provision and expect `capabilities.terminal: true` and a visible Terminal action. Request a ticket, verify a 101 handshake using `qwen-ws`, run a harmless command at the Workspace cwd, and verify resize and closure.
3. Attempt to reuse a consumed ticket. Expect HTTP 401 rather than a 101 upgrade. Also verify that browser Authorization, Cookie and identity/signature headers are not forwarded to Java, and that primary/loopback, Host and Origin violations are refused before any Java upgrade occurs. Ordinary ACP and unrelated upgrade routes should retain their existing behavior.
4. Check the matrix against the actual routes: BTW/recap cite the mounted side-query surfaces; archived Sessions can be exported; durable Managed worktrees are not mistaken for persisted attestation, ownership-transfer reset, post-create branching, or work-carrying handoff.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Before:** a static baseline review and focused regression confirmed that there was no central Managed capabilities entry, local terminal deployment options were not enabled, and the unified local front door had no Managed terminal upgrade route. The baseline global runtime-download attempt failed before launch, so no unsupported claim of a completed baseline E2E run is made.

**After (the capability inventory and creation are verified in real Chromium; terminal Group D is still incomplete):** the independent final browser run at `f8b464a6de` observed five categories, 35 unique groups, 35 tracked statuses and issue links, zero owner mismatches or malformed rows. Search/empty-state restoration, focus entry/return and query reset also passed. After an initialization-idle baseline, opening, searching and clearing the dialog produced zero new same-origin requests and zero console/page errors.

![Managed capabilities, real Chromium on f8b464a6de](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr17717-validation/managed-capabilities-dark.png)

With the required Workspace selected, real Session creation returned HTTP 202, `status: accepted` and `replayed: false`. The earlier creation-response timeouts were traced to the harness leaving **Choose a Workspace** unselected, so no create request had reached Java. The earlier capability assertion was not a request issued by this static dialog: its exact excess request was `GET /workspaces/%2Ftmp%2Fqwen-17717-postmerge-QI7mut/sessions/live-state` during initialization; the settled rerun retained the zero-request assertion. These were evidenced harness corrections, not production-code changes made to hide a failure.

![Terminal entry visible while model provisioning fails; this is not a successful terminal session](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr17717-validation/terminal-entry-provisioning-failed.png)

The second image proves only that the Terminal action became visible. The provisioning model Turn failed with `Hosted Harness model authentication is unavailable`, and the harness then stopped while waiting for an obsolete composer placeholder before requesting a ticket. No current-tree ticket, 101/`qwen-ws`, PTY command, resize or replay result was reached. Do not interpret this image as terminal execution proof.

These images are from `f8b464a6de`, not relabeled as `6e76965c76`; the later upstream change is limited to unrelated goal-marker tests, mock support and bilingual design records. Earlier pre-merge terminal successes remain historical evidence and are not substituted for current terminal verification. The final task closed its four observed listeners; its remaining tracked durable worker was separately signalled and the final tracked process/browser lists were empty. The report also records the module's local verification budget as exhausted (734 seconds including assembly), so remaining terminal/CI/manual verification is explicitly pending rather than being retried without limit.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node v26.12.1, JDK 21 and Maven 3.9.11 with a task-local Maven repository. Local build/typecheck/bundle, focused Vitest and Maven tests, and an independently driven real Java/Worker/Chromium stack using task-owned temporary directories.

Post-merge root build, typecheck and bundle: all passed on the audited merged tree (`bg_626f35d4`, exit code 0).

Focused TypeScript verification after merge: CLI passed 247 tests across 6 selected files (1020 unrelated declarations in those same files were skipped by the filter); Web Shell passed all 265 tests across the Managed capabilities dialog and Sessions page files. These are focused tests, not claims of a complete repository test run.

After refreshing the task-local sibling SDK installation, the merged-tree Java `ManagedAgentApiContractTest` passed 25 tests with zero failures, errors or skips; Checkstyle passed across all Java modules.

The upstream workflow meta-test, including the changed `sdk-java.yml`, passed all 79 selected tests in the merged tree.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: terminal dispatch is a deliberately narrow exception before daemon bearer verification because Java authenticates its one-time terminal ticket independently. It remains restricted to the Managed deployment, exact raw terminal path, primary listener and loopback, after Host/Origin checks. Handshake forwarding excludes browser credentials and private identity/signing headers. Both socket directions and shutdown cleanup are covered by focused tests and a real terminal path.
- Not validated / out of scope: full CI, the complete Java suites and MySQL profiles remain CI gates. Missing/malformed/cross-Session ticket cases, persistence across same-data-directory restart, reconnect/scrollback replay, per-header audit through the real upstream, `--open` browser cleanup, and the model provisioning Turn are only claimed where the independent report explicitly verifies them. The 35 currently tracked daemon-only surfaces are explained and assigned, not newly implemented or permanently excluded. SSH, resident, extension and repository-wide worktrees remain out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new OpenAPI route or migration. Local Managed startup explicitly rejects `QWEN_SERVE_ACP_HTTP=0` because the terminal needs that dispatcher; the ordinary daemon's ACP opt-out is unchanged. A local terminal is a human shell, not a model tool: an authorized operator can run arbitrary commands as the server OS account without per-command model approval and without container isolation. The user guide documents that trust boundary.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17717
Refs #15084, #16546, #13396.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增集中的 **Managed capabilities** 弹窗，覆盖全部 35 组已审计 daemon 专属界面，提供英文和简体中文说明、搜索及每组明确的跟踪归属。用户不再只能看到没有解释的失踪控件，而可以区分「正在跟踪的缺口」和「已决定的永久产品边界」。

按实际已挂载路由修正能力对照矩阵，包括 side-query/recap 支持和归档会话导出；同时保留持久化会话工作树与 daemon 更窄的 reset、建分支、handoff 及持久化见证合同之间的区别。

为本地 Managed 部署启用已有终端及其必需的 tool-measurements 支持。本地前门现在通过已有唯一 ACP 分发器中继 Managed 终端 upgrade，并执行严格路径匹配、primary/loopback 与 Host/Origin 检查、选择性握手头转发、初始字节转发和关闭清理。独立 gateway 复用同一 relay，不再维护分叉实现。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/managed-web-ui-17717/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-web-ui-parity.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/managed-web-ui-17717/docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-web-ui-parity.zh-CN.md)。

## 为什么需要

Managed Web UI 隐藏了许多 daemon 专属界面，却没有解释这些缺口是暂时的还是有意排除的。多条能力对照记录也与已挂载路由相矛盾，持久化工作树还掩盖了 daemon 操作合同的重要差别。

终端本来就有 Java 准入、票据、Runtime 和 UI 实现，但本地 `qwen serve --managed` 没有启用和分发它。通过既有本地前门接线后，用户可以使用这项已有能力，同时不新增 WebSocket listener，也不混淆 Java 一次性终端票和 daemon bearer token。

清单记录本次实现所选择的方向，而不是静默新增产品排除决定：Memory 继续归属 #13396；Agents、扩展、Hooks、Channels 和定时任务继续归属 #16546；其余各组继续归属 #15084，由单独评审决定后续实现。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 在完整 Shell 的新会话和已有会话（包括 host-session-only 展示）中打开 **Managed capabilities**。应看到五个分类中的 35 个分组、英文／中文理由及明确的 issue 归属。执行本地搜索，确认打开或筛选清单不会创建会话，也不会发出新的后端请求。
2. 构建并启动同一修订的本地 Managed runtime。完成 provision 后打开支持 Shell 的会话，应看到 `capabilities.terminal: true` 及可见的终端入口。申请票据，验证以 `qwen-ws` 完成 101 握手，在 Workspace cwd 执行无害命令，并检查 resize 和关闭行为。
3. 尝试重用已消费的票据，应返回 HTTP 401 而非 101。还要验证浏览器的 Authorization、Cookie 和身份／签名头不会转发到 Java；primary/loopback、Host 和 Origin 违规都在任何 Java upgrade 之前被拒绝。普通 ACP 和无关 upgrade 路由保持既有行为。
4. 按实际路由检查对照矩阵：BTW/recap 引用已挂载的 side-query surface；归档会话可以导出；持久化 Managed 工作树不会被误认为持久化见证、所有权转移 reset、创建后建分支或携带工作的 handoff。

### 改动前后证据

**改动前：**基线静态复核和聚焦回归确认，尚不存在中央 Managed capabilities 入口，本地终端部署选项没有启用，统一本地前门也没有 Managed 终端 upgrade 路由。全局 baseline 的 runtime 下载在真正启动前失败，因此不声称完成过 baseline E2E。

**改动后（能力清单与会话创建已由真实 Chromium 验证；终端 Group D 尚未完成）：**独立最后一次浏览器运行基于 `f8b464a6de`，观察到五个分类、35 个唯一分组、35 个 Tracked 和 35 个 issue 链接，owner 不匹配与异常行均为零。搜索及空结果恢复、焦点进入／返回、重开时 query 重置也通过。建立初始化静默基线后，打开、搜索和清空弹窗产生的新同源请求与 console/page error 均为零。

![Managed capabilities：基于 f8b464a6de 的真实 Chromium](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr17717-validation/managed-capabilities-dark.png)

选择必需的 Workspace 后，真实会话创建返回 HTTP 202、`status: accepted` 和 `replayed: false`。此前的创建响应超时已查明：夹具没有选择 **Choose a Workspace**，因此创建请求根本没有到达 Java。此前能力断言多出的请求明确是初始化期间的 `GET /workspaces/%2Ftmp%2Fqwen-17717-postmerge-QI7mut/sessions/live-state`，不是这个静态弹窗自己发出的请求；静默后复测仍按原来的零请求断言通过。这些都是有证据的夹具修正，不是为了掩盖失败而修改生产代码。

![终端入口可见，但模型 provision 失败；这不是成功的终端会话](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr17717-validation/terminal-entry-provisioning-failed.png)

第二张图只证明 Terminal 入口变得可见。模型 provision Turn 以 `Hosted Harness model authentication is unavailable` 失败，随后夹具在等待过期的 composer placeholder 时停止，尚未请求 ticket。没有取得当前树 ticket、101/`qwen-ws`、PTY 命令、resize 或重放结果。不能把这幅图解释为终端执行成功证明。

这些图片来自 `f8b464a6de`，没有重标为 `6e76965c76`；后续上游增量仅限无关的 goal-marker 测试、mock 支持和双语设计记录。先前合并前通过的终端链路仍只是历史证据，不代替当前终端验证。最后任务观察到四个监听端口均关闭；剩余的该任务 durable worker 另行收到 SIGTERM，最终跟踪的进程和浏览器列表为空。报告还记录模块本地验证预算已耗尽（包括装配共 734 秒），因此不会无限继续重试，剩余终端、CI 和人工验证均明确待完成。

### 已验证平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已验证 |

### 验证环境（可选）

Linux、Node v26.12.1、JDK 21、Maven 3.9.11 与任务本地 Maven 仓库。使用本地 build/typecheck/bundle、聚焦 Vitest 和 Maven 测试，以及独立驱动的真实 Java/Worker/Chromium 栈；所有运行时数据均使用任务所有的临时目录。

合并后的根 build、typecheck 和 bundle：全部在审计后的合并树上通过（退出码 0），最终 bundle 及资源已生成。

合并后的 TypeScript 聚焦测试：CLI 的 6 个选定文件中 247 个测试通过；相同文件中的另外 1020 个无关声明按过滤条件未执行。Web Shell 的 Managed capabilities 弹窗与 Sessions 页两个文件共 265 个测试全部通过。这些是聚焦测试，不表示完整仓库测试已全量运行。

刷新任务本地 sibling SDK 安装后，合并树的 Java `ManagedAgentApiContractTest` 25 个测试通过，零失败、零错误、零跳过；全部 Java 模块 Checkstyle 通过。

上游 workflow 元测试（包括发生变更的 `sdk-java.yml`）在合并树中通过全部 79 个测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：终端分发是在 daemon bearer 校验之前有意设置的窄范围例外，因为 Java 独立认证自己的一次性终端票。它仍只适用于 Managed 部署、原始精确终端路径、primary listener 和 loopback，并位于 Host/Origin 检查之后。握手转发会排除浏览器凭据及私有身份／签名头；双向 socket 和关闭清理都有聚焦测试和真实终端链路覆盖。
- 未验证／范围外：完整 CI、全部 Java 套件和 MySQL profiles 仍保留为 CI 门禁。缺失／畸形／跨会话票据、同数据目录重启后的持久化、断线重连／scrollback 重放、真实上游逐 header 审计、`--open` 浏览器清理和模型 provision Turn，只在独立验证报告明确实测时才声明。35 组当前跟踪的 daemon 专属界面仅作说明并指定归属，不新增实现，也不永久排除。SSH、resident、extension 和仓库级 worktree 仍不在范围内。
- 破坏性变更／迁移：没有新增 OpenAPI 路由或迁移。终端依赖分发器，因此本地 Managed 启动会明确拒绝 `QWEN_SERVE_ACP_HTTP=0`；普通 daemon 的 ACP 关闭行为不变。本地终端是人用 shell，不是模型工具：获授权操作者可以不经逐命令模型审批、以服务器 OS 账户运行任意命令，且没有容器隔离。用户指南记录了这一信任边界。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #17717
Refs #15084、#16546、#13396。

prs.title: fix(cli): attribute daemon log lines and bind late channel restores to the boot conflict decline
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Closes the two remaining gaps of the daemon incident report: log-line attribution and channel re-admission after a boot conflict decline. The SSE listener-cap defect (A) was already fixed by #17502 and #17662; the explicit-port fail-fast (B.1) is in #17534; offline occupancy (A.4) is deferred because the reserved listener headroom keeps `/health` reachable.

Daemon log lines become attributable per process: the stderr tee carries `pid=` and, once the listener is up, `port=`; file records gain `port=` after the existing `runId=`/`pid=`. The port is late-bound through a new `DaemonLogger.setPort` called with the actual listening port, so ephemeral port 0 and EADDRINUSE fallback both report the real port; pre-listen records carry pid only, and a caller's worker pid in context stays rendered alongside the daemon identity.

A daemon whose settings-derived channel selection was downgraded at boot because another instance held the channel-service lease no longer re-admits those channels through post-boot workspace registration. The registration hook skips the late restore while the decline stands — before consuming the workspace's once-per-run restore mark, alongside the existing operator-stop skip — so a refused workspace gets its restore back when an explicit selection commit clears the gate and it registers again. The automatic restore path keeps a defense-in-depth refusal; only a successful explicit commit clears the gate, a failed one leaves it set. The boot downgrade itself stays non-fatal: settings-derived channels must not block daemon startup.

## Why it's needed

In the reported incident, nine duplicate daemons shared one stdout sink whose lines carried no pid or port, so counter-based diagnosis (SSE opened minus closed) became unattributable once duplicates existed. Separately, a duplicate whose boot channel restore was declined for a lease conflict later ran channel workers anyway: the runtime lease re-check only sees the pidfile's current state, so once the holder's record disappeared (holder exit, stale sweep — the real reader returns null for stale records), a registering workspace's late restore acquired the lease and started side-effecting workers behind the operator's back, while the boot "Continuing without channels" decision was silently reversed. The first implementation of the gate refused after the once-per-run mark was consumed, which permanently spent a refused workspace's restore token and made the documented remedy (explicit commit) silently fail to restore it on re-registration; review caught this and the gate now skips before the mark, matching the operator-stop sibling.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Channel gate behavior suite (new file, 8 cases): `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/channel-boot-downgrade-readmission.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` — expect 8 passed. Cases: boot conflict downgrade then registration starts no workers (the reproduction, red before the fix); refusal stands while the holder record persists; a non-conflict downgrade still late-restores (gate is conflict-code-specific); an explicit commit clears the gate; the runtime lease re-check refuses independently without a boot downgrade; a refused workspace's restore fires after commit + remove + re-register (the token fix); a failed commit keeps the gate; post-listen file records carry the actual listening port (fixture boots with port 0).
2. Log identity suite: `npx vitest run src/serve/daemon-logger.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` — expect 65 passed, including tee pid-only → pid+port across `setPort`, file records (info/raw/queue-loss summary) gaining port only after `setPort`, caller ctx pid preserved, stderr-only mode identity.
3. Full channel/boot regression: `npx vitest run src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` — expect 567 passed (run with ambient `QWEN_*` unset; a serve session leaks `QWEN_SERVE_CLIENT_MCP_OVER_WS` etc. and reddens one startup-observability case otherwise).
4. Live daemon (bundled): start with a scratch workspace and isolated runtime dir; stderr shows pid-only before listening and pid+port after; the file boot record has no port; a second daemon forced onto the next port by EADDRINUSE logs its real fallback port. For the gate: fixture a live-holder channel-service pidfile record, boot with `serve.channels` configured (downgrade message names the holder), kill the holder, register a non-primary trusted workspace with its own `serve.channels` — expect INFO `skipping serve.channels for a workspace registered after boot: channel hosting was declined at boot`, no channel worker children, no lease re-reservation; then a successful explicit `PUT /workspace/channel` (a credential-free webhook adapter works) clears the gate, and remove + re-register fires the restore.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change (log lines and channel admission). Before: tee lines `[DAEMON] route=… request completed` with no identity; a downgraded duplicate started channel workers on post-boot registration once the holder record vanished. After (live, bundled daemon): `2026-11-20T04:05:50.116Z [INFO] [DAEMON] runId=c0b4d058… pid=2679367 port=43279 workspaceCwd=/tmp/…/secondary skipping serve.channels for a workspace registered after boot: channel hosting was declined at boot`; after a successful commit, remove + re-register logs `restoring serve.channels for a workspace registered after boot` and the secondary worker becomes ready. Two live verification rounds (the second on the review-revised mechanism) plus a 5-mutation matrix (hook gate removal, commit-clear removal, unconditional gate, setPort wiring removal, drop-summary port removal) each killed by exactly its intended tests; the reproduction was deterministically red on the pre-fix tree (3 consecutive runs).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Alibaba Cloud Linux 3 x86_64, Node v26.12.1, vitest 3.2.7; live arms against `node dist/cli.js` (build + bundle from this tree) with isolated `QWEN_HOME`/`QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` and credential-free webhook adapters; `tsc --build` (8G heap), eslint, prettier clean. Two pre-existing suite reds attributed and unrelated: the ACP-SSE-count case fails identically on the clean base tree (stash A/B, Node 26 environment), and the MCP-drain case is a load-sensitive flake (green in isolation).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the gate could refuse a legitimate late restore. Bounded: it is set only on the real `channel_service_conflict` error code at boot (a transient pidfile write failure does not gate — pinned by a negative control), it clears on a successful explicit commit, and the no-conflict registration path is unchanged (pinned). The refusal is fail-closed: it never hosts more than before, only declines automatic re-admission the boot already refused.
- Not validated / out of scope: a full two-real-daemon E2E with real channel adapters (no credentials; covered by single-daemon live arms with real pidfile/holder/worker-fork, the behavior suite, and mutations); macOS/Windows; offline occupancy (A.4, deferred — headroom keeps `/health` reachable); explicit-port fail-fast (B.1, in #17534). Test-fixture deduplication with the late-registration harness is deferred to the #17554 follow-up hygiene work.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Log identity fields are additive; no production consumer parses the tee shape (the desktop smoke teardown extracts `pid=` from file lines, whose identity prefix is unchanged). Channel refusal only occurs in the conflict-decline window that previously re-admitted workers silently.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17479 (partial: B.2 channel re-admission + B.3 log attribution; defect A fixed by #17502/#17662, B.1 in #17534, A.4 deferred — the issue stays open until those land or are dispositioned)

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

闭合事故报告剩余的两个缺口：日志行归属与 boot 冲突降级后的 channel 重新准入。SSE listener 上限缺陷（A）已由 #17502/#17662 修复；显式端口 fail-fast（B.1）在 #17534；离线占用（A.4）暂缓——预留余量已保证 `/health` 恒可达。

daemon 日志行按进程可归属：stderr tee 带 `pid=`，监听后带 `port=`；文件行在既有 `runId=`/`pid=` 后新增 `port=`。端口经新增的 `DaemonLogger.setPort` 以实际监听端口迟绑定，临时端口 0 与 EADDRINUSE 回退都报真实端口；监听前记录仅带 pid，调用方上下文里的 worker pid 仍与 daemon 身份并列渲染。

boot 时因另一实例持有 channel-service 租约而降级的 settings 派生选择，不再经 boot 后工作区注册重新准入。注册钩子在降级存续期内跳过 late restore——在消耗该工作区「每运行一次」恢复名额之前、与既有 operator-stop 跳过并列——因此被拒工作区在显式提交清门后重新注册能拿回恢复。自动恢复路径保留纵深防御拒绝；仅成功的显式提交清门，失败提交保门。boot 降级本身仍非致命：settings 派生 channel 不得阻止 daemon 启动。

## 为什么需要

事故中九个副本 daemon 共享一个 stdout sink，行内无 pid/port，副本出现后基于计数器的诊断（SSE opened 减 closed）无法归属。另一方面，boot 因租约冲突被拒的副本后来仍跑起了 channel worker：运行时租约重检只看 pidfile 当前状态，holder 记录消失后（holder 退出、stale 清扫——真实读取器对 stale 记录返回 null），注册工作区的 late restore 取得租约并在运维背后启动副作用 worker，boot 的「Continuing without channels」决定被静默推翻。门控的第一版实现在名额消耗之后拒绝，永久花费被拒工作区的恢复令牌，使文档补救（显式提交）在重新注册时静默失效；评审抓住此点，门控现在打标前跳过，与 operator-stop 兄弟一致。

## 评审验证计划

见英文部分：8 用例行为套件（含复现 red→green、名额恢复、失败提交保门、端口接线）、65 用例日志身份套件、567 用例 boot/channel 全量回归（剥离环境泄漏变量）、bundled daemon 两轮 live 验证（第二轮用免凭据 webhook 适配器实机演示成功提交清门 + 名额恢复）、5 变异矩阵各被其目标测试杀死。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：门控可能拒绝合法 late restore。有界：仅 boot 真实 `channel_service_conflict` 错误码置位（瞬时 pidfile 写失败不置门——负向对照钉住），成功显式提交清门，无冲突注册路径不变（钉住）。拒绝方向 fail-closed：只会少托管，不会多托管。
- 未验证/范围外：双真实 daemon + 真实适配器完整 E2E（无凭据；单 daemon 实机 + 行为套件 + 变异覆盖）；macOS/Windows；A.4 离线占用（暂缓）；B.1（#17534）。测试夹具去重延至 #17554 后续整洁工作。
- 破坏性变更：无。日志身份字段 additive；无生产消费方解析 tee 形状（desktop smoke teardown 从文件行提取 `pid=`，身份前缀未变）。channel 拒绝仅发生在此前静默重新准入的冲突降级窗口。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #17479（部分：B.2 + B.3；A 已由 #17502/#17662 修复，B.1 在 #17534，A.4 暂缓——issue 保持开放直至那些落地或处置）

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): open effort picker from the OpenTUI footer
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The reasoning-effort tier in the OpenTUI footer status line becomes clickable. Clicking the tier (for example `high` or `max`) opens the existing effort picker with the displayed tier preselected, and choosing a row applies and persists it through the same `useEffortCommand` path as Ink's `/effort`. Footer-opened picks are shown in the transcript but are not recorded as a typed `/effort` command. A click is distinguished from a drag-select release by checking whether the renderer selection contains text, which keeps compatibility with the selection auto-copy work. The model name and every other status-line run stay inert, and the footer opener remains disabled while a turn is streaming.

## Why it's needed

The footer already displays the tier, so making users type `/effort` is avoidable friction. This PR makes that existing tier a direct control while deliberately keeping effort persistence identical to Ink: the pick applies at runtime and writes `model.reasoningEffort` to the scope returned by `getPersistScopeForModelSelection`. Static provider/global effort knobs are user configuration and are left untouched, so the existing escape-hatch semantics and `formatEffortChangeMessage` feedback remain the same in both renderers. Ink is unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Build and launch the CLI with `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui` and a model that exposes effort tiers (DeepSeek-V4.x, GPT-5.x, tiered Qwen, or a model with `capabilities.reasoning.efforts`).

Confirm the footer shows `<model> <tier>`. Click only the tier; the picker should open with that tier preselected. Click the model name, any text after the tier, or use a non-left button; nothing should happen. Drag-select footer text that ends on the tier; it should copy without opening the picker, while a plain click still opens it.

Pick a different tier. The picker should apply it and write `model.reasoningEffort` to the same scope Ink's `/effort` uses. Provider/global static effort keys and provider arrays should remain untouched. If a static knob outranks the pick, the footer re-renders from the display path (which can show the picked tier) while the request keeps the static value; only the generic `formatEffortChangeMessage` wording applies. Restart and confirm the persisted tier behaves exactly as it does after Ink's `/effort`.

Toggle-only models, models whose displayed reasoning has no tier, and a displayed tier outside the model's ladder should show no click target. The footer opener should also be disabled while streaming. `/effort` should behave as before.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the footer tier is plain text; only `/effort` can change it, and static provider/global effort knobs remain user-configured escape hatches.

After: the tier is clickable, the picker preselects it, and the pick runs the same runtime-apply and settings-write path as Ink's `/effort`. Static provider/global knobs and provider arrays remain untouched; no JSONC/provider rewrite is performed. Footer picks are not recorded as typed `/effort`.

Local verification after the final refactor: `dialogs-modes.test.tsx` 100 tests pass, `opentui-footer.test.tsx` 63 tests pass, plus `tsc --noEmit`, ESLint, and Prettier. A fresh PTY/manual run after this simplification is still pending; the earlier PTY evidence was for the removed static-cleanup behavior and is intentionally not reused.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

Local source build under Node 22; OpenTUI uses the bundled Bun 1.4.4 runtime.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the footer picker writes `model.reasoningEffort`. It performs no provider-array write, no `model.generationConfig` cleanup, and no live/registry static-key stripping, matching Ink's `/effort` exactly. Static provider/global knobs are preserved and can still outrank the persisted tier; this PR intentionally does not add a second warning or change that documented escape-hatch behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: a fresh PTY/manual run after the simplification; macOS/Windows manual runs; System/SystemDefaults-owned static effort; provider-specific budget knobs (`thinking_budget`, `budget_tokens`, `thinkingLevel`); selection-copy visually re-checked after the selection-clipboard PR lands.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Ink is unchanged. This PR removes the earlier static-key cleanup behavior; the picker now persists exactly like Ink's `/effort`.

Design docs: [English](https://github.com/MikeWang0316tw/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-clickable-effort/docs/design/2026-11-19-opentui-footer-effort-picker.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/MikeWang0316tw/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-clickable-effort/docs/design/2026-11-19-opentui-footer-effort-picker.zh-CN.md)

prs.title: feat(cli): polish terminal layout and streaming interactions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps the composer at the bottom, centers bounded dialogs over the transcript, and places approval mode beside its cycling shortcut on the input's lower-right border in main and agent views. Virtual scrolling uses smaller paced updates; transcript, preview, and input share consistent drag selection and copying.

Shows completed safe tool/thought activity as muted summaries. Expanding reveals compact command/path rows and retains a clickable collapse header; Ctrl+O reaches original full details. Closing a process clears its expanded children, and independently virtualized members retain their own viewport visibility.

Uses fixed deadlines for streamed state updates and terminal drawing, reuses stable Markdown prefixes and unchanged code-line highlights, and keeps original stream-boundary ordering. Actual controls-height measurement and consistent virtual-message budgets keep advancing text and the final transcript line visible when the footer or auxiliary panels change height.

## Why it's needed

Short conversations left the input above unused space; large settings/session dialogs could overflow. Repeated process details competed with answers, and opening a tool summary could not be reversed. Selection could include popup borders or trigger expansion on release, while approval mode and its shortcut appeared in different places.

Regular small text chunks still appeared in uneven groups. A full new buffering window after each batch introduced avoidable waiting, and stable Markdown/code was processed repeatedly. Long pending paragraphs could hide their advancing tail in short virtual viewports. A stale controls-height budget could also clip the final checkpoint name from `/restore` until scrolling corrected it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start an empty session and open `/settings`, `/resume`, model, theme and permission dialogs. The composer should stay at the bottom; dialogs should remain centered and bounded, with the draft restored afterward. Check main and agent inputs: mode and cycling shortcut should share the lower-right border, without a duplicate footer hint. Resize narrow and restore.
2. Run reads, commands and thinking. Completed safe activity should use a muted summary, while live work, failures and approvals remain visible. Click to open compact details, click the retained header to close, and use Ctrl+O for original output. Repeat during and after generation; opening a child then closing its parent should leave the process closed.
3. Scroll slowly, rapidly and in reverse; use PageUp/Home/End and drag the scrollbar. One upward row should remain detached as content arrives. Drag ASCII, Chinese and multiline text in transcript, preview and main/agent input: copied text should match the highlight and exclude borders. Releasing a selection on a summary should not toggle it; an ordinary click should.
4. Stream prose, Chinese, open code and Markdown/list/table content. Updates should advance with less repeated work and retain the exact final suffix. Resize and change rendering context; completed prefixes, syntax colors, gutters and copy hints should remain correct. A long paragraph should keep advancing before completion in a short virtual viewport.
5. Cancel during buffered output and stream reasoning-to-answer, tool-to-answer and inline-image transitions. Preserve the received tail and ordering. Native scrollback and screen-reader modes should retain their existing layout and completion behavior. Do not infer a physical terminal frame rate from a timer setting.
6. Open and close completion, shortcuts and auxiliary panels after history overflows. The final transcript line should remain visible. List checkpoints with `/restore`, then hot-restore and cold-resume one; the name, files and retained conversation should agree without a scroll workaround.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Installed CLI layout | Bottom-composer layout |
| --- | --- |
| ![Installed CLI](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/images/tui-workspace/before-installed.png?raw=true) | ![Bottom composer](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/images/tui-workspace/after-startup.png?raw=true) |

These earlier layout captures use isolated fake providers and synthetic data. The installed CLI reports a 0.25.0 banner and is an environment comparison, not a rebuilt PR base. Separate E2E reports record the later pointer, expansion and approval-shortcut checks with their exact artifacts.

With identical synthetic payloads in real PTYs, Chinese visible-marker gap P95 changes from 67ms to 51ms; ASCII remains 51ms. Server-marker-to-visible lag P95 changes from 59/65/93ms to 52/50/88ms for ASCII/Chinese/mixed Markdown. Mixed Markdown visible-gap P95 rises from 117ms to 134ms, so this is not a uniform improvement across all intervals. All five final payloads, including bursts and an 80-line open code block, match exactly.

In a separate controlled 72-update renderer profile, body-write gap P95 changes from 34.73/37.61/38.58ms to 19.77/20.40/19.97ms for prose/labeled code/unlabeled code. Repeated highlighting of unchanged code lines drops from 1296 calls to zero. This profile excludes the application event buffer and native terminal presentation.

Full build, repository typecheck, bundle, focused unit tests, scoped lint/format checks and clean Ink patch application pass. The separate streaming E2E comment records the baseline, candidate and final measurements, exact-content checks, coverage and exclusions.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Real PTYs, Canary/xterm, main and Arena agent views |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not runtime tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not runtime tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 26.13.1; default Ink renderer; loopback fake providers; isolated settings, sessions, workspace and clipboard shim. Automated pointer checks use standard SGR through Canary/xterm. The user confirmed transcript dragging in Warp; this is not a native Warp/Grok frame-rate comparison.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: shared viewport geometry, pointer ownership, cache invalidation and the existing Ink patch affect terminal behavior. Frozen prefixes are conservative; unfinished text/code still requires work, and very large provider bursts can appear in one update.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/Linux runtime interaction and full OpenTUI parity. Arena retains its committed-round display. No output worker or physical VSync acknowledgement is introduced, and no fixed visible 60/120 FPS is promised.
- Known follow-up: continuing one unfinished answer can shift a detached viewport toward older content. The same 16-row shift reproduces in archived pre-increment source with pinned Ink and a test-only JSX runtime shim; this auxiliary replay establishes behavior, not binary timing. The limitation is retained for a focused viewport fix and is not claimed resolved here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no configuration migration, provider/protocol change or permission-policy change. Input selection copies text; editable replacement ranges are not added. Native scrollback retains its height safety limits.

Designs: [visual hierarchy — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/tui-visual-hierarchy.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/tui-visual-hierarchy.zh-CN.md); [workspace layout — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/53d4cbd95f513d4511fc666fb96258c6d58384d7/docs/design/tui-workspace-layout.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/53d4cbd95f513d4511fc666fb96258c6d58384d7/docs/design/tui-workspace-layout.zh-CN.md); [scrolling and selection — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/43275f059d96d46a2f926ef1519e56bd83848adc/docs/design/tui-pointer-and-composer.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/43275f059d96d46a2f926ef1519e56bd83848adc/docs/design/tui-pointer-and-composer.zh-CN.md); [streaming and controls — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/507e7dfc5410be0460279d503cb4ce3329e55b72/docs/design/tui-streaming-cadence.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/507e7dfc5410be0460279d503cb4ce3329e55b72/docs/design/tui-streaming-cadence.zh-CN.md); [incremental streaming — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/116632670d512725dbeedfb8ae523c55a1bf88c7/docs/design/tui-incremental-streaming.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/116632670d512725dbeedfb8ae523c55a1bf88c7/docs/design/tui-incremental-streaming.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

N/A — locally reported UI issues.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

将输入框固定在底部，让有尺寸约束的弹窗居中悬浮在聊天区上方，并在主视图和 agent 输入框右下边框，将权限模式与切换快捷键并排显示。虚拟滚动采用较小的按帧位移，聊天区、预览和输入文字采用一致的拖选、复制行为。

将已完成的安全工具和思考过程显示为淡色摘要。展开显示紧凑的命令、路径明细，并保留可点击的收起标题；Ctrl+O 可以查看原始完整详情。收起父过程时清理已展开子项，各个独立虚拟行仍保留自身的视口可见状态。

流式状态更新和终端绘制采用固定截止时间，复用稳定 Markdown 前缀和未变化代码行的高亮，并保留原有流事件边界顺序。跟踪控件的实际高度，并统一虚拟消息的内容预算，使文字持续推进，底部栏和辅助面板改变高度后聊天区最后一行仍可见。

## 为什么需要

短对话的输入框原本悬在空白上方，大型设置和会话弹窗可能溢出。重复过程详情会抢占回答的注意力，打开工具摘要后也无法收起。选择文字可能复制到弹窗边框或在松手时触发展开，权限模式与快捷键也出现在不同位置。

持续到达的小文字分片仍会不均匀地成批出现。每批结束后再等待一个完整缓冲窗口会引入额外等待，稳定 Markdown 和代码也被反复处理。长段落在较矮的虚拟视口里可能藏住正在增长的尾部，控件高度预算过时还会裁掉 `/restore` 的最后一个检查点名，直到滚动触发修正。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 启动空会话，打开 `/settings`、`/resume`、模型、主题和权限弹窗。输入框应保持底部，弹窗应居中且有尺寸约束，关闭后恢复草稿。主输入和 agent 输入的权限模式、切换提示应在右下边框同一组，页脚没有重复提示。缩窄窗口，再恢复。
2. 运行读取、命令和思考。完成的安全过程应采用淡色摘要，运行中活动、失败和审批保持可见。点击打开紧凑明细，再点保留的标题收起，Ctrl+O 查看原始输出。在生成中和完成后分别重复；打开子项再收起父过程，应保持关闭。
3. 缓慢、快速和反向滚动，使用 PageUp/Home/End，并拖动滚动条。向上一行后，新内容到来时保持脱离底部。在聊天、预览、主输入和 agent 输入拖选 ASCII、中文和多行文字，复制应与高亮一致、不含边框。拖选到摘要松手不应切换状态，普通点击可以。
4. 流式输出正文、中文、开放代码和 Markdown、列表、表格。更新应减少重复工作并保留准确最终尾部。缩放窗口并切换渲染上下文，稳定前缀、语法颜色、行号和复制提示仍正确。长段落在较矮虚拟视口里应在完成前持续推进。
5. 在存在缓冲文字时取消，并验证思考转回答、工具转回答和内联图片转换。保留已接收尾部和顺序。原生回滚、读屏模式保留既有布局及完成行为，不将定时器设置视为实际终端帧率。
6. 历史溢出后打开、关闭补全、快捷键和辅助面板，聊天区最后一行应保持可见。用 `/restore` 列出检查点，再执行热恢复和冷启动恢复，显示的名称、文件和保留对话应一致，无需滚动补救。

### 证据（改动前后）

| 已安装 CLI 布局 | 底部输入框布局 |
| --- | --- |
| ![已安装 CLI](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/images/tui-workspace/before-installed.png?raw=true) | ![底部输入框](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/images/tui-workspace/after-startup.png?raw=true) |

这些较早的布局截图使用隔离模拟模型和合成数据。已安装 CLI 的启动标识为 0.25.0，属于环境对照，不是重建的 PR 基线。独立 E2E 报告记录后续指针、展开及权限快捷键验证和对应准确产物。

相同合成内容在真实 PTY 中回放，中文可见标记间隔 P95 从 67ms 变为 51ms，ASCII 仍为 51ms。ASCII、中文、混合 Markdown 的服务端标记到可见延迟 P95 从 59/65/93ms 变为 52/50/88ms。混合 Markdown 的可见间隔 P95 从 117ms 增至 134ms，因此并非所有间隔都一致改善。五个场景的最终内容均完整一致，包括突发分片和 80 行开放代码块。

独立的 72 次更新受控渲染器测量中，正文、有语言代码、无语言代码的写入间隔 P95 从 34.73/37.61/38.58ms 变为 19.77/20.40/19.97ms。未变化代码行的重复高亮从 1296 次降至零。此测量不包含应用事件缓冲和原生终端实际呈现。

完整构建、仓库类型检查、bundle、定点单测、范围内 lint 和格式检查及 Ink 补丁干净应用均通过。独立流式 E2E 评论记录基线、候选及最终测量、完整文字检查、覆盖和排除项。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 真实 PTY、Canary/xterm、主视图和 Arena agent 视图 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未做运行验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未做运行验证 |

### 环境（可选）

Node.js 26.13.1；默认 Ink 渲染器；本机回环模拟模型；隔离的设置、会话、工作区和剪贴板替身。自动化指针检查通过 Canary/xterm 的标准 SGR 完成。用户已确认 Warp 主聊天拖选正常，这不是原生 Warp/Grok 帧率对比。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：共享视口几何、指针归属、缓存失效和现有 Ink 补丁影响终端行为。前缀冻结采取保守边界，未完成文字和代码仍需计算，极大的模型分片也可能一次显示。
- 未验证或不在范围内：Windows/Linux 运行交互和完整 OpenTUI 对齐。Arena 保留按已完成轮次显示。没有新增输出线程或实际屏幕 VSync 反馈，也不承诺固定每秒 60/120 可见帧。
- 已知后续事项：同一条未完成回答继续输出时，脱离底部的视口可能向较早内容移动。改动前的归档源码、固定 Ink 和仅测试使用的 JSX 运行时替身可复现相同的 16 行位移；该辅助回放只用于确认行为，不用于二进制性能对比。此限制留待单独修复视口，不宣称已在这里解决。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：无需配置迁移，不改变模型、协议或权限策略。输入选区用于复制，不增加可替换的编辑选区。原生回滚保留高度安全限制。

设计：[视觉层级 — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/tui-visual-hierarchy.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/tui-visual-hierarchy.zh-CN.md)；[工作区布局 — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/53d4cbd95f513d4511fc666fb96258c6d58384d7/docs/design/tui-workspace-layout.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/53d4cbd95f513d4511fc666fb96258c6d58384d7/docs/design/tui-workspace-layout.zh-CN.md)；[滚动与选择 — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/43275f059d96d46a2f926ef1519e56bd83848adc/docs/design/tui-pointer-and-composer.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/43275f059d96d46a2f926ef1519e56bd83848adc/docs/design/tui-pointer-and-composer.zh-CN.md)；[流式与控件 — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/507e7dfc5410be0460279d503cb4ce3329e55b72/docs/design/tui-streaming-cadence.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/507e7dfc5410be0460279d503cb4ce3329e55b72/docs/design/tui-streaming-cadence.zh-CN.md)；[流式增量渲染 — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/116632670d512725dbeedfb8ae523c55a1bf88c7/docs/design/tui-incremental-streaming.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/116632670d512725dbeedfb8ae523c55a1bf88c7/docs/design/tui-incremental-streaming.zh-CN.md)。

prs.body:
## Why it's needed

The managed `/loop` deferred-review-pins work landed as #17594 (squash `4612552f46`, 2026-11-20T03:51:54Z, approved by yiliang114 and qqqys), but its bilingual design record still opens with `Status: proposed`. A reader landing on the record cannot tell that the work shipped, which head the verification belongs to, or where the remaining hardening lives. This refreshes the status header only — the record body is a historical ledger and is left untouched.

## What changes

Both language versions gain the same three header facts, kept in sync: the merged state with the pull request, the squash commit and the merge timestamp plus the two approvers; a one-paragraph verification ledger for the merged head; and the follow-up destinations. Nothing below the header changes, and no code, contract or generated asset is touched.

The verification ledger records what was actually run at the merged head rather than a claim of green: fourteen review rounds and three independent verification rounds folded in, the core parity suite, the scripts meta suites, the cli locale-coverage suite, the Java consumer of the regenerated sidecars, the neighbouring core surface run whole rather than sampled, and both packaged arms re-run after a full rebuild with their session identifiers and the scheduled-fire occurrence key. It also states that all four required checks passed, and points at the record below for every mutation witness, every byte-equal restore and every CI attribution.

The follow-ups point at the existing hardening issue, which now carries six open items including the executed-decision seam that ends the spelling-evasion family, and at the newly filed windows-latest issue for the Java lane whose fixture passes an over-long capture payload through argv. Both were measured and attributed in the record; neither is fixed here.

## Reviewer Test Plan

**How to verify:** open both language versions and confirm the header states merged with the same squash commit, timestamp and approvers, that the verification numbers match the record's final round, and that the two follow-up links resolve to open issues. Confirm the two versions still mirror each other in section and bullet count, and that the diff touches nothing below the header.

**Before:** the record opens as a proposal even though the work is on main. **After:** it opens as merged, with the verification belonging to a named head and the residual hardening reachable in one click.

N/A (non-UI). Formatting was checked on both files; no test, build or runtime surface is affected.

prs.title: fix(cli): report terminal model errors in headless JSON output
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps terminal failures inside reusable stream-json sessions: failed turns emit one error result without exiting the host process or running process-wide cleanup. This includes tool/time budgets, local and cumulative session turn limits, and non-recoverable turn cancellation. Recoverable SDK interrupts keep their existing continuation behavior. Provider control characters are neutralized when rendered to stderr, while the original error value is preserved.

Background task callbacks belong to the reusable session. Started/completion notifications stay paired during stream cancellation and EOF draining, and completed turns do not wait indefinitely for in-flight background agents. The documentation explains that EOF cancels unfinished background work, that wall-time/tool-call budgets reset for each user or notification turn, and that the core session turn cap remains cumulative.

## Why it is needed

At the current merge base, terminal provider errors already fail across output formats. The remaining problem is ownership: process-level handlers can terminate a reusable SDK host, and queued notification/result handling can lose terminal signals or emit duplicate results. After preserving the host, cumulative turn-limit events must also remain failures instead of becoming empty successful results.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- In a reusable stream-json session, trigger a tool/time budget or a cancelled turn and verify one terminal error result. Interrupt a turn through the SDK and verify a later normal message still receives a response.
- Exhaust the cumulative session turn cap. The host must remain alive; later messages must explicitly fail without another model request. Start a new session to continue.
- Verify one-shot turn-limit and cancellation exits remain 53 and 130. Supply a provider error containing terminal controls and verify stderr is neutralized while structured/raw error data remains intact.
- Close stdin while background agents are running. Each started task must receive its cancellation notification without starting a new model turn. Keep stdin open when waiting for a background agent’s output.

### Validation

Validation: 308 relevant unit tests passed (1 pre-existing skip); full build, typecheck, bundle, changed-file ESLint and Prettier passed. Independent verification passed 4 source probes and 7 CLI E2E scenarios on macOS with deterministic localhost providers, including cumulative-cap errors, interruption recovery, and one-shot exits 53/130.

Validation used macOS and deterministic localhost providers with dummy credentials. These results do not establish Windows/Linux runtime or real remote-provider behavior. The isolated bare-abort source probe supplements the CLI signal checks.

## Risk & Scope

- Reusable hosts receive per-turn error results and retain ownership of process shutdown. An exhausted cumulative session turn cap is not reset automatically.
- There is no shared wall-time/tool-call budget across user and notification turns, and no new typed budget discriminator in the public SDK envelope; the failure reason is in error.message.
- No configuration migration or public SDK schema change is introduced.

## Linked Issues

Related to #11217 and #8920. Rate-limit retry changes belong to #11216.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动与原因

让可复用 stream-json 会话中的失败回合输出一次错误结果，并由宿主保留进程退出和全局清理的控制权。覆盖时间和工具预算、单次调用及累计会话回合上限、普通取消；SDK 的可恢复中断继续支持后续回合。stderr 渲染会过滤服务商错误中的终端控制字符，同时保留原始错误值。

当前合并基已经让各输出格式正确处理模型终止错误。本 PR 处理剩余的宿主生命周期、重复结果和通知清理问题；进程不再被回合上限终止后，也确保核心层的累计上限事件不会变成空的成功结果。

后台任务回调由可复用会话持有，在取消和 EOF 清理时保持开始/结束通知成对。回合结果不无限等待后台任务；stdin EOF 会取消未完成任务，若需要其输出应保持 stdin 打开。时间与工具预算按用户/通知回合重置，核心会话回合上限仍然累计，耗尽后需新建会话继续。

## 验证与范围

独立复现并验证了宿主不退出、单一错误结果、累计上限后的明确失败、SDK 中断后继续应答、单次运行退出码 53/130，以及 stderr 控制字符过滤。相关单元测试、完整 build/typecheck/bundle 和改动文件检查已通过，英文验证段给出本轮具体结果。使用 macOS、localhost 确定性服务和假凭据，未据此宣称 Windows/Linux 或真实远端服务验证通过。

不新增跨回合共享的时间/工具预算，也不修改 SDK envelope schema；预算原因仍通过 error.message 表达。无需配置迁移。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): pass the external worker capture payloads in the boot document
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The external foreground-Shell worker stand-in in the Runtime Broker verification suite previously received captured stdout/stderr through command-line arguments. These payloads now travel in the boot document already written to the worker's stdin, so capture size no longer increases the command-line length. A cross-platform regression guard rejects commands whose space-joined argument strings exceed 32766 UTF-16 code units, reserving one code unit for the terminating NUL in the 32767-unit limit. It detects the oversized-payload regression but does not model Windows argument quoting; passing this lower-bound check does not guarantee that the serialized command line fits.

## Why it's needed

The existing large-capture protocol case constructs a 32780-character payload, larger than the Windows CreateProcess command-line limit of 32767 characters including the terminating NUL. Passing that payload as an argument causes the worker startup failure reported in #17885. Moving both captured streams to stdin removes that source of command-line growth without reducing the capture or changing the publication protocol.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- From `packages/managed-agent-server`, run `mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress '-Dtest=ExternalShellWorkerProtocolTest,ExternalShellProducerPublicationTest' -pl verification -am test`. Confirm that the large multiblock capture preserves its bytes, including the UTF-8 character crossing a block boundary; empty streams still reach EOF; nonempty stderr and the existing exit-code, pending-read and refusal cases retain their behavior.
- Historical macOS evidence for the initial payload-move implementation, before this follow-up: `ExternalShellWorkerProtocolTest` passed all 12 tests, and `ExternalShellProducerPublicationTest` passed all 9 tests in the wider reactor run (JDK 25). The same two suites were then rerun under the required toolchain — Temurin JDK 21.0.13.1 with a task-isolated `-Dmaven.repo.local` — and passed again: 12/12 and 9/9, `BUILD SUCCESS`. These are the two suites that call the fixture, including its saved-binding overload.
- Recorded regression evidence: before moving the payloads off argv, the added guard rejected the large-capture case with `AssertionError: The worker command line is 32976 characters, over the Windows CreateProcess limit of 32767; pass capture payloads in the boot document, not as arguments`. This is a cross-platform size check, not a native reproduction of Windows `CreateProcess error=206`. The measured length depends on the checkout path.
- On Windows CI with JDK 21, confirm that the large-capture case starts its worker and completes without the reported `CreateProcess error=206`. The supplied evidence contains no Windows or Linux execution result; full-lane acceptance remains pending CI.

The supplied follow-up logs record 15 protocol tests and 9 producer tests passing under JDK 25, plus a successful Checkstyle invocation. An additional local guard matrix now covers accepted joins of 32765 and 32766 UTF-16 units and rejected joins of 32767, 32768 and 32780 units, including separators and supplementary Unicode characters. This final tree contains 16 protocol tests and 9 producer tests. The final-tree logs now record Temurin JDK 21.0.13.1 passes: 16 protocol tests and 9 producer tests, with no failures, errors or skips, plus zero Checkstyle violations. The Surefire XML confirms the JDK and test counts. These commands ran the verification module against artifacts in the default Maven cache; a follow-up source-matched run then rebuilt the qwencode SDK and all thirteen managed-agent modules from this tree's own sources under the same Temurin JDK 21.0.13.1 with a task-isolated `-Dmaven.repo.local` (reactor summary: every module `BUILD SUCCESS`), and the same two suites passed there as well — 16 protocol tests and 9 producer tests, 25/25, zero Checkstyle violations. Required CI acceptance on this revision remains pending, as before. An earlier attempt stopped before Maven started because its JDK path was absent; the later successful run supersedes that attempt, not the CI gaps.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-facing change. The recorded before/after evidence is the guard failure and the successful protocol and producer tests described above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

The supplied full verification-reactor run reported 6658 tests, 41 failures, 1 error and 44 skips. Its failures were confined to `SessionRecoveryInitialStateTest` (36 failures), `SessionResourceCollectionCollectorTest` (4 failures), `ManagedSessionStoreIntegrationTest` (1 failure) and `ToolPublicationStoreTest` (1 error). The supplied baseline comparison reports the same counts in those four classes on the unmodified tree. The missing `packages/core/dist` prerequisite was identified for the session-recovery failures; it is not established as the cause of every failing class. This was not a successful full-reactor run.

### Environment (optional)

The initial implementation’s recorded local runs used macOS arm64, Temurin OpenJDK 21.0.13.1 (the module's required toolchain), Maven 3.9.9 with a task-isolated `-Dmaven.repo.local`, and Node.js v22.23.2, with the implementation based on `e8cdbe44`. Under JDK 21: `ExternalShellWorkerProtocolTest` 12/12, `ExternalShellProducerPublicationTest` 9/9, `mvn checkstyle:check` zero violations across all modules. Earlier recorded runs used OpenJDK 25.0.2 (protocol suite 12/12, producer suite 9/9 in the wider reactor, Checkstyle and Prettier clean). The changed worker resource passes `prettier --check`. Native Windows and Linux execution remains pending CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the Java fixture and its JavaScript stand-in must agree on the two boot-document payload fields. The fixture is the only tracked launcher of this resource; its direct callers are the protocol suite and the producer-publication suite. The latter also exercises nonempty stderr and the saved-binding overload.
- Not validated / out of scope: native Windows and Linux execution and the required full-lane CI gates remain pending. The final-tree JDK 21 evidence includes the source-built isolated reactor run of the two selected suites and verification-module Checkstyle; it is focused local evidence, not a successful full-suite or CI acceptance result. The earlier default-cache run is recorded separately above. The guard measures unquoted argument strings, not the serialized Windows command line. Production TypeScript worker code, public schemas and publication request/response shapes are unchanged; the added boot fields are private to this stand-in.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no shipped API or migration change. The installer byte difference in the review snapshot is solely LF-to-CRLF checkout conversion required by `.gitattributes`; its Git blob is unchanged and it is not an outgoing installer change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17885

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

Runtime Broker 验证套件中的外部前台 Shell worker 替身此前通过命令行参数接收捕获的 stdout/stderr。现在这些负载改走已经写入 worker stdin 的 boot 文档，因此捕获大小不再增加命令行长度。一个跨平台回归守卫会拒绝以空格连接的参数字符串超过 32766 个 UTF-16 代码单元的命令，为 32767 单元上限内的末尾 NUL 留出一个代码单元。它能检出大负载回归，但不模拟 Windows 参数引号；通过该下界检查并不保证序列化后的命令行符合上限。

## 为什么需要

已有的大捕获协议用例会构造 32780 字符的负载，超过 Windows CreateProcess 包含末尾 NUL 在内的 32767 字符命令行上限。将该负载作为参数传递，会导致 #17885 报告的 worker 启动失败。把两个捕获流改走 stdin，可消除这部分命令行增长，而不缩减捕获内容或改变发布协议。

## 审阅者验证计划

### 如何验证

- 在 `packages/managed-agent-server` 中运行 `mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress '-Dtest=ExternalShellWorkerProtocolTest,ExternalShellProducerPublicationTest' -pl verification -am test`。确认跨多个块的大捕获保留全部字节，包括跨块边界的 UTF-8 字符；空流仍能到达 EOF；非空 stderr 以及既有退出码、待读取和拒绝用例的行为保持不变。
- 本次跟进之前、最初负载迁移实现的 macOS 历史记录证据：`ExternalShellWorkerProtocolTest` 的 12 个测试全部通过，`ExternalShellProducerPublicationTest` 的 9 个测试在更广的反应堆运行中全部通过（JDK 25）。随后在同一实现上以所要求的工具链——Temurin JDK 21.0.13.1 配任务隔离的 `-Dmaven.repo.local`——复跑这两个套件，再次全部通过：12/12 与 9/9，`BUILD SUCCESS`。这两个套件调用该 fixture，也涵盖其已保存绑定的重载。
- 已记录的回归证据：在负载移出 argv 之前，新增守卫在大捕获用例中报出 `AssertionError: The worker command line is 32976 characters, over the Windows CreateProcess limit of 32767; pass capture payloads in the boot document, not as arguments`。这是跨平台的大小检查，不是 Windows `CreateProcess error=206` 的原生复现。所测长度取决于检出路径。
- 在使用 JDK 21 的 Windows CI 上，确认大捕获用例能够启动 worker 并完成，不再出现所报告的 `CreateProcess error=206`。所提供证据不含 Windows 或 Linux 执行结果；整条 lane 的验收仍等待 CI。

所提供的跟进日志记录了 JDK 25 下 15 个协议测试和 9 个生产者测试通过，以及一次成功的 Checkstyle 调用。新增的本地守卫矩阵现覆盖允许的 32765、32766 个 UTF-16 单元拼接，以及拒绝的 32767、32768、32780 个单元拼接，包括分隔空格和补充平面 Unicode 字符。最终工作树包含 16 个协议测试和 9 个生产者测试。最终树日志现已记录 Temurin JDK 21.0.13.1 下的通过结果：16 个协议测试和 9 个生产者测试，无失败、错误或跳过，Checkstyle 零违规。Surefire XML 确认了 JDK 和测试数量。这些命令运行的是验证模块，依赖默认 Maven 缓存中的产物；随后的源码匹配运行在本树自有源码上重建了 qwencode SDK 与全部十三个 managed-agent 模块（同一 Temurin JDK 21.0.13.1，任务隔离 `-Dmaven.repo.local`，反应堆汇总全部模块 `BUILD SUCCESS`），同样的两套件在其上通过——16 个协议测试与 9 个生产者测试，25/25，Checkstyle 零违规。该修订所要求的 CI 验收仍与之前一样待完成。更早的一次尝试因其 JDK 路径不存在而在 Maven 启动前停止；后来的成功运行取代了那次尝试，但未填补 CI 缺口。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A — 无用户可见改动。已记录的前后对比证据是上文所述的守卫失败以及通过的协议与生产者测试。

### 测试平台

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------------: | :--: |
|     🍏 macOS     |  ✅  |
|    🪟 Windows    |  ⚠️  |
|     🐧 Linux     |  ⚠️  |

所提供的完整验证反应堆运行报告为 6658 个测试、41 个失败、1 个错误和 44 个跳过。失败仅涉及 `SessionRecoveryInitialStateTest`（36 个失败）、`SessionResourceCollectionCollectorTest`（4 个失败）、`ManagedSessionStoreIntegrationTest`（1 个失败）和 `ToolPublicationStoreTest`（1 个错误）。所提供的基线对比报告显示，未改动的树上这四个类出现相同数量的失败和错误。缺失 `packages/core/dist` 前置产物被确认为会话恢复失败的原因，但并未被确认为所有失败类的共同原因。这不是一次通过的完整反应堆运行。

### 环境（可选）

最初实现记录的本地运行使用 macOS arm64、Temurin OpenJDK 21.0.13.1（该模块要求的工具链）、Maven 3.9.9 配任务隔离的 `-Dmaven.repo.local` 以及 Node.js v22.23.2，实现基于 `e8cdbe44`。JDK 21 下：`ExternalShellWorkerProtocolTest` 12/12、`ExternalShellProducerPublicationTest` 9/9、`mvn checkstyle:check` 全模块零违规。更早记录的运行使用 OpenJDK 25.0.2（协议套件 12/12、更广反应堆中的生产者套件 9/9，Checkstyle 与 Prettier 通过）。所改 worker 资源通过 `prettier --check`。Windows 与 Linux 原生执行仍等待 CI。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Java fixture 与其 JavaScript 替身必须对两个 boot 文档负载字段保持一致。该 fixture 是跟踪文件中唯一启动此资源的入口；直接调用者是协议套件和生产者发布套件。后者还覆盖非空 stderr 和已保存绑定的重载。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：Windows 与 Linux 原生执行以及所要求的整条 lane CI 闸门仍待完成。最终树的 JDK 21 证据包括隔离、从源码构建的反应堆上的两个选定套件运行和验证模块的 Checkstyle；这些是聚焦的本地证据，而非完整套件通过或 CI 验收结果。更早的默认缓存运行已在上文单独记录。守卫测量的是未加引号的参数字符串，而非序列化后的 Windows 命令行。生产 TypeScript worker 代码、公共 schema 和发布请求/响应形态均未改变；新增 boot 字段仅供此替身使用。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无已发布 API 或迁移改动。审查快照中的安装器字节差异仅为 `.gitattributes` 要求的 LF 到 CRLF 检出转换；其 Git blob 未改变，不属于待提交的安装器改动。

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): converge pre-production version machinery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR removes the rolling-upgrade version-compatibility machinery from the managed agent server and its hosted worker, and converges the remaining version-shaped formats onto single shapes. The managed service is pre-production, so machinery whose only purpose is to protect already-deployed data or to negotiate rolling upgrades carries no protected object and can be deleted. Concretely, the batch: strips the Session storage-version reader ceiling and writer-capability negotiation; unifies the hosted action-options format family onto one superset shape validated by field presence; drops the server-side journal-pack minimum-reader declaration while keeping the standalone local journal dialect working; and finally removes the Session storage-version column itself, re-expressing the one live invariant it still carried — the activity-diagnostic projection rebuild gate — through a durable boolean head flag instead of a version number. Single-version integrity gates (record schema versions, the pack and event format versions, the version-consistency pins) are deliberately kept; they are correctness checks, not compatibility artifacts. The CSI resource-handle ladder that the original inventory listed was already retired by the cold archive #17415, so this batch records it as dropped rather than re-implementing it. The change set is mostly deletion, lands the Java and TypeScript wire changes together, and edits the V1 schema baseline in place.

## Why it's needed

Before production there is no deployed fleet to roll forward and no persisted data that an older reader must still understand. Every version ladder, reader ceiling, and capability negotiation that exists only for those scenarios is dead weight: it multiplies the shapes the writer and reader must handle, adds admission refusal paths, and obscures the few invariants that are actually load-bearing. Removing them simplifies the storage and action protocols to the single shape the current worker and server actually use, while preserving the integrity gates that catch corruption. Doing this now, before any data exists, avoids a migration later.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

This is a non-user-visible refactor of the managed storage/action protocols; verify through the focused suites and the rebuild invariant rather than the TUI.

- Activity rebuild invariant (the load-bearing behavior): a Session that has committed activity diagnostics still refuses writer admission while its activity projection is being rebuilt, and still rebuilds the projection to ready from the durable journal after the projection is wiped. The new focused test commits activity diagnostics, wipes the projection rows, asserts the durable head flag survives the wipe, asserts the next commit is refused with `managed_activity_rebuilding`, then acquires the writer (which rebuilds to ready) and confirms the commit is admitted. A Session without activity diagnostics is unaffected and never gated.
- Focused Java regressions (JDK 21, Maven, isolated local repository, `-pl verification -am`): the session-store integration, activity-diagnostics, store-wiring, side-query, and actions suites pass (102 tests), and a snapshot/recovery batch (native snapshots, snapshot restore response, recovery initial state, snapshot retirement) passes.
- Focused TypeScript regressions: the hosted session-store and original-receipt-checkpoint suites pass (266 tests), and the workspace-recovery session/worker suites pass (155 tests). The local standalone journal dialect tests stay green.
- Full repository typecheck passes (`npm run typecheck`, all packages).
- A grep across production code, tests, and the `scripts/` E2E harness confirms no live `storageVersion` / `storage_version` field remains (the cold CSI archive is excluded as dead code outside the build); only the pack/event format-version constant and its two integrity reads survive.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI refactor. Before: writer grants carried a supported storage version, heads carried a 1–5 storage version, action options had four writer shapes, and pack headers carried a minimum-reader declaration. After: a single action-options shape, no storage-version negotiation, and a boolean head flag drives the activity rebuild gate; the pack/event format-version integrity gates are unchanged.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local verification on macOS: JDK 21, Maven 3.9.12 with an isolated APFS-cloned local repository, vitest for the TypeScript suites, and `tsc --noEmit` for typecheck. MySQL integration tests, full Checkstyle/SpotBugs, and the full suite are owned by CI and were not run locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the restore-head wire shape and the native snapshot manifest change (the head now carries a boolean activity-diagnostics flag instead of a storage version, and the manifest loses its storage-version field). This is acceptable pre-production because the worker and server deploy as one unit and no deployed data needs migrating; the activity flag must be set on the first activity commit and survive a projection wipe, which the new focused test pins. Fencing, writer-lease/generation, and tenant-isolation logic are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: MySQL integration tests and the full Checkstyle/SpotBugs/full-suite gates run in CI, not locally. The tool-execution protocol convergence (A3) is a separate, larger batch and is not touched here. The local standalone journal dialect is kept working, not unified. Dual-active regime selectors (B class) are frozen product decisions, out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the Session storage-version column is removed by editing the V1 schema baseline in place (no V2+ migration; pre-production, no data to migrate). The restore-head and native-manifest wire fields change as above; worker and server must be deployed together.

Design documents (English + Chinese, complete and synchronized): [version convergence](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-agent-version-convergence.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-agent-version-convergence.zh-CN.md); [A1 Layer 2 storage-version removal](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-a1-layer2-storage-version-removal.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-a1-layer2-storage-version-removal.zh-CN.md). The CSI cold archive context is recorded in [managed-kubernetes-java-archive](docs/design/2026-11-13-managed-kubernetes-java-archive.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-13-managed-kubernetes-java-archive.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Context: the CSI resource-handle ladder (A4) was retired by the cold archive #17415 (already merged); this batch records it as dropped. No tracking issue is auto-closed by this PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 从 managed agent server 及其 hosted worker 中拆除滚动升级版本兼容机制，并把剩余按版本 shaped 的格式收敛为单一形状。managed 服务尚未投产，因此那些仅为保护已部署数据、或为协商滚动升级而存在的机制没有保护对象，可以删除。具体而言，本批：剥离 Session storage 版本的 reader 天花板与 writer 能力协商；把 hosted action-options 格式族统一为按字段存在性校验的单一超集形状；删除服务器侧 journal pack 的 minimum-reader 声明，同时保持 standalone 本地 journal 方言可用；最后删除 Session storage 版本列本身，并用一个持久的 head 布尔标记（而非版本号）重新表达它仍承载的唯一活不变量——activity 诊断投影重建门。单版本完整性门（记录 schema 版本、pack 与 event 格式版本、版本一致性 pin）被刻意保留：它们是正确性检查，不是兼容产物。原盘点列出的 CSI resource-handle 阶梯已被冷归档 #17415 退役，故本批将其记录为丢弃而非重新实现。变更集以删除为主，Java 与 TypeScript 线变更同步落地，并原地编辑 V1 schema 基线。

## 为什么需要

投产前没有需要滚动向前的部署集群，也没有旧 reader 仍须理解的持久数据。每一个仅为这些场景存在的版本阶梯、reader 天花板、能力协商都是死重：它让 writer 与 reader 须处理的形状成倍增加、增加准入拒绝路径、并掩盖真正承重的少数不变量。拆除它们把 storage 与 action 协议简化为当前 worker 与 server 实际使用的单一形状，同时保留捕获损坏的完整性门。趁现在还没有任何数据做这件事，可避免日后的迁移。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

这是 managed storage/action 协议的非用户可见重构；通过聚焦套件与重建不变量验证，而非 TUI。

- activity 重建不变量（承重行为）：已提交 activity 诊断的 Session 在其 activity 投影重建期间仍拒绝 writer 准入，并在投影被清后仍从持久 journal 把投影重建至 ready。新增聚焦测试提交 activity 诊断、清除投影行、断言持久 head 标记在清除后存活、断言下一次提交被拒 `managed_activity_rebuilding`，然后获取 writer（重建至 ready）并确认提交被准入。无 activity 诊断的 Session 不受影响、从不被门控。
- 聚焦 Java 回归（JDK 21、Maven、隔离本地仓库、`-pl verification -am`）：session-store 集成、activity-diagnostics、store-wiring、side-query、actions 套件通过（102 测试），快照/recovery 批次（native snapshots、快照 restore 响应、recovery 初始状态、快照退役）通过。
- 聚焦 TypeScript 回归：hosted session-store 与 original-receipt-checkpoint 套件通过（266 测试），workspace-recovery session/worker 套件通过（155 测试）。本地 standalone journal 方言测试保持绿。
- 全仓 typecheck 通过（`npm run typecheck`，所有包）。
- grep 普查生产代码、测试与 `scripts/` E2E harness，确认无活 `storageVersion` / `storage_version` 字段残留（冷 CSI 归档作为构建外死代码排除）；仅 pack/event 格式版本常量及其两处完整性读取存活。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 非 UI 重构。前：writer grant 携带 supported storage version，head 携带 1–5 storage version，action options 有四种 writer 形状，pack 头携带 minimum-reader 声明。后：单一 action-options 形状、无 storage 版本协商、head 布尔标记驱动 activity 重建门；pack/event 格式版本完整性门不变。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 环境（可选）

macOS 本地验证：JDK 21、Maven 3.9.12 配隔离 APFS clone 本地仓库、vitest 跑 TypeScript 套件、`tsc --noEmit` 做 typecheck。MySQL 集成测试、完整 Checkstyle/SpotBugs 与全套件由 CI 负责，未本地跑。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：restore-head 线形状与 native snapshot manifest 变更（head 改携带布尔 activity-diagnostics 标记而非 storage version，manifest 去掉 storage-version 字段）。这在 pre-production 可接受，因为 worker 与 server 作为一个单元部署、无既有部署数据需迁移；activity 标记必须在首次 activity 提交置位并在投影清除后存活，新增聚焦测试钉住这一点。围栏、writer-lease/generation、租户隔离逻辑未动。
- 未验证/超出范围：MySQL 集成测试与完整 Checkstyle/SpotBugs/全套件门在 CI 跑，未本地跑。tool 执行协议收敛（A3）是独立的更大批次，本 PR 不触碰。本地 standalone journal 方言保持可用，不做统一。双活 regime 选择器（B 类）是冻结的产品决策，超出范围。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：Session storage 版本列通过原地编辑 V1 schema 基线删除（无 V2+ 迁移；pre-production，无数据需迁移）。restore-head 与 native-manifest 线字段如上变更；worker 与 server 须同部署。

设计文档（英文 + 中文，完整同步）：[版本收敛](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-agent-version-convergence.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-agent-version-convergence.zh-CN.md)；[A1 Layer 2 storage-version 删除](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-a1-layer2-storage-version-removal.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-a1-layer2-storage-version-removal.zh-CN.md)。CSI 冷归档背景见 [managed-kubernetes-java-archive](docs/design/2026-11-13-managed-kubernetes-java-archive.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-13-managed-kubernetes-java-archive.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

背景：CSI resource-handle 阶梯（A4）已被冷归档 #17415（已合并）退役；本批记录为丢弃。本 PR 不自动关闭任何跟踪 issue。

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): files-on-v2 lifecycle and public child relaxation (D3/D5')
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR advances two pieces of the pre-production managed-agent convergence on top of current main, re-adapted after main's /loop profile ladder and external-workspace execution landed:

- **Files-on-v2 lifecycle (D3, narrowed).** Ordinary `hosted-workspace-files/1` Sessions now close through the unified lifecycle v2 — the same effects and resource phases as Shell and MCP — instead of the single-phase v1 path. The files profile joins the negotiated `lifecycleV2Profiles` (capability advertisement and default), the files close settles its resource phase like MCP (no Shell capture/publication/monitor), and the preflight checks files against v2. `hosted-workspace-external-files/1` deliberately keeps protocol 1: its Runtime does not support the v2 resource phase, so the v1 saved-close path and the v1 capability field stay intact for it. Protocol 0 legacy close remains frozen.

- **Public child agents on SSH and pooled Harnesses (D5′).** Public child delegation was admitted only on a durable local-process Broker with a single Harness. The control-plane gates now also admit the SSH runtime arm and pooled Harness workers, keyed on the existing capability checks rather than the deployment shape: the `public-child-agents/1` feature (with its `approval-selection/1` dependency), lifecycle v2 Shell, session isolation and configured SSH nodes. SSH roots no longer need managed extension execution for built-in children. Capable SSH public child Sessions keep their background surface — roots and their depth-1 children alike, so an existing SSH child is not tightened — while launch gating stays root-only and depth 1 holds.

The D1 profile collapse from the earlier convergence branch is **dropped**: main's /loop ladder (`shell/1/3/4`, `files/1/3/4`, which selects the managed /loop skill variant by profile) is a live feature and is preserved unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Files Sessions still closed on the older single-phase protocol while Shell/MCP had moved to the verifiable two-phase v2 close; unifying files on v2 gives files the same resource-closure guarantees. Public child delegation was artificially limited to one deployment shape even though the worker already advertises the capability unconditionally and drives its child lane entirely from control-plane flags; relaxing the gates lets SSH and pooled (Kubernetes) deployments use public children without weakening any capability check. Both changes are pre-production convergence with no stored data to migrate.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Files-on-v2: with a Harness advertising `hosted-workspace-files/1` in `QWEN_HOSTED_LIFECYCLE_V2_PROFILES` (now the default alongside `shell/1`), a files Session close admits protocol 2 and settles the resource phase; an external-files Session still closes on v1. A Harness that does not advertise files/1 fails preflight with "does not offer hosted-workspace-files/1".
- Public children: an SSH deployment (ssh-process provisioner, configured nodes, session isolation) with a capability-advertising Harness admits public children on public Shell roots, built-in or extension, without requiring managed extension execution for the built-in arm. A pooled Harness whose contract advertises `public-child-agents/1` and lifecycle v2 Shell admits children; a pool without the token (or without `approval-selection/1`) refuses. Resident/CSI Workspaces, depth > 1 and incapable workers refuse exactly as before.
- Java focused suites (lifecycle, admission, connector, preflight, properties, pool) and the worker contract suite pass; Checkstyle dual execution is clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — control-plane refactor, no TUI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment

JDK 21 + Maven 3.9.12 (isolated local repository), Node 24, `npm run build`; Java focused tests + Checkstyle dual execution, TS contract suite. MySQL integration tiers and full CI suites run in CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: files-on-v2 changes the files close path; it is gated by capability negotiation, so an old worker that does not advertise files/1 fails preflight rather than silently downgrading. External-files keeps v1, so its close is unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: MySQL integration tiers and full CI suites (run in CI); the A-series version-convergence commits are a separate effort and not included.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: pre-production hard cut; no stored data migration. The `workspace-child-agents-enabled` configuration description and the generated configuration reference are updated to the relaxed admission.

Design documents (bilingual, synchronized):
- [Managed public child agents on SSH and pooled Harnesses (D5′)](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-public-child-runtime-relaxation.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-19-managed-public-child-runtime-relaxation.zh-CN.md)
- [Workspace profile lifecycle](docs/design/workspace-profile-lifecycle.md) / [中文](docs/design/workspace-profile-lifecycle.zh-CN.md) (D3 note)
- [Re-adaptation plan](docs/plans/2026-11-20-managed-convergence-readapt-main.md) / [中文](docs/plans/2026-11-20-managed-convergence-readapt-main.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 在当前 main 上推进 managed-agent 投产前收敛的两项（在 main 的 /loop profile 阶梯与 external workspace 执行落地后重新适配）：

- **Files-on-v2 生命周期（D3，收窄）。** 普通 `hosted-workspace-files/1` 会话改经统一的 lifecycle v2 关闭——与 Shell/MCP 相同的 effects 与资源阶段——取代单阶段 v1 路径。files profile 加入协商的 `lifecycleV2Profiles`（能力广告与默认值），files 关闭像 MCP 一样结算资源阶段（无 Shell capture/publication/monitor），preflight 按 v2 检查 files。`hosted-workspace-external-files/1` 刻意保留 protocol 1：其 Runtime 不支持 v2 资源阶段，故 v1 saved-close 路径与 v1 能力字段为其保留。protocol 0 legacy close 仍冻结。

- **SSH 与池化 Harness 上的 public child agent（D5′）。** public child 委派原本只在持久 local-process Broker 加单 Harness 上准入。控制面门控现在也准入 SSH runtime 臂与池化 Harness worker，以既有能力检查而非部署形态为键：`public-child-agents/1` feature（含 `approval-selection/1` 依赖）、lifecycle v2 Shell、session 隔离与已配置 SSH 节点。SSH 根不再需要为内置 child 开启 managed extension execution。有能力的 SSH public child 会话保留背景表面——根与其深度 1 child 一致，既有 SSH child 不被收紧——发起门仍仅限根，深度 1 不变。

旧收敛分支的 D1 profile 塌缩**放弃**：main 的 /loop 阶梯（`shell/1/3/4`、`files/1/3/4`，按 profile 选择 managed /loop skill 变体）是活特性，原样保留。

**为何需要：** files 会话仍走旧单阶段协议，而 Shell/MCP 已迁到可核验的两阶段 v2 关闭；统一 files 到 v2 赋予 files 相同的资源关闭保证。public child 委派被人为限制在单一部署形态，尽管 worker 早已无条件广告该能力并完全由控制面标志驱动 child lane；放宽门控让 SSH 与池化（Kubernetes）部署在不削弱任何能力检查的前提下使用 public child。两项均为投产前收敛，无存量数据需迁移。

**评审验证：** files-on-v2——Harness 在 `QWEN_HOSTED_LIFECYCLE_V2_PROFILES` 广告 `hosted-workspace-files/1`（现与 `shell/1` 同为默认）时，files 会话关闭准入 protocol 2 并结算资源阶段；external-files 会话仍走 v1。不广告 files/1 的 Harness 在 preflight 以 "does not offer hosted-workspace-files/1" 失败。public child——SSH 部署（ssh-process、已配节点、session 隔离）加广告能力的 Harness 在 public Shell 根上准入 public child（内置或扩展），内置臂不要求 managed extension execution。contract 广告 `public-child-agents/1` 与 lifecycle v2 Shell 的池化 Harness 准入 child；缺 token（或缺 `approval-selection/1`）的 pool 拒绝。resident/CSI、深度 > 1、无能力 worker 的拒绝与之前一致。Java 聚焦套件与 worker contract 套件通过；Checkstyle 双 execution 干净。

**风险与范围：** 主要风险——files-on-v2 改变 files 关闭路径，由能力协商门控，旧 worker 不广告 files/1 时 preflight 失败而非静默降级；external-files 保留 v1，关闭不变。未验证/范围外——MySQL 集成层与完整 CI 套件（CI 跑）；A 系列版本收敛属另一工作，不含。破坏性/迁移——投产前硬切，无存量数据迁移；`workspace-child-agents-enabled` 配置描述与生成的配置参考已更新到放宽后的准入。

设计文档（双语同步）：D5′ 设计、workspace-profile-lifecycle（D3 注记）、重适配计划，链接见英文正文。

</details>
